title: CHIME All-sky Multiday Pulsar Stacking Search (CHAMPSS): Power Spectrum Injections and Survey Sensitivity
background_knowledge: 射电脉冲星是快速旋转、具有强磁场的中子星，其射电束周期性扫过视线，形成可观测的脉冲信号。脉冲星巡天通常先对接收机数据进行消色散，以补偿星际介质引起的频率依赖延迟（色散量 DM），再通过傅里叶功率谱、周期折叠或单脉冲搜索来寻找周期信号；多天数据叠加（stacking）可提升弱周期信号的显著性。CHIME 是位于加拿大的宽视场、无机械指向的射电望远镜，工作于约 $400$--$800\ \mathrm{MHz}$，适合开展全天时域巡天。信号注入是刻画巡天选择效应与敏感度的标准方法：向真实数据中加入人工脉冲星信号，再运行完整搜索流程，统计其恢复率随流量、频率、DM、占空比和天区位置的变化。传统做法多在时间序列中注入，但对大规模巡天而言计算成本很高；频域注入则直接在傅里叶功率谱中加入信号，可显著降低计算开销。巡天敏感度还会受到频率依赖噪声（尤其是低频“红”噪声）、射电干扰、时间采样与积分时间等因素影响。
contribution: 针对 CHAMPSS（CHIME All-sky Multiday Pulsar Stacking Search）中硬件与软件时间序列注入计算量过大的问题，本文提出并实现了将人工脉冲星信号注入傅里叶功率谱的方法；该注入过程相对于 CHAMPSS 搜索管线的整体开销可忽略不计。作者利用这些注入信号探测 CHAMPSS 巡天的系统内部偏差，并评估其探测敏感度。结果表明，**CHAMPSS 对频率量级为 $0.1$--$100\ \mathrm{Hz}$、流量高于 $1\ \mathrm{mJy}$ 的脉冲星最为敏感**；整体敏感度对色散量（DM）、占空比和天区坐标等因素仅有较弱依赖，但**所有参数之间存在复杂的非单调相互作用**。研究进一步指出，**频率依赖噪声，尤其是低频或“红”噪声，以及更高频率处的采样限制，是降低 CHAMPSS 对脉冲星敏感度的主要外在因素**。
summary: Artificial signal injection into real data is a key tool in time-domain radio astronomy, with particular import to the study of pulsars and Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs). Many surveys inject into the time series to probe observational biases impacting the detection of radio transients. In the case of the CHIME All-sky Multiday Pulsar Stack Search (CHAMPSS), the computational demands of both hardware and software time series injections force an alternative approach. We present methods for injecting artificial pulsar signals into the Fourier power spectrum. The injection process detailed here is computationally negligible compared to the overhead of the CHAMPSS search pipeline. We use injections to probe the in-system biases of the CHAMPSS survey. CHAMPSS is most sensitive to pulsars with frequencies on the order of 0.1 - 100 Hz and fluxes > 1 mJy. Our injections show weak overall sensitivity dependence on other factors such as dispersion measure (DM), duty cycle, and sky coordinates, but complex non-monotonic interactions between all parameters. Our findings suggest that frequency-dependent noise, especially low-frequency or "red" noise, and sampling limitations at higher frequencies are the dominant extrinsic factors decreasing CHAMPSS' sensitivity to pulsars.

title: Hidden Neutrino Active Galaxy Candidates: Prospects for Catalog and Stacking Searches with IceCube, IceCube-Gen2, and KM3NeT
background_knowledge:
高能中微子天文学的核心目标，是找到能够把宇宙线质子加速到高能并产生中微子的天体。质子在与光子或物质作用时可产生π介子，继而衰变产生中微子；中微子几乎不与物质和磁场作用，因而能携带源区信息并指向源的方向。由于通量极低且大气中微子构成强背景，探测通常依赖千米级水或冰的切伦科夫探测器，如 IceCube，并借助单源搜寻与多源叠加（stacking）提高灵敏度；下一代设施 IceCube-Gen2 和 KM3NeT 将进一步扩展能量与天区覆盖。
\n活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积供能，是主要候选源之一。传统上，具有相对论喷流的 blazar 被寄予厚望，但 IceCube 对 NGC 1068 等的观测表明，喷流安静、核区可能被遮蔽的 AGN 也可能有效产生高能中微子。此类系统中，吸积盘上方的高温电子冕可通过逆康普顿散射产生 X 射线；若磁化冕同时加速质子，则质子与 X 射线光子作用可产生中微子。因此，内禀 X 射线通量可在特定模型下作为中微子通量的代理，但源参数、辐射机制和遮蔽结构仍带来显著不确定性。
contribution: 论文构建了一个理论引导、以内禀 X 射线选择的隐藏中微子 AGN 候选体样本 X-HiNAC，共包含 28 个 X 射线明亮的 AGN，并将 Swift/BAT 与 BASS 巡天同专门的 NuSTAR 观测和能谱分析相结合。作者汇编了这些源的内禀 X 射线通量、能谱性质、光度距离和超大质量黑洞质量，为高能中微子源搜寻提供了统一样本；该样本具有物理动机，同时在给定中微子通量正比于内禀 X 射线通量的前提下保持模型独立性。基于磁能驱动的冕模型，论文展示了利用 IceCube-Gen2 和 KM3NeT 开展单源搜寻与 stacking 搜寻的前景，识别出有希望的单源目标，并发现若排除 NGC 1068 后对剩余源进行 stacking，在有利模型假设下，当前及下一代中微子天文台可在约 5–15 年内达到 $5\sigma$ 探测。作者强调源参数的系统不确定性，尤其是黑洞质量：不同测量技术给出的估计可相差一个量级，从而显著影响预测的中微子辐射，**因此需要更精确的黑洞质量测量和更好的宽波段 X 射线观测**。这些结果**推动对邻近 AGN 开展更完善的多波段刻画，并为研究其作为高能中微子源的作用提供指引**。
summary: In high-energy neutrino astrophysics, the identification of high-energy neutrino sources is a central goal, and jet-quiet active galactic nuclei (AGNs) have emerged as promising candidates. For this purpose, we present a theory-guided, intrinsic X-ray selected sample of hidden neutrino AGN candidates consisting of $28$ X-ray bright AGNs (X-HiNAC), combining the {\em Swift}/BAT and BASS surveys with dedicated {\em NuSTAR} observations and spectral analyses. We compile their intrinsic X-ray fluxes, spectral properties, luminosity distances, and supermassive black hole masses, to provide a coherent sample for neutrino source searches. The sample is physically motivated but remains model independent given that the neutrino flux is proportional to the intrinsic X-ray flux. Using the magnetically powered corona model, we also demonstrate the prospects for individual-source and stacking searches with IceCube-Gen2 and KM3NeT. We identify promising individual targets and find that stacking the remaining sources, excluding NGC 1068, could yield a $5σ$ detection within $\sim 5-15$ years under favorable model assumptions at the current and upcoming neutrino observatories. We highlight systematic uncertainties in the adopted source parameters, particularly the black hole masses, for which different measurement techniques can yield estimates differing by up to an order of magnitude. Such uncertainties can significantly affect the predicted neutrino emission, motivating more precise black hole mass measurements and improved broadband X-ray observations. Our findings motivate improved multiwavelength characterization of nearby AGNs and provide a guide for investigating their role as high-energy neutrino sources.

title: Detectability of an orbital-angular-momentum-based gravitational wave detector
background_knowledge: 引力波是时空度规的微小扰动，通常由加速运动的大质量天体的四极矩变化产生；地面激光干涉仪通过测量相互垂直臂长差引起的激光相位变化来探测 kHz 频段的引力波。其研究范式是把引力波信号置于差分模式，而把激光强度、相位、频率以及光学模式不纯等公共扰动作为共模量，利用平衡探测与共模抑制降低噪声；最终灵敏度受散粒噪声、热噪声和量子辐射压噪声等限制。光的轨道角动量（OAM）对应光束横向空间模式的相位绕转结构，不同 OAM 模式正交，可作为新的精密测量自由度：若引力波使光子在 OAM 模式间发生跃迁，则模式分辨读出可把微小跃迁转化为可测信号。该方向属于引力波探测与量子光学、精密测量交叉的新型读出方案研究，目前主要处于噪声预算与可探测性评估阶段。
contribution: 论文建立了一套基于 OAM 模式跃迁的引力波读出方案，并在 $1\,\mathrm{mHz}$ 到 $100\,\mathrm{Hz}$ 频段内评估激光强度噪声、激光相位噪声、模式不纯噪声和散粒噪声构成的噪声预算。对于对称叠加 OAM 态，引力波诱导的跃迁振幅满足 $\alpha_{+}=-\alpha_{-}^{*}$，而噪声诱导的模式串扰系数满足 $n_{+}=n_{-}^{*}$；因此引力波信号表现为差分模式贡献，激光强度噪声与模式不纯噪声表现为共模贡献，可通过平衡探测加以抑制。论文指出，在固定束腰约束下，较短的臂长允许更大的傍轴参数，从而降低等效角噪声的应变灵敏度限制；其代表性配置取 $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$、$N=160$ 次往返、傍轴参数 $\gamma=0.1$、入射分束器激光功率 $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$ 和波长 $\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$。采用代表性噪声谱时，对于红移 $z=1$、源系分量质量 $M_{\mathrm{src}}=10^{4}\,M_{\odot}$ 的等质量双黑洞引力波，平衡探测在失配参数 $\varepsilon=10^{-3}$ 时给出 $\mathrm{SNR}=24.7$，在 $\varepsilon=10^{-5}$ 时给出 $\mathrm{SNR}=239$，后者灵敏度接近散粒噪声极限。**紧凑光学配置与强共模抑制是实现基于 OAM 的引力波探测器的关键。**
summary: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) of light provides a new approach to probing gravitational waves (GWs) through transitions between OAM states. Here, we assess the detectability of an OAM-based GW detector by developing a readout scheme and evaluating its noise budget over the frequency range from $1~\mathrm{mHz}$ to $100~\mathrm{Hz}$, including laser-intensity noise, laser-phase noise, mode-impurity noise, and shot noise. For a symmetric superposition OAM state, the GW-induced transition amplitudes satisfy $α_+=-α_-^*$, whereas the noise-induced mode-crosstalk coefficients obey $n_+=n_-^*$. Hence, the GW-induced signal forms a differential-mode contribution, while laser-intensity and mode-impurity noises enter as common-mode contributions, enabling their suppression by the balanced detection. Under a fixed beam-waist constraint, a shorter arm permits a larger paraxial parameter, reducing the equivalent angular-noise strain sensitivity. We adopt an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $γ=0.1$, a laser power incident on the beam splitter of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, and a wavelength of $λ_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$. Using representative noise spectra, we find that, for GWs from an equal-mass binary black hole with source-frame component masses of $M_{\mathrm{src}}=10^{4}\,M_{\odot}$ at redshift $z=1$, balanced detection yields an SNR of $24.7$ for an imbalance parameter of $ε=10^{-3}$ and $239$ for $ε=10^{-5}$, with the sensitivity approaching the shot-noise limit in the latter case. These results highlight the importance of a compact optical configuration and strong common-mode rejection for realizing an OAM-based GW detector.

title: Nonlinear Physics and Self-Organized Criticality in Astrophysics
background_knowledge: 自组织临界性（Self-Organized Criticality，SOC）是描述非线性、耗散、多尺度复杂系统的一类重要框架。其基本图像是：系统在缓慢、持续的外部驱动下，内部应力或能量逐步积累；当局部状态超过阈值时发生快速释放，并通过相互作用触发连锁的“雪崩”事件。系统无需精细调节外部参数，便可自发演化到临界态附近，从而在事件能量、尺寸、持续时间或等待时间等统计量上呈现幂律分布，例如 $N(s) \propto s^{-\alpha}$，并可能伴随分形结构、长程时空关联和有限尺寸标度行为。该领域与相变和临界现象、非线性动力学、元胞自动机、沙堆模型、雪崩动力学及普适性等研究范式密切相关。在天体物理中，太阳耀斑、X 射线爆发、吸积盘不稳定性、星际介质湍流与恒星形成等系统都可能具有阈值驱动的能量释放和尺度不变统计特征。然而，幂律本身并非 SOC 的充分证据，因为多种非临界机制也可产生幂律；因此需要结合动力学过程、时空演化、等待时间分布、能量依赖性和有限尺寸标度等进行综合判别。SOC 的定义长期存在模糊性与争议，这正是该文讨论六类基本定义的背景。
contribution: 论文针对 SOC 定义模糊且有争议的问题，梳理并讨论六类基本 SOC 定义所涉及的非线性物理：相变、分形结构、幂律、SOC 偶发性（contingency）、指数增长与扩散衰减。文章指出，SOC 事件或雪崩过程的统计特征可由事件尺寸分布推断，也可由系统的时空演化推断。其核心贡献在于 **从多种非线性物理定义出发厘清 SOC 的判据与诊断量**，并强调 **不能将 SOC 简单等同于单一幂律现象，而应综合考察事件的统计分布与时空动力学**。该工作为在天体物理中识别、检验和比较 SOC 现象提供了概念性框架。
summary: The definition of self-organized criticality (SOC) is ambiguous and controversial. Here we discuss the nonlinear physics of six basic SOC definitions, such as: phase transitions, fractal structures, power laws, SOC contingency, exponential growth, and diffusive decay. Statistics of SOC events or avalanche processes can be inferred from their size distributions, or from their spatio-temporal evolution.

title: The Stellar-Mass Dependence of Feedback-Driven Outflows in DESI DR1 Star-Forming Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕、气体与恒星之间的多尺度相互作用：气体冷却并坍缩形成恒星，而恒星反馈通过超新星爆发、恒星风、辐射压和宇宙线把能量与动量注入星际介质，驱动外流、加热气体并调节恒星形成。数值模拟与观测表明，在低质量星系中引力势阱较浅，反馈驱动的外流更容易逃逸，反复的气体流入与外流可形成“呼吸模式”，并预言质量归一化气体速度弥散与近期恒星形成之间存在正相关。随着恒星质量增加，引力势阱变深、气体运动学更可能由旋转和稳定支撑主导，反馈信号可能被稀释。该领域通常结合 DESI 等大样本光谱巡天、COSMOS2020 等测光数据、电离气体运动学测量与恒星形成历史拟合，并将结果与 FIRE-2 等宇宙学流体模拟比较，以检验反馈调控星系演化的物理图像。
contribution: 论文利用约 1200 个处于 $z<0.25$、$7.9<\log M_\star/M_\odot<11.5$ 范围内的恒星形成星系，结合 DESI DR1 光谱与 COSMOS2020 测光，使用 pPXF 测量电离气体运动学，并通过 Prospector 联合测光与光谱拟合重建近期恒星形成历史。论文确认，在低质量区间 $\log M_\star/M_\odot \lesssim 9.8$ 内，质量归一化气体速度弥散与近期恒星形成之间存在预期的正相关，且与既有观测及 FIRE-2 模拟定量一致；当 $\log M_\star/M_\odot \sim 9.8$ 以上时，该相关性迅速减弱并趋近于零，**首次从观测上给出了反馈驱动外流循环的运动学特征变得可忽略的恒星质量标度约束**。这些结果**确立了一个特征恒星质量，在该质量以上恒星反馈不再主导星系尺度气体运动学**，并为反馈调控星系演化的模型提供了新的观测基准。未来结合气体运动学与恒星结构的联合分析将检验该转变是否伴随呼吸模式预言的更广泛星系响应。
summary: Stellar feedback plays a key role in regulating star formation and shaping the evolution of star-forming galaxies. Low-mass galaxies provide one of the most powerful laboratories for testing stellar feedback and its impact on galaxy evolution. Numerical simulations predict that repeated feedback-driven gas inflows and outflows generate a "breathing mode," producing a positive correlation between mass-normalized gas velocity dispersion and recent star formation in dwarf galaxies. Whether this kinematic signature persists at higher stellar masses has remained untested. We investigate this question using $\sim1200$ star-forming galaxies with Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) spectroscopy and COSMOS2020 photometry spanning $7.9<\log M_\star/M_\odot<11.5$ within $z<0.25$. Ionized-gas kinematics are measured with pPXF, and recent star formation histories are reconstructed through joint spectrophotometric fitting with Prospector. We confirm the predicted positive correlation throughout the low-mass regime with $\log M_\star/M_\odot \lesssim 9.8$, quantitatively consistent with previous observations and FIRE-2 simulations. Above $\log M_\star/M_\odot \sim 9.8$, the correlation weakens rapidly and becomes consistent with zero, providing the first empirical constraint on the stellar mass scale above which the kinematic signature of feedback-driven outflow cycles becomes negligible. Our results establish a characteristic stellar mass above which stellar feedback no longer dominates galaxy-scale gas kinematics, providing a new observational benchmark for models of feedback-regulated galaxy evolution. Future joint analyses of gas kinematics and stellar structure will test whether this transition is accompanied by the broader galaxy response predicted by the breathing mode scenario.

title: An all-sky catalogue of Be transition stars from WISE and Gaia
background_knowledge: 经典 Be 星是快速自转的非超巨星 B 型星，因星周存在外流盘（decretion disk）而呈现氢发射线和红外超。其基础物理图像通常包括接近临界自转的恒星、由物质外流形成的星周盘、盘内黏性演化与辐射转移，以及间歇性的爆发、盘形成和盘耗散。观测上，盘活动会在中红外波段产生显著红外超和时变；WISE 的 $W_1$、$W_2$ 波段及 $W_1-W_2$ 颜色可追踪星周盘的存在与变化，Gaia 提供全天高精度位置、视差和自行以构建母样本。该领域的研究范式是以大规模时域巡天进行统计样本筛选，再结合 TESS 光变与 LAMOST 等光谱开展双星、爆发和盘演化研究；它连接恒星物理、星周盘物理与双星演化，但经典 Be 星并非新生恒星，因此与恒星形成研究有所区别。
contribution: 论文利用 Gaia DR3 天体测量和 WISE/NEOWISE-R 多历元中红外测光，从 420 万颗 Gaia 筛选的候选 OBA 星中，通过 $W_1$ 星等与 $W_1-W_2$ 颜色的相关时变来识别在宁静 B 型与活动 Be 星阶段之间转换的 Be 过渡星（Be transition stars）。最终星表包含 **3,300 颗 Be 过渡星，其中 2,743 颗为新发现**，为全天统计研究 Be 爆发活动提供了大样本。测得爆发相和衰减相的中位持续时间分别为 **459 天和 478 天**，与既往基于 WISE 的测量一致，也与黏性外流盘框架下较长的盘演化时标相符。作为初步应用，作者对 3,017 个目标使用 TESS 测光，识别出 **63 个宿主为 Be 过渡星的食双星系统**，包括 **33 个 Algol 型、17 个 Beta Lyrae 型和 13 个 W Ursae Majoris 型**系统。在 LAMOST 多历元光谱中，两个源显示出超过 $20\ \mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$ 的候选视向速度变化；其谱线轮廓行为提示，活动 Be 过渡星的视向速度变化可能受爆发相关谱线轮廓变化影响，而不能作为双星运动的确凿指标。该星表为未来研究 Be 爆发、盘演化及其与双星性和光谱变率联系提供了基础。
summary: We present an all-sky catalogue of classical Be stars undergoing transitions between quiescent B-type and active Be-star phases, based on Gaia DR3 astrometry and multi-epoch mid-infrared photometry from WISE and NEOWISE-R. From a Gaia-selected parent sample of 4.2 million candidate OBA stars, we identify Be transition stars through correlated variability in $W_1$ magnitude and $W_1-W_2$ colour, which traces circumstellar disk formation and dissipation. The final catalogue contains 3,300 Be transition stars, including 2,743 newly identified objects, and provides a large, homogeneous sample for studying Be outburst activity across the sky. The median durations of the measured outburst and decay phases are 459 and 478 days, respectively, consistent with previous WISE-based measurements and compatible with the long disk-evolution timescales expected in the viscous decretion disk framework. As an initial application, we use TESS photometry for 3,017 targets to identify 63 eclipsing binary systems hosting Be transition stars, including 33 Algol-type, 17 Beta Lyrae-type, and 13 W Ursae Majoris-type systems. Among the multi-epoch LAMOST spectra, two sources show candidate radial-velocity shifts exceeding 20 km s $^{-1}$; their line-profile behaviour suggests that RV variability in active Be transition stars may be influenced by outburst-related line-profile changes rather than being an unambiguous indicator of binary motion. This catalogue provides a basis for future statistical studies of Be outbursts, disk evolution, and their connection with binarity and spectroscopic variability.

title: Imaging the Current Distribution in Superconducting Transition-Edge Sensors with Scanning SQUID Microscopy
background_knowledge: 超导过渡边缘传感器（transition-edge sensors，TESs）是一类工作在超导临界温度 $T_c$ 附近电阻转变区的低温量热器：吸收体把入射 X 射线光子的能量转化为微小温升，电阻对温度的陡峭依赖再把它转成电流或电压信号；在电压偏置与电热反馈条件下，TES 可获得低噪声和高能量分辨率，因此是 X 射线精密能谱（包括天文 X 射线观测）的重要探测器。理想化模型通常把超导态、临界温度和输运电流视为空间均匀，但实际器件由超导薄膜、超导引线、正常金属结构及双层膜邻近效应构成，几何边界和材料不均匀性会在介观尺度上改变超导区域与电流路径，进而影响转变曲线、噪声、稳定性和能量分辨率。扫描超导量子干涉仪（SQUID）显微镜（SSM）能以高磁灵敏度和微米至亚微米空间分辨率扫描样品表面局域磁场：抗磁/迈斯纳响应可标示超导区域，电流产生的奥斯特场可反演电流密度分布，因而适合检验 TES 在偏置状态下的实际电磁结构。
contribution: 论文利用扫描 SQUID 显微镜（SSM）对两种钼-金（MoAu）X 射线 TES 设计进行局域成像，**直接测量器件内的超导性质与输运电流分布**。对于电压偏置在超导转变区内的器件，作者通过局域抗磁响应识别超导区域，并利用输运电流产生的奥斯特场重构相应的电流分布。结果显示，**电流分布会随偏置条件发生重构，并与电流诱导的超导区域变化同步**；这揭示出既有 TES 模型因忽略空间变化而遗漏的关键物理。论文据此强调，**介观尺度的空间不均匀性对 TES 的器件物理、运行和设计具有重要影响**。
summary: Transition-edge sensors (TESs) exploit the resistive transition of a superconductor to detect minute changes in temperature. While significant progress has been made in understanding the temperature- and current-dependent resistive transition in these devices, important aspects of TES behavior under bias remain unresolved. In particular, existing TES models largely neglect spatial variations in the superconducting state and current distribution arising from device geometry and proximity effects associated with the superconducting leads and normal metal features. Using scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscopy (SSM), we directly image local superconducting properties and transport current in two molybdenum-gold (MoAu) X-ray TES designs. We measure the local diamagnetic response to identify superconducting regions in devices voltage-biased within the transition and the Oersted field generated by the transport current to reconstruct the corresponding current distribution. We observe bias-dependent reconfigurations of the current distribution that track current-induced changes in superconducting regions, highlighting the importance of mesoscale spatial variations for TES device physics, operation, and design.

title: FiDeR: Denoising Astronomical Images at the Observational Resolution
background_knowledge: 天文图像本质上是源表面亮度分布与望远镜及探测器点扩散函数（PSF）的卷积，并叠加天空背景、暗电流与读出噪声等随机成分。图像降噪的目标是在尽量不改变测光、形态和 PSF 的前提下抑制噪声；它不同于反卷积，后者的目标是提高分辨率，但常会放大噪声并引入伪结构。PSF 是点源测光、孔径通量、形态测量以及弱引力透镜等分析的核心校准量，因此降噪方法若改变 PSF 或引入空间相关噪声，会影响后续科学测量。Richardson--Lucy（RL）迭代是常用的非线性反卷积方法，可在非负约束下估计源分布；采用有限迭代并在之后进行再卷积，是在抑制噪声与保持观测 PSF 之间折中的思路。常用评价指标包括峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性（SSIM）、PSF 翼部误差、孔径通量与形状误差。JWST 的 NIRCam 与 MIRI 提供高分辨率红外成像，但背景噪声、仪器噪声与多次曝光的相关噪声仍使降噪与误差传播成为关键问题。
contribution: 论文提出有限迭代反卷积--再卷积降噪方法 FiDeR，用于在近似保持输入 PSF 的同时降低天文图像噪声。方法先对非负的源加背景图像执行有限次 Richardson--Lucy（RL）迭代，再用相同设置处理校准点源，测量其响应并构建与观测 PSF 匹配的再卷积核；该校准还纳入背景与源通量比 $B/S$ 的贡献。作者使用模拟点源场、恒星--星系混合场以及 JWST NIRCam 与 MIRI 观测，将 FiDeR 与六种降噪器比较。结果显示：在恒星测试中，亮源宽度与输入宽度接近，暗源仅有小幅残余偏移；在混合场中，每像素背景为 10 counts 与 20 counts 时，FiDeR 的峰值信噪比分别达到 46.701 dB 与 44.850 dB，PSF 翼部误差分别为 0.657 counts 与 0.858 counts，孔径通量与形状误差也较小，尽管 BM3D 的结构相似性更高。NIRCam 数据上核心区与组合区域误差更低，三曝光 MIRI 测试的收益主要体现在恒星孔径与测光。**这些结果支持在所测试范围内实现显著降噪且测得 PSF 变化很小**；降噪图像可作为后续重建与测量的输入，但其不确定性评估**必须计入残余噪声相关性**。
summary: We present Finite-iteration Deconvolution--Reconvolution Denoising (FiDeR), a method for reducing noise in astronomical images while retaining approximately the input point-spread function (PSF). We first apply a finite number of Richardson--Lucy (RL) iterations to the nonnegative source-plus-background image. We then measure the response of a calibration point source processed with the same settings and derive a reconvolution kernel matched to the observational PSF. The calibration includes the background-to-source flux ratio. We compare FiDeR with six denoisers using simulated point-source and mixed stellar--galaxy fields, and observations from the James Webb Space Telescope Near-Infrared Camera (NIRCam) and Mid-Infrared Instrument (MIRI). In the stellar tests, bright-source widths remain close to the input widths; faint sources show small residual offsets. For the mixed field, FiDeR reaches peak signal-to-noise ratios of 46.701 and 44.850 dB at backgrounds of 10 and 20 counts per pixel, with wing errors of 0.657 and 0.858 counts. It also gives small aperture-flux and shape errors, although block-matching and three-dimensional filtering (BM3D) gives higher structural similarity. The NIRCam data show lower core and combined-region errors, while the three-exposure MIRI test gives benefits mainly in the stellar aperture and photometry. These results support substantial noise reduction with little change in the measured PSF within the tested regimes. The denoised images can provide inputs for further reconstruction and measurement; their uncertainties must account for residual noise correlations.

title: EMU/GAMA: Understanding the link between dust geometry and star formation rate in galaxies
background_knowledge: 恒星形成率（SFR）是理解星系形成与演化的核心量之一。年轻大质量恒星的电离辐射使周围气体产生复合线，其中 Hα 是最常用的近邻宇宙 SFR 示踪剂；但其光子易被星际尘埃吸收和散射，因此需要进行尘埃消光改正。传统的 Balmer 递减（BD，常用 Hα/Hβ）在薄屏近似下估计消光，却难以描述光学厚、团块化或混合型尘埃几何：在这些区域 Hα 可能完全无法逃逸，导致基于 Hα 的 SFR 被低估。射电连续谱（如 887.5 MHz 的同步辐射和自由—自由辐射）主要由短寿命大质量恒星终点及其超新星遗迹产生，受尘埃遮蔽影响小，因而可作为互补的 SFR 示踪剂；不过其解释仍受宇宙线电子、磁场、辐射老化及定标等物理系统效应影响。将射电与 Hα 导出的 SFR 比较，可作为诊断尘埃几何与遮蔽程度的工具；再结合由红外/亚毫米波段得到的尘埃质量 $M_{\mathrm{d}}$，可在统计上约束光学厚尘埃对 Hα 发射的贡献。GAMA 等大视场多波段巡天与 EMU 等射电巡天结合，为在星系尺度上检验这些示踪剂和尘埃几何模型提供了样本基础。
contribution: 论文利用 EMU Early Science 在 887.5 MHz 的射电数据与 GAMA G23 场多波段数据，研究尘埃遮蔽与基于 $L_{\mathrm{H\alpha}}$、$L_{\mathrm{radio}}$ 的 SFR 估计器之间的联系。研究指出，BD 虽是改正 Hα 消光的标准工具，却可能遗漏 Hα 无法逃逸的光学厚尘埃区；由射电光度与经 BD 改正的 $L_{\mathrm{H\alpha}}$ 得到的 SFR 之比，可用于探测影响 Hα 的光学厚尘埃程度。作者联合使用 BD 和尘埃质量 $M_{\mathrm{d}}$ 两类尘埃估计，发现它们与 $L_{\mathrm{radio}}/L_{\mathrm{H\alpha}}$ 及星系其他性质存在系统性关联，并据此建立了一个考虑光学厚尘埃的 Hα SFR（$\mathrm{SFR}_{\mathrm{H\alpha}}$）估计器，证明其与传统 SFR 指示量一致。**核心结论是：BD 与 $M_{\mathrm{d}}$ 联合构成的尘埃几何参数 $H_{\mathrm{dust}}$ 能更物理完备地描述传统方法可能忽略的光学厚环境，并可给出与传统方法一致的 SFR 估计；该工作并非替代标准改正方法，而是展示这种联合框架的有效性。**
summary: We investigate the link between dust obscuration and star formation rate (SFR) estimators using Halpha luminosities, L_Halpha and radio luminosities, L_radio. While the Balmer Decrement (BD) is the standard tool for attenuating Halpha, it can fail to account for optically thick dust regions from which Halpha cannot escape. The ratio of SFRs estimated from radio luminosity and L_Halpha corrected for dust attenuation using the BD can be used as a probe of the degree of optically thick dust affecting Halpha. We explore this combining Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) Early Science data at 887.5MHz in the Galaxy and Mass Assembly (GAMA) G23 field with the GAMA data. We draw on dust estimates using both the BD and the dust mass, M_d, demonstrating systematic underlying dependencies with L_radio/L_Halpha. By combining the BD and M_d, we quantify how they relate to L_radio/L_Halpha and other galaxy properties. We use this approach to establish an Halpha SFR (SFR_Halpha) estimator that accounts for optically thick dust, demonstrating its consistency with conventional SFR indicators. Rather than proposing a replacement for standard correction methods, we aim to demonstrate the effectiveness of a dust geometry model that integrates both BD and M_d parameters. This H_dust parameter provides a more physically complete representation of optically thick environments that traditional methods may overlook, and can produce SFR estimates consistent with traditional techniques.

title: Anomaly-ranked confirmation slows new-class learning
background_knowledge: 这一方向处在异常检测、主动学习与新类发现的交叉处。大规模观测或实验（如天文巡天、粒子物理实验、医学影像）先产生海量无标签样本，新类别通常稀少且初始没有标签。典型流程是：异常检测器依据样本与已知数据分布的偏离程度排序，专家用有限预算确认少量候选，再用确认样本训练分类器，使其能自动识别新类。异常分数高只说明“不熟悉”，可能对应新类核心、极端个例、噪声，或已知类边界附近样本；而分类器要学会一个新类，不仅需要发现它，还需要覆盖类内变化并刻画其与邻近已知类的边界。主动学习研究如何选样标注以最有效地改进模型。本文关注的正是：按异常排序挑选确认样本，是否真能高效地教会分类器一个新类及其范围。
contribution: 论文在物理、医学和计算机视觉的五个基准上检验了按异常排序进行专家确认对新类学习的影响。结果显示，检测器标出的成员正是分类器最先学会的样本；但**在三个系统中，确认新类中异常排序最高的成员，反而比确认同样数量的随机成员获得更低的新类识别性能**。**在两种系统中，把后续样本选择交给由已确认样本训练出的分类器，可以挽回部分性能损失**。配对干预进一步表明，**用距离较远的已知类替换邻近已知类，会显著减少达到识别所需的确认次数**。因此，**发现新类与选择能教会其类别范围的样本是两件事；在所测试的类别中，把确认集中在异常排序顶部会降低学习效率**。
summary: Anomaly detectors rank unfamiliar examples for expert confirmation, and the confirmed examples teach a classifier to recognise a new class. Across five benchmarks from physics, medicine and computer vision, the members flagged by the detector are those the classifier learns first. In three systems, confirming the highest-ranked members of a new class gives lower recognition than confirming the same number of random members. Handing subsequent selection to the promoted classifier recovers part of this loss in two systems. A paired intervention further shows that replacing nearby known classes with distant ones sharply reduces the confirmations needed for recognition. These results distinguish finding a new class from selecting examples that teach its extent: within the tested classes, concentrating confirmations at the top of the anomaly ranking makes learning less efficient.

title: Statistical Modeling of Foreground Galactic Cirrus for Diffuse Halo Light Measurement
background_knowledge: 在超低表面亮度深成像中，河系卷云（Galactic cirrus）是银河系星光被星际尘埃散射形成的弥散前景辐射。它具有多尺度、空间相关的结构，在光学波段可能模拟或污染恒星晕、超弥散星系以及星系团内光（ICL）等暗弱延展信号。此类科学目标要求把河系前景、平滑的河外弥散辐射与残余天空项区分开；传统天空背景扣除若过于简单，容易过扣真实延展信号或留下系统残差。星系团中的 ICL 与最亮团星系（BCG）恒星晕记录了星系并合、剥离和团势阱演化，但其表面亮度 $\mu$ 极低，因此前景建模精度直接决定测量可靠性。结合远红外尘埃形态与光学多尺度结构，并用统计方法重建卷云，是提升下一代深场巡天（如 Euclid VIS）弥散光测光的关键途径。
contribution: 论文提出一种统计建模方法，用于重建河系卷云的二维分布，同时在拟合过程中保留恒星晕等河外弥散辐射。方法将远红外尘埃发射所描绘的宽尺度尘埃形态与光学图像中的多尺度结构信息结合，并通过迭代优化前景卷云、平滑弥散光模型和残余天空三个部分，合成合理的卷云结构。作者利用 Euclid VIS 对 Abell 2390 星系团的观测开展注入—回收实验，发现方法 **显著改善了恒星晕测光精度**，但残余偏差仍依赖局地前景结构与天空估计。将该方法应用于 Abell 2390 中心视场后，校正了 BCG 附近显著的卷云复合体，得到 **更平滑的 BCG+ICL 分布、更陡的外廓光剖面以及更低的积分光污染**。结果展示了统计建模河系卷云在深宽场成像巡天弥散光测光中的潜力。
summary: Galactic cirrus, the diffuse Milky Way starlight scattered by interstellar dust, has become a major source of systematic uncertainty in measurements of extragalactic diffuse emission at ultra-low surface brightness levels. Proper modeling and correction of this foreground is crucial to unlock the full potential of next-generation deep imaging surveys for studies of faint diffuse emission such as galactic stellar halos, ultra-diffuse galaxies, and intracluster light (ICL). We develop a statistical approach to reconstruct the 2D distribution of the Galactic cirrus while preserving the underlying diffuse extragalactic emission from stellar halos. We combine the broad dust morphology traced by far-infrared emission with multiscale structural information extracted from the optical images. The method synthesizes plausible cirrus structures through iteratively refining the foreground, the smooth diffuse light model, and the residual sky. The performance is assessed through injection--recovery experiments using Euclid VIS observations of the Abell 2390 cluster, which show substantial improvements in recovered stellar halo photometry, although residual biases depend on the local foreground structure and sky estimation. We apply the method to the central Abell 2390 field to correct for a prominent cirrus complex near its brightest cluster galaxy (BCG), revealing a smoother BCG+ICL distribution with a steeper outer light profile and reduced contamination in the integrated light. Our results demonstrate the potential of statistical modeling of Galactic cirrus to improve diffuse light photometry in deep wide-field imaging surveys.

title: Baryonic feedback and intrinsic alignments in profile: a frequentist view of DES Y3 cosmic shear
background_knowledge: 宇宙剪切是弱引力透镜的核心观测效应：前景大尺度结构产生的引力场使背景星系的图像发生微小但相干的形状畸变，统计其椭率两点评相关可测量物质功率谱的投影，并对宇宙结构增长和几何敏感。在平坦 $\Lambda$CDM 框架下，此类巡天常以 $S_8=\sigma_8(\Omega_\mathrm{m}/0.3)^{0.5}$ 与 $\Omega_\mathrm{m}$ 作为主要宇宙学约束，但小尺度信号还会受到重子反馈和内禀对齐（IA）等天体物理系统的影响。重子反馈通过超新星与活动星系核（AGN）驱动的气体外流和加热改变小尺度物质分布，从而重塑剪切功率谱；IA 则源于星系形状与本地潮汐场的物理关联，常用非线性线性对齐（NLA）或潮汐对齐与潮汐扭矩（TATT）等模型描述。宇宙学参数推断通常采用贝叶斯边缘后验，但在多参数强退化时，后验会受先验体积影响；剖面似然（profile likelihood）沿最大似然路径扫描参数，可用于区分数据驱动约束与先验体积效应。DES Y3 与 KiDS-1000 是当前重要的弱透镜巡天，CMB 外部信息与剪切比（shear ratios）则可用于打破退化并校准系统误差。
contribution: 论文在 DES Y3+KiDS-1000 Hybrid 模型下，从频率学派剖面似然视角对 DES Y3 宇宙剪切进行比较，系统检验重子反馈和内禀对齐参数造成的先验体积效应。仅使用宇宙剪切时，剖面全局最佳拟合与边缘后验均值在 $S_8$ 上一致，但 **剖面似然揭示反馈强度与 $S_8$ 之间存在强退化，$S_8$ 的 $1\sigma$ 上限由所假设的反馈范围决定**。引入对 $\Omega_\mathrm{m}$ 与 $S_8$ 以外参数的外部 CMB 信息后，**该退化被打破，先验体积效应受到抑制，剖面似然与后验重新一致**；在此条件下，小尺度宇宙剪切数据 **偏好中等强度的重子反馈，与按观测气体分数校准的流体动力学模拟相符**。此外，TATT 模型中额外未受约束的参数会使约束变弱，**使 $S_8$ 剖面相对 NLA 模型发生移动并展宽**；加入 DES Y3 剪切比可 **缓解该退化，使剖面似然与边缘后验高度吻合**。
summary: Current cosmic shear surveys primarily constrain $S_8$ and $Ω_\mathrm{m}$, while most other model parameters remain dominated by priors. Consequently, marginal posteriors are vulnerable to prior-volume effects, particularly through degeneracies among $S_8$, baryonic feedback, and intrinsic alignment (IA) model parameters. To isolate data-driven constraints from prior volume effects, we compare profile likelihoods with Bayesian posteriors for DES Y3 cosmic shear under the DES Y3+KiDS-1000 Hybrid model. For cosmic shear alone, the profile global best fit and the marginal posterior mean agree in $S_8$, but the profile likelihood reveals a strong degeneracy between feedback strength and $S_8$, leaving the upper $1σ$ limit on $S_8$ determined by the assumed feedback range. External CMB information on parameters other than $Ω_\mathrm{m}$ and $S_8$ breaks this degeneracy, suppressing prior-volume effects and reconciling the profiles with the posteriors. With CMB data included, small-scale cosmic shear data prefers moderate baryonic feedback strengths consistent with hydrodynamical simulations calibrated to observed gas fractions. Furthermore, additional unconstrained parameters in the tidal alignment and tidal torquing (TATT) model result in weaker constraints, shifting and broadening the $S_8$ profile relative to the nonlinear linear alignment (NLA) model. Adding DES Y3 shear ratios mitigates this degeneracy, bringing profile likelihood and marginal posteriors into close agreement.

title: Multiprobe strategies for Kinematic Lensing with the Roman Space Telescope High Latitude Wide Area Survey
background_knowledge:
现代宇宙学观测表明宇宙正在加速膨胀，其成因通常归为暗能量，并用状态方程参数 $w$ 描述；刻画暗能量性质精度的常用指标是品质因数（Figure of Merit，FoM），它反比于 $w_0$ 与 $w_a$ 联合约束的误差椭圆面积。弱引力透镜（Weak Lensing，WL）是直接探测宇宙大尺度结构中物质分布的方法：前景星系或暗物质晕的引力场使背景星系像产生微弱的相干形变，即剪切（shear）。通过测量大量背景星系形状的二点统计量（如宇宙剪切功率谱），可以反演物质功率谱的增长历史，从而约束暗能量、修改引力以及中微子质量等。传统宇宙剪切分析的主要统计误差来自形状噪声：星系内禀椭率未知且弥散约 $\sigma_\epsilon \sim 0.26$，需要叠加大量星系，统计误差大致按 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 下降。
\nKinematic Lensing（KL，运动学透镜）利用星系自身的运动学信息——例如旋转速度场、旋转轴方向与倾角——来推断其内禀形状和取向，从而在单个星系层面预言其被剪切后的观测量，显著压低形状噪声。它通常需要空间分辨的光谱或无缝隙光谱观测，并与高精度成像结合。Roman Space Telescope 的 High Latitude Wide Area Survey（HLWAS）在其最新设计中包含约 2,300 平方度的重叠测光与光谱数据，为 KL 提供了理想数据集。
\n现代弱透镜宇宙学通常采用多探针（multiprobe）联合分析：宇宙剪切、星系成团性（galaxy clustering）与星系-星系透镜（galaxy-galaxy lensing）共享同一物质场和宇宙学参数，联合建模可打破参数简并并自洽地处理星系偏置（galaxy bias）。系统误差包括测光红移误差、剪切标定偏差、星系偏置模型和重子反馈（baryonic feedback）等；尺度截断与巡天策略（如 Roman 的滚转角设计）也会影响科学产出。
contribution: 论文基于 Roman Space Telescope HLWAS 最新设计（Medium Tier 覆盖约 2,300 平方度的重叠测光与光谱数据），构建并分析了一系列模拟，以量化 KL 的预期宇宙学产出。作者考察了 Roman 早期数据（Deep Tier 天区与早期 Medium Tier 天区）的 KL 前景，评估了不同滚转角（roll angle）选择对 KL 性能的影响，并将 KL 与传统 WL 进行基准比较；同时提出并研究了一个联合 KL、星系成团性和星系-星系透镜的多探针分析框架。分析中纳入了测光不确定性、剪切标定偏差、星系偏置和重子反馈等系统误差。结果表明：**KL 单独即可达到 22.54 的暗能量品质因数（FoM），相比对应的 WL 分析提升超过两倍**；**KL 多探针方法在全巡天条件下将 FoM 提升至 34.58，即使对成团性和星系-星系透镜采用保守的尺度截断**；**对 HLWAS 的滚转角策略，当前计划的 4 次观测（旋转角约 0、10、170、180 度）对 KL 而言接近最优**。
summary: In its latest design, the High Latitude Wide Area Survey (HLWAS) Medium Tier comprises overlapping photometric and spectroscopic data across 2,300 square degrees. This dataset enables Kinematic Lensing (KL), a Weak Lensing (WL) technique that exploits galaxy kinematics to control for shape noise, the dominant statistical limitation of traditional WL. We present several simulated analyses quantifying the expected cosmological science return of a Roman KL analysis with the latest design of the HLWAS: We explore KL prospects with early Roman data from the Deep Tier fields and from the early Medium Tier fields; we demonstrate the impact of different roll-angle choices on the KL performance; we benchmark KL against traditional WL; we introduce a KL-based multiprobe analysis that jointly models KL, galaxy clustering, and galaxy-galaxy lensing. In these analyses, we consider systematics, including photometric uncertainties, shear calibration bias, galaxy bias, and baryonic feedback. Our results show that KL alone achieves a dark energy figure of merit (FoM) of 22.54, which is more than a factor of two improvement over a corresponding WL analysis. The KL multiprobe approach improves the full-survey FoM to 34.58, even assuming conservative scale cuts in the clustering and galaxy-galaxy lensing. For the HLWAS roll-angle strategy, we find that the current plan of 4 passes with rotations of approximately 0, 10, 170, 180 degrees are near optimal for KL.

title: DBI Softens Stiff-Phase Gravitational-Wave Spectra
background_knowledge:
原初引力波通常指暴胀期间张量型时空量子涨落被加速膨胀拉伸到视界外，并在后续宇宙演化中重新进入视界而形成的随机引力波背景。其今日能量密度谱 $\Omega_{\rm GW}(f)$ 不仅依赖暴胀势以及张量谱的振幅和倾斜，还对暴胀结束到辐射主导之间的膨胀历史十分敏感，因为不同物态会改变哈勃膨胀率、张量模的演化以及高频模式的相对贡献。
\n在标准图像中，若暴胀后标量场动能主导而势能可忽略，宇宙会进入 kination，也就是以 $w=1$ 为特征的 stiff phase（硬阶段）。在 canonical 情形下，$w=1$，能量密度按 $\rho\propto a^{-6}$ 红移，比辐射的 $\rho\propto a^{-4}$ 更快；这会缩短 stiff phase 的持续时间，并在原初引力波谱的高频端留下 blue tilt（蓝倾）。观测上，宇宙微波背景（CMB）与大爆炸核合成（BBN）通过限制早期额外能量密度、膨胀率以及有效中微子物种数 $N_{\rm eff}$ 等，对这类阶段给出约束。
\n非正则动能项会改变标量场的传播速度、压强与能量密度关系，因此是修改暴胀后物态和引力波谱的常用理论工具。DBI 作用量源于弯曲额外维中膜的运动，其洛伦兹因子使动能项在强场或高速度时呈现非线性。该方向的研究范式通常是：选取势能与 DBI 参数，数值求解背景膨胀历史和宇宙学扰动，计算原初张量谱经过 stiff phase 后的今日谱，并检验 CMB、BBN 等早期宇宙约束。
contribution: 论文研究非正则动能项对今日原初引力波密度谱的影响：考虑由 Dirac–Born–Infeld（DBI）作用量和 runaway 型势支配的标量场，该场先驱动暴胀，随后进入动能主导的 stiff phase。作者指出，DBI 结构使该阶段的物态参数低于 canonical kination 的 $w=1$，从而**软化原初引力波谱的蓝倾**；与此同时，场能量密度红移更慢，**延迟辐射主导并延长 stiff phase**。这两个效应的竞争可产生**未来实验有可能观测到的引力波信号**，而在对应的 canonical 情形下该信号原本不可及。作者从暴胀一直数值求解到辐射主导，联合背景与扰动演化，得到**与 CMB 和 BBN 约束兼容的可行参数空间**。
summary: We investigate the effect of non-canonical kinetic terms on the present-day density spectrum of primordial gravitational waves (GWs), by considering the dynamics of a scalar field governed by the Dirac--Born--Infeld (DBI) action and a runaway potential. The field, responsible for a period of inflation, subsequently enters a kinetically dominated regime, where the DBI structure reduces the equation-of-state parameter relative to the canonical kination result $w=1$, thereby softening the blue tilt of the GW spectrum. Simultaneously, the energy density of the field redshifts at a slower rate, delaying radiation domination and prolonging the stiff phase. The interplay between these two effects can lead to a potentially observable GW signal that would otherwise remain beyond the reach of future experiments in the canonical case. We test our predictions by numerically solving the background and perturbations, from inflation until radiation domination, and find viable parameter space compatible with cosmic microwave background and Big Bang Nucleosynthesis constraints.

title: Tracking the evolution of sub-Neptunes. I. Gyrochronology of planet hosting stars
background_knowledge: 系外行星系统中，宿主恒星年龄是理解行星形成、轨道迁移、大气演化和族群统计的基础参数。然而，对尚未显著演化的主序星，仅靠等龄线拟合得到的年龄往往误差很大，因为这类恒星在赫罗图上的位置随年龄变化缓慢。恒星自转提供了另一条年龄诊断：主序星在磁制动作用下逐渐减速，且自转周期与恒星颜色（质量或有效温度）和年龄之间存在统计关系，这一研究范式称为陀螺年代学（gyrochronology）。其基本图像是，恒星年轻时自转较快，随着年龄增长角动量被星风带走，自转周期 $P_{\mathrm{rot}}$ 增大；因此，若测得 $P_{\mathrm{rot}}$、颜色和质量，并用开放星团等样本标定自转演化轨迹，就可反推年龄。现代模型常区分辐射核心与对流包层，即所谓双区（two-zone）自转演化模型，以描述内部角动量输运和包层磁制动。对近距离 sub-Neptune 这类半径约 1–4 $R_{\oplus}$ 的小行星而言，其半径分布中存在位于约 1.5–2 $R_{\oplus}$ 的“半径谷”（radius valley），通常与大气逃逸、光致蒸发或核心供能的质量损失有关；要检验这些机制并追踪族群随时间的演化，需要大量宿主星具有均匀、精确的年龄。
contribution: 本文是该系列的第一篇，目标是利用宿主星的均匀年龄追踪 sub-Neptune 族群的演化。作者汇编了 4639 颗已确认系外行星宿主星的自转周期与恒星参数，并采用双区自转演化模型和贝叶斯方法推断陀螺年代学年龄；该方法将自转周期、去红化的 Gaia（BP-RP）颜色以及文献恒星质量作为高斯先验联合起来，并把自转轨迹外推到终端主序（terminal-age main sequence），超出经验标定范围。最终，**研究获得 2204 颗宿主星的陀螺年代学约束**，其中约束良好的年龄典型形式误差约为 **10–15%**，明显优于未演化恒星通常可由等龄线拟合达到的精度。反演得到的恒星质量与文献先验一致，模型有效温度也与独立测量相符；不过，超出开放星团标定范围的年龄仍然依赖模型。由此得到的均匀年龄目录为研究 sub-Neptune 族群演化及半径谷的出现提供了年龄框架，恒星参数、数据来源和陀螺年代学结果已通过 CDS 公开。
summary:
Stellar age is fundamental for reconstructing planetary-system evolution but remains difficult to determine for unevolved main-sequence stars. Stellar rotation provides a sensitive age diagnostic and a temporal framework for investigating the evolution of close-in planets. This is the first paper in a series aimed at tracing the evolution of the sub-Neptune population through homogeneous ages of their host stars.
  We compiled rotation periods and stellar parameters for 4639 confirmed exoplanet hosts. Gyrochronological ages were inferred using a two-zone rotational evolution model and a Bayesian approach combining rotation periods, dereddened Gaia (BP-RP) colours, and literature stellar masses as Gaussian priors. Rotational tracks were extended to the terminal-age main sequence, beyond the empirical calibration range.
  We obtain gyrochronological constraints for 2204 host stars. Well-constrained ages have typical formal uncertainties of 10--15%, offering substantially greater precision than is generally achievable through isochrone fitting for unevolved stars. Inferred stellar masses agree with the literature priors, while model effective temperatures are consistent with independent determinations. Ages beyond the open-cluster calibration range remain model-dependent.
  The resulting homogeneous catalogue provides the age framework for investigating the evolution of sub-Neptune populations and the emergence of the radius valley. Stellar parameters, provenance, and gyrochronological results are publicly available through CDS.

title: A multiprobe $Λ$CDM consistency analysis with gravitational-wave standard sirens
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 ΛCDM 模型为基准：宇宙由辐射、重子物质、冷暗物质和暗能量组成，后两者分别主导结构形成与加速膨胀。模型的核心参数包括物质密度参数 $\Omega_m$、哈勃常数 $H_0$ 和物质涨落幅度参数 $S_8 = \sigma_8 (\Omega_m/0.3)^{0.5}$。不同观测探针测量这些参数时会出现两类著名张力：一是本地距离阶梯测得的 $H_0$ 与宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）推断值之间的 $H_0$ 张力；二是弱引力透镜测得的 $S_8$ 与 CMB 推断值之间的 $S_8$ 差异。检验这些张力需要在统一先验和一致模型下联合多探针。CMB 提供早期宇宙声学尺度与复合时期信息；重子声学振荡（BAO）和 Ia 型超新星（SNe Ia）测量膨胀历史；弱透镜与星系成团联合的 $3\times2\mathrm{pt}$ 分析测量低红移结构增长；引力波标准汽笛（standard sirens）则由致密双星并合的波形给出光度距离，并通过电磁对应体或宿主星系统计获得红移，从而独立测量 $H_0$ 和几何膨胀。多探针联合分析通常借助似然或后验密度估计（如 normalizing flows）来一致地组合各数据集，并评估 ΛCDM 的自洽性。
contribution: 论文在 GWTC-5.0 的 LVK 引力波标准汽笛基础上，首次把标准汽笛纳入多探针 ΛCDM 一致性检验：将 DES Year 6 弱透镜与星系成团 $3\times2\mathrm{pt}$、BAO、SNe Ia、DESI BAO 以及 Planck、ACT、SPT 的 CMB 主测量在统一先验下分析，并用 normalizing flows 联合各探针，量化相对 CMB 的 $S_8$ 差异与 $H_0$ 张力。**在 $3\times2\mathrm{pt}$ 分析中加入标准汽笛，使 $\Omega_m$-$S_8$ 平面的约束改善约 30%，并把 $H_0$ 约束到 6.2%**。包含标准汽笛的低红移探针联合给出 $S_8 = 0.793 \pm 0.010$、$\Omega_m = 0.308^{+0.007}_{-0.006}$ 和 $H_0 = 69.4^{+4.1}_{-4.4}$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$。**但在当前引力波灵敏度下，$S_8$ 差异和 $H_0$ 张力基本保持不变**。该工作仍给出了首个把标准汽笛作为探针之一计算 ΛCDM 张力的评估，**并确立标准汽笛为成熟宇宙学探针，可在 LSST、Euclid 和 Roman 等未来巡天中与成熟数据集平等联合**。
summary: Multi-messenger cosmology offers an independent path to stress-test the $Λ$CDM model as gravitational wave (GW) catalogs grow in size. We present the first multiprobe assessment of $Λ$CDM tensions incorporating GW standard sirens: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (LVK) fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC-5.0) standard sirens are combined with Dark Energy Survey (DES) Year 6 weak lensing and galaxy clustering (3$\times$2pt), baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO), and type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia), together with Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) BAO, and confronted with primary cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements from Planck, the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT), and the South Pole Telescope (SPT). All probes are analyzed under homogeneous priors and combined via normalizing flows, and we quantify the $S_8$ discrepancy and $H_0$ tension with respect to CMB. Adding standard sirens to the 3$\times$2pt analysis improves the constraints in the $Ω_m$-$S_8$ plane by $\sim$30%, while constraining $H_0$ to 6.2%. We present cosmological constraints from the low-redshift probes including standard sirens, yielding $S_8 = 0.793 \pm 0.010$, $Ω_m = 0.308^{+0.007}_{-0.006}$, and $H_0 = 69.4^{+4.1}_{-4.4}$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$. At current GW sensitivity, however, both the $S_8$ discrepancy and the $H_0$ tension remain essentially unchanged. Our analysis nonetheless delivers the first assessment of $Λ$CDM tensions computed with standard sirens included among the probes, and establishes them as a mature cosmological probe -- ready to be combined on equal footing with established datasets in forthcoming surveys such as the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), Euclid, and Roman.

title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
background_knowledge: 三维磁流体力学（MHD）湍流描述导电流体或等离子体中速度场与磁场的非线性耦合，是星际介质、恒星形成区、吸积盘、星系团等离子体以及聚变等离子体中的基本过程。其核心图像是能量从大尺度注入，经非线性相互作用向小尺度级联，并在电阻耗散尺度转化为热能；磁场还会引入各向异性、阿尔芬波和电流片等结构。研究此类湍流通常依赖三维高分辨率数值模拟，但直接数值模拟在高雷诺数下计算代价极高，且需要同时分辨大尺度涡旋与小尺度耗散过程。近年来，机器学习代理模型通过学习数值模拟的时间演化，尝试以更低成本复现湍流统计与结构；其中自回归滚动预测的稳定性、对能谱和间歇性结构的保持，以及在公开基准上的泛化能力是关键评价指标。
contribution: 论文据作者所知首次给出三维电阻性 MHD 湍流的学习型代理模型，并系统比较卷积 UNet、移位窗口 transformer 与 Fourier 神经算子三种骨干网络。模型在分辨率 $128^3$、雷诺数 $1000$、$3000$ 和 $6000$ 的衰减 MHD 湍流上训练，每个雷诺数使用 $500$ 组模拟；训练采用两阶段流程，先做单步预测，再进行短程 rollout，并由统一规则停止。**在约一个大型涡旋周转时间的窗口内，UNet 与 transformer 达到 $0.018$ 至 $0.053$ 的相对速度误差，并保持电流片、拟能、电流密度和能谱等关键结构；二者精度随雷诺数变化，UNet 在 $3000$ 和 $6000$ 领先，transformer 在 $1000$ 领先。**在公开基准上，同一骨干与训练流程在 FactFormer 的各向同性湍流数据集上取得目前报道的最低误差，较最佳已发表模型低 $39\%$；在 The Well 的可压缩 MHD 数据集上，其 rollout 误差比 The Well 最佳基线低三分之一至一半。**模型还在 rollout 窗口内匹配 $1.3$ B 参数的预训练基础模型，而参数量少 $20$ 至 $62$ 倍。**作者将公开代码、各模型配置、评估脚本以及带每次模拟随机种子的数据生成器。
summary: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence, the flow of astrophysical and fusion plasmas, is costly to simulate. We present, to our knowledge, the first learned surrogates of three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, and compare three standard backbones in that role: a convolutional UNet, a shifted-window transformer and a Fourier neural operator. They are trained as autoregressive emulators of decaying MHD turbulence at a resolution of $128^3$ and Reynolds numbers of 1000, 3000 and 6000, on 500 simulations per Reynolds number, each with one two-stage procedure, single steps and then short rollouts, and stopped by one rule. Over a window of about one large-eddy turnover time, the UNet and the transformer reach relative velocity errors of 0.018 to 0.053 and keep the current sheets, the enstrophy, the current density and the energy spectra of the simulation; which of the two is the more accurate depends on the Reynolds number, the UNet leading at 3000 and 6000 and the transformer at 1000. Applied with the same backbones and training procedure to two public benchmarks, the models reach the lowest error reported to date on the isotropic turbulence set of FactFormer, 39% below the best published model. On the compressible MHD set of The Well, their rollout errors are a third to a half below those of the best of The Well's baselines. They also match a 1.3 B-parameter pretrained foundation model in its rollout windows, with 20-62 times fewer parameters. The code, the configuration of every model, the evaluation scripts and the data generator with the seed of every simulation will be released upon publication.

title: Witnessing pre-processing at intermediate redshift: observational evidence of infalling groups onto a merging galaxy cluster
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大质量的引力束缚系统。在等级结构形成框架下，星系团通过并合以及从周围吸积星系群和单个星系而增长。观测表明，随着局域密度升高，淬灭星系比例增加、恒星形成活动下降；除星系团内介质剥离气体、潮汐作用、冲压剥离和高速碰撞等团内过程外，星系在进入星系团前所属星系群中也可能经历相互作用、潮汐扰动和气体耗散，这一前置处理（pre-processing）可在吸积前改变星系形态、气体运动学和恒星形成。研究此类问题常结合积分视场光谱、空间分辨成像、相空间分析和宇宙学模拟，以区分群尺度相互作用、并合触发星暴与星系团尺度环境效应。恒星形成主序及 [O II] 发射线运动学是判断星系是否受扰动、是否处于星暴状态的重要观测量。
contribution: 论文结合 MUSE 积分视场光谱与 HST 成像，研究 $z=0.579$ 的并合星系团 SPT-CL J0307-6225 中五个高速运动星系；这些星系分布在两个候选吸积群中。作者利用 [O II] 运动学图、光谱分类和 SFR，并借助 Magneticum 模拟与相空间信息，判断这些星系是否属于两个群以及是否将被星系团吸积。Group 1 是形态受扰动的相互作用对，与星系团束缚，其中至少一个星系被分类为尘埃星暴。Group 2 是距星系团约 $4\sigma_v$ 的致密三重星系，其中两个星系共享 [O II] 包层，主导成员为 e(b) 型星暴，并表现出升高的电离气体速度弥散。两个星暴星系的 SFR 均落在场星系恒星形成主序的弥散范围内，符合相互作用触发的适度星暴预期。在 Magneticum 模拟中，处于 Group 2 相空间位置的紧密星系对约占可比质量星系团星系的 1%，因此该群仍有可能处于束缚状态。两组均显示空间分辨的星系—星系相互作用迹象，并伴随正在进行的恒星形成，**这支持并合星系团环境中的前置处理场景**；此类群尺度相互作用可能贡献于并合星系团中观测到的恒星形成增强。
summary: The fraction of quenched galaxies increases with local density, and part of this trend is thought to arise in groups before cluster accretion (pre-processing). In merging clusters, this is difficult to separate from star formation triggered or suppressed by the cluster merger itself. We investigate whether five high-velocity galaxies in the merging cluster SPT-CL~J0307-6225 ($z=0.579$), distributed in two candidate infalling groups, show signs of group-scale environmental processing prior to accretion. We combine MUSE integral-field spectroscopy and HST imaging to derive [\ion{O}{ii}] kinematic maps, spectral classes, and star-formation rates (SFR), to understand the properties of the galaxies. We further use the Magneticum simulations and the phase-space information to determine if these galaxies are part of two groups, and if they will be accreted onto the merging cluster. Group~1 is a morphologically disturbed interacting pair bound to the cluster, with at least one galaxy classified as dusty starburst. Group~2 is a compact triplet at $\sim$4$σ_v$ from the cluster, in which two galaxies share a common [\ion{O}{ii}] envelope and the dominant member, an e(b) starburst, shows an elevated ionised-gas velocity dispersion. The SFR of both starburst galaxies lie within the scatter of the field star-forming main sequence, as expected for modest, interaction-triggered bursts. Close pairs at the phase-space position of group~2 occur for $\sim$1\% of comparable-mass cluster galaxies in Magneticum, so it is not unlikely for the group to be bound. Both groups show spatially resolved signatures of galaxy--galaxy interactions alongside ongoing star formation, supporting a pre-processing scenario in the environment of a merging cluster. Such group-scale interactions may contribute to the enhanced star formation reported in merging clusters.

title: Molecular gas in the disks and tails of ram pressure stripped Coma galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最致密的星系环境之一，其中弥漫着温度约 $10^7$–$10^8\,{\rm K}$ 的热星系团内介质（intracluster medium，ICM）。星系以数百至上千 $\rm km\,s^{-1}$ 的速度穿过 ICM 时，会受到正比于 $\rho_{\rm ICM} v^2$ 的冲压。当冲压超过星系盘对气体的引力恢复力时，冷气体可被剥离，并在星系后方形成延展的气体尾，这一过程称为冲压剥离（ram pressure stripping），是星系团中星系失去冷气体、恒星形成被抑制的重要环境机制。冷气体（原子氢 ${\rm H\,I}$ 与分子氢 ${\rm H}_2$）是恒星形成的原料；其中 ${\rm H}_2$ 主要通过 CO 转动跃迁谱线示踪，${\rm H\,I}$ 则由 21 cm 超精细结构线观测。分子云形成需要足够的柱密度、金属丰度和尘埃遮蔽，使 ${\rm H\,I}$ 在尘埃表面复合为 ${\rm H}_2$，因此原子—分子相变会随周围压力、辐射场和星系质量而变化。场星系中，分子气体质量、分子气体—恒星质量比、总气体比例等与恒星质量、恒星形成率之间存在较紧的标度关系，这些关系为识别环境效应提供了参照。研究范式通常把星系团星系与场星系作对照，利用 ${\rm H\,I}$、CO、${\rm H}\alpha$ 和光学成像测量气体含量、恒星形成与气体尾形态，再结合流体模拟理解剥离、压缩和混合过程。在星系团中，观测常发现 ${\rm H\,I}$ 缺失、气体盘截断、单侧尾和恒星形成降低，表明环境过程在起作用；但被剥离气体能否保持分子相、分子气体是否会在尾中形成、以及它与电离气体和恒星形成的关系，仍是理解星系团星系演化的重要问题。
contribution: 作者利用 IRAM 30 m 望远镜对后发座星系团（Coma cluster）中五个正在经历冲压剥离的星系开展 CO(1-0) 与 CO(2-1) 观测，在四个星系中探测到分子气体，并在三个星系的剥离尾中清晰探测到 CO 发射，尾中分子气体可延伸至距恒星盘约 50 kpc。尾内分子气体质量约为几 $\times 10^8\,M_\odot$，最多可达母星系盘中剩余分子气体质量的 10%–20%。与场星系标度关系相比，若干星系尽管 ${\rm H\,I}$ 缺失，仍表现出升高的分子气体—恒星质量比；这种增强在样本较低质量端依然存在，即使处于大质量的 Coma 星系团环境中，**这与冲压导致的原子气体压缩以及盘中 ${\rm H\,I}$ 向 ${\rm H}_2$ 转化增强相一致**。同时，若把尾中分子气体计入，多数星系的总气体比例仍接近具有相近恒星质量的场星系，**说明气体移除与相变在同时发生**。作者进一步比较剥离区中的 CO 与 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 发射，以研究分子气体与电离气体的关系。CO 更倾向于在 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 明亮区被探测到，但与以往研究相比散布增大，**暗示尾中既存在恒星形成中的 CO 成分，也存在弥散的 CO 成分**。总体而言，**冲压剥离在致密环境中具有双重作用：既高效移除星系气体，又在盘中和剥离物质中促进分子气体形成，从而塑造星系团星系的短时标恒星形成**。
summary: We present new IRAM 30 m observations of CO(1-0) and CO(2-1) emission in five Coma cluster galaxies undergoing ram pressure stripping. Molecular gas is detected in four galaxies, and CO emission is clearly detected in the stripped tails of three, extending up to $\sim50$ kpc from the stellar disks. The molecular gas masses in the tails range from a few $\times10^8\,M_\odot$ and account for up to 10-20% of the molecular gas remaining in the parent disks. Compared with field scaling relations, several galaxies exhibit elevated molecular-to-stellar gas ratios despite being H I deficient. This enhancement persists toward the lower-mass end of our sample, even in the massive Coma cluster environment, consistent with ram-pressure-induced compression of atomic gas and enhanced H I-to-H$_2$ conversion in the disks. At the same time, the total gas fractions of most galaxies remain close to those of field galaxies with similar stellar masses when the molecular gas in the tails is included, indicating that gas removal and phase transformation act simultaneously. We further investigate the relation between molecular and ionized gas by comparing CO and H$α$ emission in the stripped regions. Although CO is preferentially detected in H$α$-bright regions, the increased scatter compared with previous studies suggests the presence of both star-forming and diffuse CO components in the tails. Our results highlight the dual role of ram pressure stripping in dense environments: it efficiently removes gas from galaxies while also promoting molecular gas formation in both the disks and stripped material, thereby shaping short-term star formation in cluster galaxies.

title: Are habitable-zone TESS Objects of Interest really there? Period resolution from the full archive
background_knowledge: 系外行星的凌星法通过测量恒星亮度周期性下降来推断行星存在，并由相邻凌星的时间间隔确定轨道周期 $P$；周期又决定行星接收的恒星辐射，从而影响其是否位于宜居带（HZ）。对只观测到一次凌星、或仅两次凌星且间隔很长的候选体，周期往往无法唯一确定，目录中可能出现 $P=0$ 或以两次事件间隔作为周期的情形。真实周期可能存在多个混叠（alias）：不同试探周期都能把部分凌星折叠到同一相位附近，尤其当观测存在季节间隙、数据边缘、仪器系统误差或其他行星污染时。TESS 以分段观测和全天巡天提供大量光变曲线，TOI 目录汇总候选行星，但长周期、单次/双次凌星候选的周期与宜居带标签需要利用全档案数据重新检验。研究范式通常包括：对候选周期做相位折叠与凌星似然评估，比较不同 alias 的拟合优度，检查凌星持续时间是否自洽，进行注入-恢复测试以量化完备度与错误率，并用贝叶斯或边际化方法给出周期和宜居带概率。保守宜居带通常指在恒星演化过程中较长时间可维持液态水的轨道范围，因此周期错误会直接导致宜居带判断错误。
contribution: 论文重新分析了截至 Sector 107 的全部公开 TESS 数据中 187 个目录周期为 $P=0$ 或 $P \geq 200$ d 的 TOI，采用基于光变通量的方法，将每个周期混叠按逐观测段的凌星似然、凌星持续时间和几何先验加权，并检验相位相干性、数据边缘、其他行星污染和仪器伪影。该方法盲复原了 12 个已发表周期；在注入-恢复测试中，对于由新凌星约束的周期，恢复率为 71%，且未给出错误周期。研究共分辨 28 个周期，并通过排除法修正另外 8 个周期。核心结论是：**多数被目录周期判据放入保守宜居带的双凌星 TOI 实际上并不在宜居带**——在 28 个此类候选体中，预期约 2 个真正位于宜居带且二者均为巨行星，12 个行星大小候选无一如此，已分辨者多为更热行星的周期混叠。反过来，真正宜居带行星也可能因周期缺失或错误而被隐藏：作者复现了 3 个已发表的 M 矮星例子，并验证了 4 颗具有新周期的行星，包括 **TOI-2298 b：半径 3.0 倍地球半径的亚海王星，周期 146.58 d，位于 K 矮星的保守宜居带**，以及 **TOI-6075 b：半径 1.7 倍地球半径，周期 416.5 d（833 d 未被排除），是第二颗被验证的、半径小于 2 倍地球半径且 $P > 1$ yr 的凌星行星**。论文发布了全样本经混叠边际化的宜居带概率。
summary: TESS Objects of Interest (TOIs) seen as single or duo transits carry a catalogue period that is undefined or equal to the separation of the two events, and their insolation and any habitable-zone label inherit it. We reanalyse all 187 TOIs catalogued with P = 0 or P >= 200 d using all public TESS data through Sector 107, with a flux-based method that weights each alias by per-epoch transit likelihoods, the transit duration and a geometric prior, and tests for coherence, data edges, contamination by other planets and instrumental artefacts. It recovers 12 published periods blindly and, in injection-recovery tests, 71 per cent of periods constrained by a new transit, with no wrong period. It resolves 28 periods and fixes 8 more by exclusion. Are habitable-zone TOIs really there? Mostly not: of the 28 duo-transits that a catalogue-period criterion places in the conservative habitable zone, about two are expected to lie there, both giants, and none of the 12 planet-sized ones; those resolved are aliases of hotter planets. Conversely, habitable-zone planets hide behind missing or wrong periods: we recover three published M-dwarf examples and validate four planets with new periods, including TOI-2298 b, a 3.0 Earth-radius sub-Neptune at 146.58 d in the conservative habitable zone of a K dwarf, and TOI-6075 b, a 1.7 Earth-radius planet at 416.5 d (833 d not excluded), the second validated transiting planet smaller than 2 Earth radii with P > 1 yr. We release alias-marginalised habitable-zone probabilities for the whole sample.

title: Recovering Missing Degrees of Freedom in Simulation-Trained Field-Level Generative Models
background_knowledge: 弱引力透镜是背景星系图像被前景大尺度结构引力场剪切的现象，其剪切场直接编码暗物质与宇宙学参数的投影分布。传统分析常将信息压缩为两点相关函数或功率谱，而场级推断（field-level inference）试图直接利用整张剪切场，从而保留非线性、非高斯与高阶关联信息。在强非线性尺度上，解析似然不可得，研究范式转向基于 $N$ 体模拟的仿真推断：先用大量模拟训练生成模型，例如连续归一化流（continuous normalizing flow, CNF），通过神经常微分方程定义从简单潜变量到宇宙学场的可逆映射并学习其分布，再在观测场上进行后验采样。此类生成模型的有效性依赖训练集对真实实现级涨落的覆盖；有限模拟会导致方差收缩（variance shrinkage），即生成分布的实现间方差小于物理过程本身的方差。该现象可提示模型缺少有效自由度，并影响场级推断的校准与对分布外偏移的稳健性。
contribution: 论文把方差收缩解释为仿真训练生成模型中**缺失有效自由度**的诊断信号，并针对连续归一化流的生成动力学引入物理启发的潜变量修正。作者表明，这些潜空间修正**无需额外训练模拟即可恢复相当一部分缺失的实现级变异性**。以弱引力透镜场级推断为代表性宇宙学应用，后验分析显示学习到的潜变量方向在推断中被主动利用，并表现为**吸收训练分布与目标分布部分失配的有效冗余参数**；因此模型对场级推断中的分布外偏移表现出**更好的稳健性**。该工作确立了方差收缩作为识别缺失自由度的实用诊断，并提供了通过物理启发式修改生成动力学来恢复这些自由度的框架。
summary: Simulation-trained generative models are emerging as a powerful framework for field-level inference in cosmology, particularly in strongly nonlinear regimes where analytical approaches become intractable. However, the finite size of training datasets often leads to variance shrinkage, indicating that part of the realization-level variability of the underlying physical process is not captured by the learned generative dynamics. In this Letter, we interpret variance shrinkage as a diagnostic of missing effective degrees of freedom and introduce physics-informed latent modifications to the generative dynamics of a continuous normalizing flow. We show that these latent corrections recover a substantial fraction of the missing variability without requiring additional training simulations. Using weak-lensing field-level inference as a representative cosmological application, we further demonstrate through posterior analysis that the learned latent directions are actively exploited during inference and behave as effective nuisance parameters that absorb part of the mismatch between the training and target distributions. As a result, the model exhibits improved robustness to out-of-distribution shifts in field-level inference. Our work establishes variance shrinkage as a practical diagnostic for identifying missing degrees of freedom in simulation-trained generative models and provides a framework for recovering them through physics-informed modifications of generative dynamics.

title: Modeling CO Line Luminosity with FIRE simulations: II. Comparison With Observations, CO Luminosity Functions and Redshift Evolution
background_knowledge: 星际介质中的冷分子气体是恒星形成的原料，而 CO 分子的转动跃迁是观测冷分子气体最常用的示踪剂之一。CO(1-0) 与 CO(2-1) 的谱线光度 $L_{\mathrm{CO}}$ 可通过转换因子 $X_{\mathrm{CO}}$（或 $\alpha_{\mathrm{CO}}$）与分子气体质量 $M_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}$ 相联系，但该转换依赖于金属丰度、气体密度、辐射场与尘埃遮蔽；在低金属丰度环境中，尘埃少、远紫外辐射强，CO 易被光致离解，因而单位分子气体质量对应的 CO 光度偏低。星系形成与反馈过程决定气体的分布、金属丰度及恒星形成率（SFR），这些量又共同影响 CO 的激发与出射。为从宇宙学模拟预测 CO 线光度，通常需在模拟星系上做尘埃辐射转移和谱线激发/发射计算，例如 SKIRT 与 CLOUDY。观测方面，CO 光度函数以及 $L_{\mathrm{CO}}$ 与 SFR、金属丰度、恒星质量的经验关系，是检验星系形成模型和开展 CO 线强度映射（intensity mapping）的基础。
contribution: 作者基于 FIRE-2 模拟，选取 $z=0$、1、2、3 的 765、850、887、915 个星系，并用 SKIRT 辐射转移与 CLOUDY 谱线发射计算进行后处理，给出 CO(1-0) 和 CO(2-1) 光度的预测，并与现有观测比较。**在 $z=0$，预测能复现大质量恒星形成星系与低金属丰度矮星系中 SFR 与 CO(1-0) 光度关系的观测弥散和平均趋势，也复现 CO(1-0) 光度与金属丰度之间的超线性幂律斜率。** 在 $z=1$，CO(2-1) 预测向低光度端弥散到比观测更低的范围，作者认为这很可能反映了现有巡天灵敏度的限制。**在固定 SFR 时，CO(1-0) 光度随单位红移增加约下降一个量级；该下降很可能由金属丰度随红移降低所驱动，因为 FIRE-2 中具有相近 SFR 与金属丰度的星系在不同红移下给出相似的 CO(1-0) 光度。** 相对地，**在固定恒星质量时，预测光度不显示红移依赖**。这些结果表明，在观测星系被稳健探测的参数区间，FIRE-2 预测能再现 CO(1-0) 光度与星系性质之间的标度关系，从而增强了对无观测数据区间预测的信心，并说明这些光度预测可用于构建 CO 线强度映射实验的预测模型。
summary: We present predictions for the CO(1-0) and CO(2-1) luminosities of 765, 850, 887 and 915 galaxies at z=0, 1, 2 and 3, respectively, drawn from the Feedback in Realistic Environments (FIRE-2) simulations and post-processed with SKIRT radiative transfer and CLOUDY line emission calculations. We compare our CO line luminosity predictions with existing observations. At z=0, our predictions reproduce the observed scatter and mean relation between star formation rate (SFR) and CO(1-0) luminosity for both massive star-forming galaxies and low-metallicity dwarf galaxies. We also reproduce the observed superlinear power-law slope between CO(1-0) luminosity and metallicity. At z=1, our CO(2-1) predictions scatter to much lower luminosities than observed, which likely reflects the limited sensitivity of current surveys. At fixed SFR, our CO(1-0) luminosities decrease by roughly an order of magnitude per unit increase in redshift. This decline is likely driven by the decrease in metallicity with increasing redshift, since FIRE-2 galaxies with comparable SFR and metallicity produce similar CO(1-0) luminosities regardless of redshift. At fixed stellar mass, the predicted luminosities show no redshift dependence. These results show that our FIRE-2 predictions reproduce the observed scaling relations between CO(1-0) luminosity and galaxy properties wherever the observed galaxies are robustly detected. This gives us confidence in our predictions for the regime where no observational data exist, and suggests that our luminosity predictions can be used to build predictive models for CO line intensity mapping experiments.

title: A VLT/CRIRES+ study of helium 1.083$μ$m absorption features towards the inner Orion Nebula
background_knowledge: 猎户座星云是邻近的大质量恒星形成区，也是典型的 blister HII 区：电离气体从分子云面向观测者的一侧膨胀，在远侧靠近分子云处形成致密而明亮的电离层，并伴随团块、球状体、原行星盘状天体（proplyds）和星风等小尺度结构。氦的 $1.083\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 三重线是 H II 区中重要的复合线，其辐射强度与电离氦丰度、气体密度、速度结构及辐射转移过程密切相关。JWST 近红外窄带成像能够揭示该谱线造成的暗特征，但要判断其究竟来自吸收、发射受抑还是其他效应，需要高分辨率光谱观测来检验谱线轮廓。
contribution: 论文针对 JWST NIRCam F115W 在猎户座星云内部发现的多类此前未知暗特征，使用 VLT/CRIRES+ 对多个暗目标开展高分辨率光谱观测，**确认这些暗特征由氦 $1.083\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 三重线通量降低所致，且该降低在谱线轮廓上相当均匀**。结合一个简单辐射转移模型，作者表明：猎户座星云作为 blister HII 区，在远侧靠近 Orion A 分子云处具有致密明亮电离层；当该致密层发出的氦线辐射被位于其近侧的中间密度氦气体——例如团块、球状体或 proplyds 等天体产生的星风——吸收时，便形成观测到的暗特征。
summary: JWST NIRCam F115W observations towards the inner Orion Nebula revealed a diverse array of previously unknown dark features. The most likely cause was absorption or suppressed emission of the helium 1.083$μ$m triplet which lies in that filter. We have obtained VLT/CRIRES+ high-resolution spectrographic observations over a selection of different dark targets, confirming that the features are indeed explained by a reduction in the flux of the helium 1.083$μ$m triplet, a reduction that is fairly uniform across the line. The Orion Nebula is a blister HII region, with a dense, bright ionised layer on the far side from the observer near the Orion A molecular cloud and lower density gas elsewhere. Using a simple radiative transfer model, we show that dark features arise when emission from the dense layer is absorbed by intermediate density helium (e.g. in clumps, globules, or winds from objects like proplyds) on the near side of the dense layer.

title: Contrastive Astromer: Two-Stage Contrastive Representation Learning for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
background_knowledge: 时域天文学通过测量天体亮度随时间的变化（光变曲线 $F(t)$ 或星等 $m(t)$）来研究变星、食双星、微引力透镜、活动星系核等。大型巡天（如 MACHO、OGLE、ZTF、LSST）产生海量光变曲线，但人工标注成本高，可靠类别标签稀缺且类别分布不平衡。传统方法常依赖周期、振幅、颜色等特征工程；深度学习可直接从不等间隔、带噪声和缺失的序列中学习表示。自监督预训练（如掩码重建）能利用无标签数据学习通用表示，但重建目标主要保留重建所需信息，未必形成利于类别分离的紧凑嵌入。对比学习通过拉近同一对象不同增强视图、推远不同样本的表示来塑造嵌入空间；有监督对比学习进一步利用标签增强类内一致性与类间分离。冻结编码器后训练简单分类器，是评估表示质量的常用范式。
contribution: 论文提出 Contrastive Astromer，一种两阶段对比表示学习方法，不改变 ASTROMER 2 编码器结构。第一阶段在单波段 MACHO 光变曲线上进行无监督对比学习，使同一目标不同增强视图的表示相互靠近；第二阶段利用另一组带标签的 Alcock 样本进行有监督对比学习，并辅以辅助分类损失，以增强类别判别能力。评估时冻结编码器并单独训练分类器：在 600 个目标的留出集上，每类 500 个带标签样本时 macro-F1 达 0.7943，比复现的 ASTROMER 2 微调-分类流程高 5.10 个百分点；每类仅 20 和 100 个样本时，macro-F1 分别为 0.7078 和 0.7704，同样优于该基线。嵌入空间分析表明，有监督适配提升了局部类别一致性与全局类别分离。**结果表明，对比式适配能使预训练光变曲线表示更适合分类，并更充分地反映变光类别的结构。**
summary: Large astronomical surveys collect abundant light curves, but reliable class labels remain scarce. ASTROMER 2 learns from unlabeled light curves by reconstructing masked observations, yet this objective does not explicitly encourage class separation in a compact representation of each light curve. We introduce Contrastive Astromer, a two-stage approach that makes these representations more useful for classification without changing the ASTROMER 2 encoder architecture. First, unsupervised contrastive learning on single-band MACHO light curves brings together representations of augmented views of the same object. Supervised contrastive learning, supported by an auxiliary classification loss, then uses a separate labeled Alcock sample to strengthen class discrimination. We evaluate the resulting representations by freezing the encoder and training a separate classifier. On a held-out set of 600 objects, this classifier achieves a macro-F1 of 0.7943 with 500 labeled examples per class, exceeding our reproduction of the ASTROMER 2 finetune-and-classify pipeline by 5.10 percentage points. With downstream classifier training budgets of 20 and 100 examples per class, macro-F1 reaches 0.7078 and 0.7704, respectively, also surpassing this baseline. Embedding-space analyses further show that supervised adaptation improves local class consistency and global class separation. These results show that contrastive adaptation makes pretrained light-curve representations more effective for classification and more informative about the structure of variability classes.

title: Characterisation Methodology for Persistence and Anti-persistence in IR Detectors for the Euclid and SVOM Space Missions
background_knowledge: 该方向属于空间红外探测器物理与定标（instrumentation/calibration），服务于 Euclid 这类高精度宇宙学任务和 SVOM 这类伽马射线暴及瞬变源观测任务。红外焦平面阵列通过半导体像素将光子转换为电荷，并以多次非破坏性读出形成 ramp 来估计入射通量；理想情况下，信号 $S(t)$ 随积分时间线性增长。但真实探测器存在电荷陷阱、读出噪声、暗电流和非线性响应等效应。持续效应（persistence）指像素曝光后，陷阱中电荷在后续帧缓慢释放，形成残余信号；反持续效应（anti-persistence）则表现为后续读出响应被压低或出现异常时间行为。二者可同时发生，导致通量测量偏差、测光系统误差，甚至产生虚假探测。对高精度测光而言，必须建立可预测、可校正的探测器响应模型，而地面表征数据是构建在轨校正模型的关键基础。
contribution: 论文提出并验证了一套适用于 Euclid 与 SVOM 所用 H2RG、ALFA 红外探测器的持续效应与反持续效应通用表征方法：利用差分 ramp 分离像素响应的时间演化，结合 Savitzky--Golay 滤波抑制噪声并保留趋势，再施加非线性校正，从而更可靠地提取残余信号。将该方法用于地面表征数据后，**揭示出探测器响应的空间不均匀性、对注量、通量、温度与波长的环境依赖，并在 ALFA 中发现意外的光谱效应**。这些初步结果**验证了方法的有效性**，并为发展能满足任务精度要求的在轨校正模型奠定基础。
summary: H2RG and ALFA are the infrared detectors used in the Euclid and SVOM space missions. These types of detectors may be affected by persistence and anti-persistence, phenomena that distort pixel responses after exposure to light due to simultaneous trapping and release of charges within the pixel. These phenomena have shown to cause biases in flux measurements and potentially false detections, among other effects. This article presents a universal methodology for characterising persistence and anti-persistence using differential ramps, Savitzky--Golay filtering, and non-linearity correction. When applied to ground characterisation data, this approach reveals spatial inhomogeneities, environmental dependencies (in particular fluence, flux, temperature and wavelength), and unexpected spectral effects in ALFA. These preliminary results validate the method and pave the way for in-flight correction models capable of meeting the missions' accuracy requirements.

title: Two Fast Radio Burst Candidates Detected in the RATAN-600 Blind Survey
background_knowledge: 快速射电暴（FRB）是持续时间仅毫秒量级的射电脉冲，具有极高的亮温度和极大的能量释放，通常发生在宇宙学距离上。其核心观测量是色散量（DM）：不同频率的电磁波在电离介质中传播速度不同，到达时间产生频率依赖延迟，DM 正比于视线方向自由电子柱密度。观测到的 DM 包含银河系、星系际介质（IGM）和宿主星系等贡献；扣除银河系贡献后，常利用 IGM 的近似关系由 DM 估计红移。FRB 的物理起源仍待厘清，可能与磁星等致密天体活动有关。高频射电观测可降低散射展宽和部分传播效应，并补充低频巡天样本，但灵敏度、视场和射频干扰抑制更具挑战。盲巡天中的单脉冲搜索通常结合匹配滤波、去色散和机器学习分类，以提高弱脉冲探测能力并控制虚假信号。RATAN-600 是俄罗斯的大型射电望远镜，其西扇区天线可用于米波至厘米波段的巡天观测。
contribution: 论文报告在 RATAN-600 西扇区天线的盲巡天中探测到两个单次色散脉冲，宽度分别约为 $6.7\,\mathrm{ms}$ 和 $15.6\,\mathrm{ms}$，流量密度分别约为 $0.8\,\mathrm{Jy}$ 和 $1.7\,\mathrm{Jy}$。巡天覆盖两个圆形天区（赤纬 $+22^{\circ}$ 和 $+5^{\circ}$，赤经 $0$--$24\,\mathrm{h}$），频率为 $4400$--$5000\,\mathrm{MHz}$，使用四个 4 通道滤波辐射计（中心频率 $4475$、$4625$、$4775$、$4925\,\mathrm{MHz}$，总带宽 $600\,\mathrm{MHz}$）；西扇区天线在 $2017$--$2025$ 年的有效面积约为 $1200\,\mathrm{m}^2$，巡天总面积约 $1500$ 平方度，每个指向持续一年。两个事件分别发生于 MJD $58614.38257$ 和 MJD $58659.62482$，估计色散量为 $200\pm20$ 和 $266\pm10\,\mathrm{pc}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-3}$，经附加最优滤波后的最终信噪比（SNR）为 $8$--$9$。扣除银河系内估计色散后，采用星系际介质关系 $\mathrm{DM}/(\mathrm{pc}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-3}) = 1000\,z$ 估算红移约为 $0.09$ 和 $0.13$，相应各向同性能量约为 $10^{40}\,\mathrm{erg}$ 和 $2\times10^{40}\,\mathrm{erg}$。为有效探测单脉冲，作者使用了基于合成 FRB 脉冲轮廓训练的神经网络进行机器学习搜索。**作者将这两个事件视为两个罕见的高频 FRB 候选体。**
summary:
We report the detection of two single dispersed pulses with widths of about 6.7\,ms and 15.6\,ms and flux densities of about 0.8 and 1.7\,Jy. These were found in a blind survey of two circular regions (Dec$\;=+22^{\circ}$ and $+5^{\circ}$,RA: 0--24~h) at high radio frequencies \mbox{(4400--5000\,MHz)} using four 4-channel filter radiometers (central frequencies of 4475, 4625, 4775, and 4925\,MHz)
  spanning a total frequency bandwidth of 600\,MHz. The survey was carried out with the Western Sector antenna of the RATAN-600 radio telescope, which had an effective area of 1200\,m$^2$ in~2017--2025. The total area of the survey was about 1500~square degrees, and each pointing of the antenna lasted one year. We consider these to be two rare, high-frequency FRB events (MJD~58614.38257 and MJD~58659.62482), detected with estimated dispersion measures of $200\pm20$ and $266\pm10$\,pc\,cm$^{-3}$ at a final signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) level of 8--9 after additional optimal filtration. After subtraction of the estimated dispersions within the Milky Way, we estimated redshifts of approximately 0.09 and 0.13, respectively, using the traditional equation: ${\rm DM}\,[{\rm pc~cm}^{-3}] = 1000\,z$ for the intergalactic medium. The estimated isotropic energies of the FRBs are equal to $10^{40}$\,erg and $2\times 10^{40}$\,erg, respectively. To effectively detect single pulses, we applied machine learning methods using a neural network trained on synthetic FRB pulse profiles.

title: Beyond Point Photo-$z$ Estimates: Normalizing Flows for Tomographic $N(z)$ Reconstruction with DESI DR1
background_knowledge: 弱引力透镜通过测量背景星系形状的相干畸变来重构前景物质分布，是研究宇宙大尺度结构和暗能量的重要探针。层析（tomographic）弱透镜分析需要把源星系按红移分箱，并准确知道每个红移区间的源星系红移分布 $N(z)$；$N(z)$ 的偏置会直接传播到宇宙学参数。光谱红移精度高，但观测成本大、样本较暗，而宽视场成像巡天可提供海量星系的多波段测光。photo-$z$ 利用测光信息估计红移：点估计给出单个红移用于分箱，但 $N(z)$ 重建更需要每个星系的红移后验概率密度函数（PDF）或可堆叠的分布。研究范式包括模板拟合、机器学习回归或分类，以及条件密度估计；Normalizing Flows 可学习复杂、多峰的条件分布 $p(z\mid \mathrm{photometry})$，再堆叠单个星系的 PDF 得到样本 $N(z)$。评估常用散度、离群率、平均红移偏置、Wasserstein 距离、JS 散度与概率重叠等指标；实际应用还需用带光谱红移的验证样本进行事后校准，并关注模型跨星系族群迁移时的鲁棒性。
contribution: 论文系统比较条件归一化流（conditional Normalizing Flows, NF）与随机森林（Random Forest, RF）及分位数随机森林（Quantile Random Forest, QRF）在 photo-$z$ 点估计和层析 $N(z)$ 重建中的表现。作者使用 DESI DR1 的光谱星系和类星体样本，并匹配 Legacy Surveys DR10 测光，在 $0<z_{\mathrm{spec}}<4.5$ 范围内以约 110 万源训练、在不相交天区的约 200 万源测试。点估计方面，NF 在 $0<z_{\mathrm{spec}}<1.6$ 取得最低的离散度和离群率，并在 $z_{\mathrm{spec}}>1.6$ 时于三项指标上均优于两个基线。引入 Wasserstein 距离和 JS 散度等分布级指标后，作者发现堆叠 NF 后验 PDF 能得到比 QRF 更准确的层析 $N(z)$，尤其在高红移端；当 $z_{\mathrm{median}}>2.5$ 时，NF 的平均红移绝对偏置为 $0.060\pm0.031$（QRF 为 $0.318$），概率重叠为 $0.905\pm0.008$（QRF 为 $0.787$）。作者还用留出验证样本实施随红移变化的事后 PDF 校准：校准后，$0.2<z_{\mathrm{median}}<1.0$ 的四个区间平均红移绝对偏置为 $0.0016$ 至 $0.0019$，中心值低于 $0.002(1+z)$ 的参考基准；最高红移区间的偏置进一步降至 $0.016\pm0.011$。这些结果**表明 NF 后验 PDF 在层析 $N(z)$ 重建中具有潜力**，同时**凸显了模型跨星系族群迁移时的挑战**。
summary: Accurate calibration of tomographic redshift distributions, $N(z)$ is essential for cosmological analysis of weak lensing data. We investigate conditional normalizing flows (NFs) and compare their performance with random forest (RF) and quantile random forest (QRF) models. We consider DESI galaxy and quasar targets from DESI DR1 spectroscopic data and with the photometry from Legacy Surveys DR10. We train on 1.1 million sources and test on 2.0 million sources in a non-overlapping sky region ($0<z_{\rm spec}<4.5$). For point estimation, the NF achieves the lowest scatter and outlier fraction at $0<z_{\rm spec}<1.6$ and outperforms both baselines across all three metrics at $z_{\rm spec}>1.6$. By introducing distribution-level metrics like Wasserstein distance and JS divergence, we find that stacking NF posterior PDFs provides more accurate tomographic $N(z)$ reconstruction than QRF, particularly at high redshifts. For $z_{\rm median}>2.5$, the NF achieves a smaller absolute mean-redshift bias ($0.060\pm0.031$ versus $0.318$) and higher probability overlap ($0.905\pm0.008$ versus $0.787$) than QRF. We apply redshift-dependent post-hoc PDF calibration derived from a held-out validation sample. After calibration, the absolute mean-redshift biases in four bins spanning $0.2<z_{\rm median}<1.0$ range from $0.0016$ to $0.0019$, with central values below referring benchmark $0.002(1+z)$. In the highest-redshift bin, calibration further reduces the bias to $0.016\pm0.011$. Our results demonstrate the potential of NF PDFs for tomographic $N(z)$ reconstruction while highlighting challenges in transferring models across galaxy populations.

title: GALACTIC CENTERS AS TRACERS OF GALAXY EVOLUTION: Zooming from galaxy large-scale properties into their central massive black holes
background_knowledge: 星系中心是星系引力势阱最深、恒星与气体密度最高的区域之一，通常存在核星团，并在至少部分星系中存在中心大质量黑洞（MBH）。该子领域的核心图像是：中心黑洞通过吸积气体增长并释放能量，活动星系核反馈可通过辐射、喷流和外流加热或驱散气体，从而影响恒星形成、气体循环乃至星系整体演化；与此同时，星系尺度的气体入流、棒与旋臂输运、星系并合和相互作用又为黑洞增长与核区恒星形成提供燃料。观测上的黑洞质量与核球质量、速度弥散之间的经验关系，以及核星团与黑洞共存现象，提示中心与星系存在共同演化，但其因果方向和效率仍不清楚。研究范式因此跨越宇宙学流体模拟、高分辨率星系模拟、黑洞吸积与反馈的亚网格模型，以及高分辨率光谱、成像、时域和多波段观测；关键前置问题包括 MBH 种子如何形成、黑洞如何增长、活动星系核反馈如何调节气体入流与出流，以及核星和核气体结构如何形成。
contribution: 本文是 Lorentz Center 研讨会 “Galactic Centers as tracers of galaxy evolution” 的总结，而非单一观测或模拟研究。它汇集不同研究社区，围绕星系中心区域与全局星系演化之间的联系，梳理中心大质量黑洞（MBH）、核结构、气体入流与出流以及星系—星系相互作用等连接通道；重点讨论 MBH 种子、形成与增长、活动星系核反馈和核区恒星结构形成，并概括数值模拟与前沿观测技术的现状。文中**总结研讨会亮点、提炼讨论中出现的开放问题，并提出未来观测与模拟需求**，包括利用 Extremely Large Telescope（ELT）等下一代设施的计划。核心判断是：**星系中心是连接黑洞小尺度物理与星系大尺度演化的重要示踪区域，但 MBH 种子、增长历史、反馈效应和核星结构起源仍是关键未解问题**。
summary: During the workshop ''Galactic Centers as tracers of galaxy evolution'' (Lorentz Center, Leiden), we reviewed one of the most debated questions in the field of galaxy evolution: the connection between galactic central regions and the evolution of galaxies at a global scale. We gathered different research communities to reveal the connection channels between central massive black holes (MBHs), nuclear structures, and evolutionary processes at a global scale, such as gas inflows and outflows and galaxy-galaxy interactions. Special focus was dedicated to MBH seeding, formation and growth, active galactic nuclei feedback, and the formation of nuclear stellar structures, without missing a global perspective. Participants from these different fields introduced us to the state of the art in numerical simulations, as well as cutting-edge observational techniques. In addition to achieving a deep understanding of these topics, we set up plans to exploit future facilities such as the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT). In this paper, we briefly summarize the highlights of the workshop, identify the open questions that emerged during the workshop discussions, and discuss what observations and simulations will be needed to address them.

title: Decomposition of disk and jet optical emission: Case of PKS~1510-089 and PKS~0736+017
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积供能：光学至紫外连续谱主要来自吸积盘的热辐射，而宽发射线来自被中心连续谱照耀的电离气体云，即宽线区（BLR）。混响映射（reverberation mapping）利用连续谱与发射线光变之间的时间延迟测量 BLR 半径，再结合线宽并由维里关系估计黑洞质量。对具有相对论性喷流的 AGN，尤其平谱射电类星体（FSRQ），喷流的非热同步辐射可在光学波段显著贡献甚至主导连续谱，稀释吸积盘信号，使基于连续谱的延迟和黑洞质量测量产生偏差。吸积盘热辐射与喷流同步辐射具有不同的偏振特征，因此多历元光谱、测光与偏振观测结合射电监测，可用于分解两类连续谱成分并校正混响映射结果。
contribution: 论文针对两个平谱射电类星体 PKS 0736+017 与 PKS 1510-089，利用热吸积盘与非热喷流同步辐射在偏振特征上的差异，分解它们在光学波段的连续谱发射；分析综合了档案中的多历元光学分光测光与偏振观测、早期混响映射得到的 H$\beta$ 发射线光变曲线，以及 37 GHz 射电数据。对 PKS 0736+017，作者发现吸积盘约占总光学发射的 70%（$f_d = 0.70^{+0.01}_{-0.01}$），扣除喷流成分后得到修正的 H$\beta$ 延迟为 $84.8^{+23.2}_{-18.4}$ 天。对 PKS 1510-089，吸积盘贡献较低，为 37.5%（$f_d = 0.37^{+0.01}_{-0.01}$），相应 H$\beta$ 延迟为 $54.4^{+4.4}_{-5.4}$ 天。**结果强调，对喷流主导的 AGN 必须仔细分解光学光变曲线中的盘与喷流成分，否则 BLR 尺度及黑洞质量估计可能被显著偏置。**
summary: Measuring BLR size and black hole mass of jetted quasars with strong radio emission is challenging due to the contribution from non-thermal synchrotron radiation from the jet in the optical continuum. Here, we investigate the optical continuum emission in two flat-spectrum radio quasars (FSRQs), PKS~0736+017 and PKS~1510-089, by separating the thermal emission from the accretion disk and the non-thermal synchrotron emission from the jet using their distinct polarization signatures. Our analysis combines multi-epoch optical spectro-photometric and polarimetric observations from the archival optical continuum, H$β$ emission line light curves from earlier reverberation mapping campaigns, and 37 GHz radio data. For PKS~0736+017, we find that the disk contributes approximately 70 % ($f_d = 0.70^{+0.01}_{-0.01}$) of the total optical emission. After removing the jet component, we obtain a revised H$β$ lag of $84.8^{+23.2}_{-18.4}$ days. In contrast, the disk contribution in PKS~1510-089 is lower with 37.5 % ($f_d = 0.37^{+0.01}_{-0.01}$), with a corresponding H$β$ lag of $54.4^{+4.4}_{-5.4}$ days. Our findings highlight the need for careful decomposition of optical light curves in jet-dominated AGN.

title: Mean-element Parareal: Parallel-in-Time Integration of the Solar System
background_knowledge: 太阳系长期动力学研究关注行星轨道在数百万至数十亿年尺度上的演化：行星间的引力摄动、轨道共振、广义相对论修正与混沌共同决定轨道相位和半长轴的长期变化。行星轨道近似为开普勒运动，但微小摄动会通过轨道剪切与近共振逐渐累积；在混沌系统中，数值积分任一步的截断误差或舍入误差都可能改变长程轨迹，因此传统上必须严格按时间顺序逐步推进。常用的 Wisdom-Holman 辛积分器把哈密顿量拆分为可解析求解的开普勒部分和缓慢变化的相互作用部分，能以较大步长高效积分；但每一步仍依赖上一步状态。并且现代积分器单步仅约 100 ns，短到难以直接拆分到多核，所以多核通常只用于并行运行不同初始条件或参数的集合模拟。Parareal 是一类时间并行算法：先用廉价粗传播子（coarse propagator）在整段时间上顺序给出近似，再用多个细传播子在时间片并行修正，迭代逼近细积分精度；其成败取决于粗传播子能否以低成本抓住主导动力学。平均根数理论则通过平均掉短周期项，保留长期和长周期项，为构造廉价而物理合理的粗传播子提供了途径。
contribution: 论文提出平均根数 Parareal（mean-element parareal，MEP），一种时间并行格式，**能在与串行积分器相同精度下加速包含八大行星和广义相对论效应的单次太阳系积分**。作者结合一个延迟优化的 C 内核，使 5 Gyr 积分在单核上耗时 5.8 h；MEP 在 64 核上 52 min 完成同一 5 Gyr 积分，并行加速 6.7x，并比此前 9.0 h 的单核纪录快 10.4x；在 16 核上耗时 1.8 h，并行加速 3.3x，比此前纪录快 5.0x。MEP 有效的关键在于其粗传播子采用数值一阶平均根数理论，去除半长轴中的短周期振荡，从而避免开普勒剪切将这些振荡放大为增长的相位误差。相比之下，采用粗 Wisdom-Holman 积分器的标准 Parareal 对行星轨道失败，因为尚无廉价粗积分器能分辨这些振荡。据作者所知，这是**首次实测单次长期行星积分的多核加速**，为更大规模并行化开辟了路径。
summary: Long-term integrations of planetary systems have long been considered inherently sequential: each time step must start from the exact state at the end of the previous one, because any error in that state, however small, is amplified by orbital shear and chaos and alters the trajectory. Because a single step of a modern Wisdom--Holman integrator takes only ~100 ns - too short to split across cores - additional cores have previously only been used to run multiple simulations in parallel. We introduce mean-element parareal (MEP), a parallel-in-time scheme that accelerates a single Solar System integration (eight planets, general relativity) at the same accuracy as the serial integrator. Combined with a latency-optimized C kernel that integrates 5 Gyr on one core in 5.8 h, MEP completes a 5 Gyr integration in 52 min on 64 cores (a parallel speed-up of 6.7x, and 10.4x faster than the previous 9.0 h single-core record) or in 1.8 h on 16 cores (3.3x parallel speed-up, 5.0x faster than the previous record). MEP succeeds because its coarse propagator uses a numerical first-order mean-element theory to remove the short-period oscillations from the semi-major axes, preventing Keplerian shear from amplifying them into growing phase errors. Standard parareal with a coarse Wisdom-Holman integrator fails for planetary orbits because no inexpensive coarse integrator can resolve these oscillations. To our knowledge, this is the first measured multicore speed-up of a single long-term planetary integration and opens a pathway towards larger-scale parallelization.

title: Harmonic Angular Mapping Method for Binary Microlensing Grid Search
background_knowledge: 引力微透镜指前景天体（恒星、行星或致密天体）的引力场对背景源星光的暂时放大。双透镜系统中，两个透镜天体共同形成复杂的焦散线结构，使光变曲线呈现多峰、非对称等特征；通过拟合光变曲线可推断透镜质量、间距、源轨迹等参数。传统研究范式是先计算或预生成放大率图，再对透镜参数与源轨迹进行网格搜索，并用 $\chi^2$ 优化、Levenberg--Marquardt 或 MCMC 精化。由于参数空间高维且每个试验模型都需在大量观测时刻求放大率，双透镜网格搜索计算量很大；Roman 空间望远镜等高时间采样率的微透镜巡天将进一步放大这一挑战。
contribution: 提出一种谐波角向映射方法：将预计算放大率图的角向依赖展开为 Fourier 模式，在 Fourier 空间中收缩依赖观测的加权求和，并利用逆快速 Fourier 变换（IFFT）高效评估所有试验源轨迹角度的 $\chi^2$，从而避免对每个观测反复计算。作者在 200 个 Roman-like 合成双透镜事件上测试，其中 166 个（83%）事件的恢复拟合与在注入参数处初始化的 Levenberg--Marquardt 拟合一致到 $|\Delta\chi^2|\le 1$。FFT 图扫描平均每事件耗时 5.05 min；在相同离散搜索体积下，Fourier 角向评估估计比传统放大率图采样快约 900 倍。**该方法可高效识别双透镜光变曲线建模的有用初始条件。**
summary: Searching for binary-lens microlensing solutions is computationally demanding because of the complex parameter space and the large number of trial models required. We present an algorithm that accelerates binary-lens grid searches by expanding the angular dependence of precomputed magnification maps in Fourier modes. By contracting the observation-dependent weighted sums in Fourier space, the $χ^2$ values for all trial source-trajectory angles can be evaluated efficiently using inverse fast Fourier transforms (FFTs), avoiding repeated calculations over individual observations. We tested the method on 200 Roman-like synthetic binary-lens events. For 166 events (83%), the recovered fits agreed with Levenberg--Marquardt fits initialized at the injected parameters to within $|Δχ^2|\leq1$. The FFT map scan required an average of 5.05~min per event. For the same discrete search volume, the Fourier angular evaluation was estimated to be approximately 900 times faster than conventional magnification-map sampling. These results demonstrate that the method can efficiently identify useful initial conditions for binary-lens light-curve modeling.

title: The Transient Array Radio Telescope: An open-source all-sky imaging radio interferometer
background_knowledge: 射电干涉测量通过多面天线同步观测同一天空区域，并将两两天线的信号进行相关运算，测量可见度函数 $V(\mathbf{u},v)$。在天空亮度分布 $I(\mathbf{l},m)$ 的傅里叶变换框架下，可见度函数对应不同空间频率上的分量，因此干涉阵列能够通过采样 $u$–$v$ 平面并反演成像来重建射电源或全天图像。实际观测中必须进行相位与幅度校准，以消除电子学通道差异、天线响应和大气等效应；校准源可以是人造卫星、射电源或专门的校准信号。全天空成像、瞬变源监测和开源硬件/软件平台是射电天文中兼具科研与教学价值的发展方向。
contribution: 论文介绍 Transient Array Radio Telescope（TART）：一个面向科研与教学的开源 24 阵元、1573–1577 MHz L 波段成像干涉仪。文章描述其物理架构，包括电子学、接收机、相关器和天线阵列设计；随后讨论软件架构，包括利用卫星进行望远镜校准以及成像流程。论文展示成像结果，并据此估计望远镜灵敏度约为 **52 kJy**，**表明 TART 可作为开源、低成本的全天空射电成像与教学实验平台**。
summary: The Transient Array Radio Telescope (TART) is an open-source 24-element 1573-1577 MHz L-band imaging interferometer designed for research and education. This paper introduces the physical architecture of the TART, describes it's electronics, radios, correlator, and the design of the antenna array. Then we discuss the software architecture, including the calibration of the telescope using satellites and imaging pipelines. Imaging results are presented, which lead to an estimate of ~52 kJy for the sensitivity of the telescope.

title: Thirty years of primordial deuterium abundances: A provenance-aware statistical reanalysis
background_knowledge: 原初氘（D/H）是大爆炸核合成（BBN）最精确的观测检验之一。BBN 发生在宇宙最初几分钟，轻元素丰度主要由重子—光子比决定；由于氘在恒星演化中容易被破坏，原初 D/H 对宇宙重子密度高度敏感，因此可作为独立于宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）的重子密度探针。观测上，原初 D/H 主要通过高红移类星体光谱中的金属贫乏吸收系统测得。该领域的精度不仅取决于单条吸收系统的测量误差，也取决于文献中独立吸收体数量、数据复用与汇编方式，以及不同分析选择对最终共识值及误差预算的影响。
contribution: 本文构建了一个具有来源追踪（provenance-aware）的原初 D/H 数据库，收录 1994–2026 年间 247 篇文献中的 957 个已发表数值，并尽可能将观测条目追溯至其对应的物理吸收系统。分析发现，795 个观测条目中 **80.1% 属于重复使用的个体值或汇编值，仅 11.4% 对应单个吸收系统的新测定**；共识别出 52 个不同吸收体，但 **出现最频繁的 8 个系统占全部可识别吸收体提及的 62.0%**。对完整数据库计算的逆 Herfindahl–Hirschman 指数表明，其有效代表性仅相当于 **16.28 个等权吸收体**，说明已发表文献高度集中于一个远小于表面样本数的有效子集。尽管存在强烈的内部依赖性，现代共识值 $10^5({\rm D/H})\simeq2.5$ 在替代的吸收体层面处理下仍然稳健，并且在移除 8 个主导系统后依然成立；但 **文献层面汇编所呈现的表观精度比简单统计已发表数值数量所暗示的更易受重复代表性影响**。作者还发现汇编文献在 2013–2014 年前后出现同步转变，表现为分析趋于更具选择性和同质性，而较老的个体值仍在流通。因此，**现代 D/H 共识的中心值稳健，但其底层文献的统计独立性低于发表密度所暗示的程度**，凸显了在精密宇宙学中开展来源追踪分析的重要性。
summary: (ABRIDGED:) Primordial deuterium provides one of the most precise observational tests of Big Bang nucleosynthesis, yet the published literature is built on a comparatively small number of high-redshift absorption systems. We construct a provenance-aware database of 957 published primordial-D/H values from 247 publications spanning 1994--2026 and trace observational entries, wherever possible, to their underlying physical absorbers. Of the 795 observational entries, 80.1 percent represent reused individual or compilation values; only 11.4 percent correspond to new determinations of individual absorption systems. Although 52 distinct absorbers are identified overall, the eight most frequently represented systems account for 62.0 percent of all identifiable absorber mentions. An inverse Herfindahl--Hirschman measure applied to our full database gives an effective representation equivalent to only 16.28 equally represented absorbers, demonstrating that the published literature is strongly concentrated around a much smaller effective subset. Despite this strong internal dependence, the modern consensus value of $10^5({\rm D/H})\simeq2.5$ is robust to alternative absorber-level treatments and survives removal of the eight dominant systems. However, the apparent precision of literature-level compilations is more sensitive to repeated representation than a simple count of published values implies. We also identify a synchronised transition in the compilation literature around 2013--2014, associated with increasingly selective and homogeneous analyses while older individual values continued to circulate. The modern D/H consensus is therefore robust in central value, but the underlying literature is less statistically independent than its publication density suggests.
