This thus highlights the importance of provenance-aware analysis in precision cosmology.

title: Stellar wind variability in OB stars and its effect on mass-loss determinations
background_knowledge: OB 型星是短寿命的大质量恒星，其强烈辐射通过谱线跃迁中的辐射压力驱动高速星风。经典星风模型常假设球对称、稳态且平滑的外流，并用 UV 共振线轮廓、Hα 以及红外/射电自由-自由辐射推导弹道质量损失率 $\dot M$。研究范式通常是将观测到的谱线轮廓与辐射转移模型比较，反演风速、密度和离化结构；但星风中的团块化、非稳态和不均匀结构会改变共振线光学厚度与发射率，从而给 $\dot M$ 带来系统偏差。因此，星风变率既是诊断星风结构的窗口，也是精确测定大质量恒星质量损失的关键不确定性来源。
contribution: 本文综述 OB 型星星风在至少一种光谱诊断中表现出的普遍变率，重点总结利用 UV 光谱变率揭示星风大尺度速度与密度结构的研究。作者强调，这些结构**尺度大、空间相干，并根植于恒星的光球层**；并汇总证据表明它们**对共振线辐射可以呈光学厚**，且**密度足以调制来源于星风中的 X 射线通量**。文章还讨论这些结构如何改变星风谱线形成，从而影响质量损失率测定的精度；并指出**毫米波与射电连续谱观测有潜力约束星风团块化的径向分层，是未来实现大质量恒星质量损失率可靠经验测定的重要方向**。
summary: Virtually all stellar winds of OB stars exhibit variability in one spectral diagnostic or another. This review focuses primarily on UV spectroscopic signatures of this variability and on studies that have exploited it to reveal the presence of large-scale velocity and density structures in the winds. The review includes demonstrations that the physical structures responsible for the variations appear to be large, spatially coherent and rooted in the stellar photospheres. Furthermore, evidence is summarised that these structures can be optically thick to resonance line radiation and are dense enough to modulate the X-ray fluxes that originate in the wind. Also discussed, is how the structures can affect wind line formation and, as a result, the precision by which mass-loss rates can be determined. The potential of millimetre and radio continuum observations to constrain the radial stratification of wind clumping is highlighted, as a future path to reliable empirical determinations of massive star mass-loss rates.

title: Chemical and dynamical evolution of prestellar cores, the dawn of star and planet formation
background_knowledge: 前恒星核是分子云中寒冷、致密、以尘埃和分子气体为主、尚未形成原恒星且可能处于引力坍缩边缘的云核，是恒星与行星系统形成的直接起点。其内部密度分布、速度场、湍流与磁场、尘埃性质以及气体电离度共同决定质量分布、坍缩时间尺度和后续盘与行星形成环境。观测上通常利用（亚）毫米波段的尘埃连续谱示踪柱密度，用分子谱线示踪运动学与化学，并结合电离探针约束宇宙线电离率和磁扩散过程。小尺度结构需要高灵敏度、高分辨率观测；单天线望远镜擅长恢复大尺度弥散辐射，干涉阵列擅长高分辨率，二者互补。环境（如分子云边界、反馈、星团成员）可能改变云核寿命和演化路径，因此需要大样本、统一选择的巡天。
contribution: 论文强调研究前恒星核是理解恒星与行星系统形成的关键；目前尚缺乏对其小尺度（$100$ 至 $1000\,\mathrm{au}$）密度与速度结构、气体电离态、寿命以及环境如何影响这些性质的系统巡天。为深入观测这一恒星形成关键阶段，需要类似 AtLAST 的大型单天线（亚）毫米波望远镜。**摘要的核心主张是需要以大型单天线（亚）毫米波设施开展大样本、深度的前恒星核巡天，以连接化学与动力学演化并揭示恒星与行星形成的开端**；摘要未给出具体观测结果或定量发现。
summary: Studying prestellar cores is crucial to understanding the formation of stellar and planetary systems. To date, we lack a comprehensive survey of their density and velocity structure at small scales (100-1000 au), the gas ionisation state, their lifetimes, and how these properties are influenced by the environment. A deep study into this critical stage of star formation requires a large single-dish (sub)millimetre telescope like AtLAST.

title: Episodic Protostellar Outflows: A Proper Motion Study in Serpens South
background_knowledge: 在低质量恒星形成过程中，分子云核在引力塌缩时保留角动量，并通过吸积盘、磁场与双极喷流/外流把部分物质和角动量抛射出去。原恒星外流穿过包层与周围分子云时会产生激波，加热并加速气体；一氧化碳（CO）分子谱线常示踪被外流卷吸的较冷分子气体，而一氧化硅（SiO）等激波示踪分子则更直接地标记高速喷流与激波结节。Class 0 原恒星处于仍被浓厚包层包裹的早期阶段，其外流往往高度准直并呈现分节结构，反映吸积事件可能具有间歇性或爆发性。利用多历元高分辨率观测测量外流结节的 proper motion（自行），再结合径向速度，可以重建外流的三维运动学、倾角、喷射历史与近期喷发时标。Serpens South 是邻近且活跃的原恒星形成区，拥有较高比例的原恒星和显著的外流反馈，适合检验上述物理图像。
contribution: 论文利用 ALMA 在 2017 年与 2021 年获取的两历元亚角秒观测，对 Serpens South 中心 hub 内 Class 0 原恒星 CARMA-7 驱动的分子外流开展研究，并给出该外流**首个 proper motion（自行）分析**。外流由 $^{12}$CO $J = 3-2$ 与 SiO $J = 8-7$ 示踪，呈现高度准直、分节且具有分离喷射结节的结构；整体上南侧主要为蓝移、北侧主要为红移，径向速度至少约 25 km/s。通过比较两历元的位置，测得 $^{12}$CO 与 SiO 结节的 proper motion 约为 10–40 mas/yr，对应速度约 30–90 km/s，并据此**重构外流形态与喷射历史**。结合径向速度与 proper motion，作者推断外流瓣相对视线的倾角约为 60–80 度。进一步测得**近期喷射事件的时标约为 10–120 年**，并将该结果与其他具有近期喷发事件的原恒星进行比较。
summary: Serpens South is a notable protostellar cluster with signatures of recent star formation, including a high protostellar fraction. Within the region, several protostars provide important mechanical feedback via outflows. We investigate the molecular outflow driven by the Class 0 protostar known as CARMA-7, which is located in the central hub of Serpens South. Two epochs of observations with the Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) with sub-arcsecond resolution capture the well-collimated, episodic outflow with distinct ejecta knots. This outflow, traced with 12CO J = 3-2 and SiO J = 8-7, appears to be mostly blueshifted to the south and redshifted to the north, with radial velocities up to at least 25 km/s. We present the first proper motion study of this outflow by comparing observations taken in 2017 and 2021. The measured proper motions trace the ejection history and refine the inferred outflow morphology. We find that proper motions of the 12CO J = 3-2 and SiO J = 8-7 knots range between 10 - 40 mas/yr, corresponding to 30-90 km/s. Using radial velocities and proper motions, we determined that the inclinations of the outflow lobes are ~60 -80 degrees relative to the line of sight. Finally, we measure ejection timescales as recent as ~10 to ~120 years, and we discuss this in the context of other known protostars with recent ejecta events.

title: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic $N$-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构由早期近均匀密度场在引力不稳定性作用下增长形成；标准图像以广义相对论（GR）加冷暗物质和宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 为基础，并用 N 体模拟追踪无碰撞暗物质粒子的非线性成团。N 体模拟通常把粒子网格（particle-mesh, PM）方法与泊松求解结合，以覆盖大尺度非线性演化，并用线性微扰理论和玻尔兹曼代码（如 hi_class）标定初始条件与线性响应。另一方面，宇宙加速膨胀可来自暗能量，也可来自修改引力；Horndeski 理论是最一般的标量-张量引力理论之一，其度规与标量场方程保持二阶，能统一包含 k-essence、KGB、Brans-Dicke、Cubic Galileon 等模型。为系统比较此类模型，常采用 α 基参数化，用时间函数 $\alpha_{\rm K}, \alpha_{\rm B}, \alpha_{\rm M}, \alpha_{\rm T}$ 与有效 Planck 质量 $M_*^2$ 描述标量场的动能、braiding、Planck 质量跑动和张量传播速度；这些量决定线性扰动、引力滑移以及结构增长的修正。要在非线性区检验修改引力，需要把标量自由度与非线性物质成团结合并入相对论 N 体框架，同时为屏蔽机制和非线性标量自相互作用预留接口。
contribution: 论文提出 Mercury，一个在 Horndeski 引力 α 基表述下进行宇宙学模拟的相对论 N 体代码。它在粒子网格（particle-mesh, PM）方案中加入了额外标量自由度的演化及相应的修改 Einstein 方程，以时间相关函数 $\alpha_{\rm K}, \alpha_{\rm B}, \alpha_{\rm M}, \alpha_{\rm T}$ 和有效 Planck 质量 $M_*^2$ 为基本描述量，从而把作者此前对 Horndeski 子类（k-essence 与 kinetic gravity braiding, KGB）的实现推广到一般线性 Horndeski α 基。代码将标量自由度及其有效应力-能量张量与非线性物质场、度规场一同演化，使非线性结构形成既作为标量场演化的源，又通过引力势反作用于物质。借助与 hi_class 的接口，Mercury 同时支持现象学 α 函数参数化和协变 Horndeski 理论；作者用 nKGB、Cubic Galileon 和 Brans-Dicke 模型进行了演示，并在线性区与 hi_class 校验，在非线性区恢复 k-essence 与 KGB 的预期极限。对于所考虑的光速传播的 Horndeski 模型，作者表明 **跑动的有效 Planck 质量会通过标量各向异性应力产生引力滑移，并改变控制矢量与张量度规扰动的摩擦项**；**$M_*^2$ 的演化还会改变有效暗能量密度扰动的归一化和尺度依赖，从而在其功率谱上留下印记**。该框架是迈向在统一相对论体系中一致纳入非线性标量自相互作用和屏蔽效应的非线性 Horndeski 模拟的中间步骤。
summary: We present Mercury, a relativistic $N$-body code for cosmological simulations in the $α$-basis formulation of Horndeski gravity. Mercury extends a particle-mesh scheme by incorporating the dynamics of the additional scalar degree of freedom and the corresponding modified Einstein equations, expressed in terms of the time-dependent functions $α_{\rm K}, α_{\rm B}, α_{\rm M}, α_{\rm T}$ and the effective Planck mass $M_*^2$. This generalises our previous implementation of Horndeski subclass models, namely $k$-essence and kinetic gravity braiding (KGB), to the general linear Horndeski $α$-basis. The code evolves the additional scalar degree of freedom and its effective stress--energy tensor alongside the nonlinear matter and metric fields, so that nonlinear structure formation sources the scalar-field evolution and feeds back on the gravitational potentials. Through its interface with hi_class, Mercury supports both phenomenological $α$-function parametrisations and covariant Horndeski theories; we demonstrate the latter using nKGB, the Cubic Galileon, and Brans--Dicke models. We validate the implementation against hi_class in the linear regime and recover the expected nonlinear $k$-essence and KGB limits. For the luminal Horndeski models considered here, we show how a running effective Planck mass generates gravitational slip through the scalar anisotropic stress and modifies the friction terms governing the vector and tensor metric perturbations. The evolution of $M_*^2$ also modifies the normalisation and scale dependence of the effective dark-energy density contrast, leaving a corresponding imprint on its power spectrum. The present framework provides an intermediate step towards nonlinear Horndeski simulations, in which nonlinear scalar self-interactions and screening effects can be incorporated consistently within the same relativistic framework.

title: Toward the one- and two-loop EFTofLSS for Simons Observatory CMB lensing
background_knowledge: 宇宙学标准模型将宇宙中的结构形成理解为引力不稳定性驱动的物质成团过程：早期近标度不变的密度扰动在膨胀宇宙中增长，逐渐形成暗物质晕、星系与星系团。宇宙微波背景（CMB）透镜效应是 CMB 光子从最后散射面传播至今、被沿途大尺度结构引力偏折的结果，因此 CMB 透镜功率谱携带了物质分布、宇宙几何与结构增长的信息。在较小尺度上，物质成团进入非线性区，重子反馈过程（如 AGN 反馈、超新星反馈）会改变物质功率谱，进而影响 CMB 透镜观测的解释与宇宙学参数推断。有效场论大尺度结构（EFTofLSS）为温和非线性区的物质成团提供系统描述：它将小尺度物理“积分掉”，在密度扰动与潮汐场等引力不稳定模式上作微扰展开，并用带自由系数的 counterterms 吸收未知的小尺度与重子效应；按展开阶数可分为单圈与双圈等近似。该领域的研究范式通常包括：构建理论模板并与观测功率谱或交叉相关比较；用 nuisance 参数或 counterterms 描述重子反馈等系统效应；通过 Fisher 矩阵预报或贝叶斯推断评估参数偏差、精度与尺度切割的影响。Simons Observatory 作为下一代 CMB 实验，将高精度测量温度、偏振与 CMB 透镜，从而检验非线性结构形成模型与重子反馈建模。
contribution: 本文针对 Simons Observatory 的温度、偏振与 CMB 透镜联合似然开展 Fisher 预报，使用无噪声数据矢量并考虑不同重子反馈情景，以单圈与双圈 EFTofLSS 建模非线性结构形成。核心工作是检验不同 loop order 的 EFTofLSS 在重子反馈存在时能否稳健拟合 CMB 透镜数据，并量化其对宇宙学参数偏差与精度的影响。主要发现是：通过对 EFTofLSS counterterms 进行主成分分析引入单个额外参数后，单圈与双圈 EFTofLSS 均能很好地拟合所考虑的重子反馈情景；该参数与有效 AGN 加热温度 $T_{\rm AGN}$ 密切对应。两种 loop order 均能减小宇宙学参数偏差，在固定尺度切割下仅造成很小的 marginalized precision 损失。**单圈 EFTofLSS 在类似 dark-matter-only 模型的尺度范围内给出无偏估计，而双圈 EFTofLSS 将无偏范围延伸到更小尺度，并更稳健地容纳不同重子反馈情景。** 当各模型在其宇宙学参数估计仍保持无偏的最小尺度上评估时，**双圈 EFTofLSS 给出比 dark-matter-only 模型更强的参数约束**。
summary: Cosmic microwave background (CMB) lensing observations are becoming sensitive to non-linear structure formation and baryonic feedback scenarios. The effective field theory of large-scale structure (EFTofLSS) provides a systematic description of matter clustering in the mildly non-linear regime, accounting for baryonic effects through counterterms and offering a consistent framework for cross-correlations with other observables. We perform a Fisher forecast for the joint Simons Observatory temperature, polarization, and CMB lensing likelihood using noiseless data vectors with different baryonic feedback scenarios, modelling non-linear structure formation using the one- and two-loop EFTofLSS. We find that, with a single additional parameter, obtained through a principal-component analysis of the EFTofLSS counterterms, both the one- and two-loop EFTofLSS provide a good fit across the baryonic feedback scenarios considered. This parameter is closely aligned with the effective AGN heating temperature $T_{\rm AGN}$. Both loop orders reduce cosmological parameter biases, with only a small loss in marginalized precision at fixed scale cuts. We find that the one-loop EFTofLSS yields unbiased estimates over a range of scales similar to the dark-matter-only model, while the two-loop EFTofLSS extends this range to smaller scales and accommodates different feedback scenarios more robustly. When each model is evaluated at the smallest scales for which its cosmological parameter estimates remain unbiased, the two-loop EFTofLSS yields stronger constraints than the dark-matter-only model.

title: VLITE Observations of the Hubble Ultra Deep Field
background_knowledge: 低频射电天文学通过同步辐射追踪相对论电子，是研究星形成星系、射电 AGN 及其周围等离子体过程的重要手段。在亚毫央斯基（sub-mJy）流量段，射电源计数由星形成星系与不同射电宁静/射电噪 AGN 共同贡献，因此深场低频观测可用于检验星系演化与 AGN 人口模型；但定量结论依赖完备性修正、混淆噪声和精确的流量定标。射电 AGN 的变源性可来自内禀的喷流/吸积变化，也可来自传播效应，例如沿视线方向由星际介质引起的折射星际闪烁（RISS），其在低频、致密源和约 1 年时间尺度上尤为值得搜索。致密对称天体（CSO）是年轻射电 AGN 的重要子群，通常具有峰化射电谱和小尺度双瓣结构。将低频观测与高频 VLA 观测共时采集，可在不额外占用望远镜时间的情况下开展深场成像与多历元变源研究。
contribution: 作者利用 VLITE 与更高频率 VLA 观测共时采集的 136 小时 340 MHz 数据观测 HUDF。最深图像使用 20 小时数据，覆盖 4 平方度，角分辨率为 $8.8'' \times 3.8''$，中心 rms 灵敏度为 158 μJy/beam，并编目 671 个高于 $5\sigma$ 的射电源。基于模型射电连续谱人口的注入-恢复模拟进行不完备性修正后，**源计数恢复了亚毫央斯基星形成星系人口，且其丰度与同频段其他深场一致**。数据覆盖 45 个观测日、横跨相隔 1.3 年的两个 VLA A 构型学期，从而可在亚毫央斯基流量密度上搜索约 1 年时间尺度的变源性。作者识别出 11 个流量密度为 1–100 mJy、调制指数为 6%–40% 的变源，其中 6 个具有峰化射电谱，**与致密 AGN 一致**。这些变源的变幅总体与沿该视线方向预期的 RISS 相符，**但 3 个调制指数超过 30% 的源很可能需要内禀贡献**。其中一个源经 VLBA 后续观测确认为 CSO，**表明 VLITE 的共时低频变源搜索有潜力识别年轻射电 AGN 群体**。
summary: We present 136 hr of 340 MHz observations of the Hubble Ultra Deep Field (HUDF) conducted with the VLA Low-band Ionosphere and Transient Experiment (VLITE), collected commensally with higher-frequency Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (VLA) observations. Our deepest image combines 20 hr of data, covers 4 square degrees, and achieves an angular resolution of 8.8 arcsec x 3.8 arcsec with an rms sensitivity of 158 microJy per beam at the field center. We catalog 671 radio sources detected above 5 sigma significance. Correcting for incompleteness using injection-recovery simulations with a model radio continuum population, we show that our source counts recover the sub-mJy star-forming galaxy population at abundances consistent with other deep fields at comparable frequencies. The data span 45 observing days across two VLA A-configuration semesters separated by 1.3 years, providing a search for variability on ~1-year timescales at sub-mJy flux densities. We identify eleven variable sources with flux densities of 1-100 mJy and modulation indices of 6-40%, six of which exhibit peaked radio spectra consistent with compact AGN. Their variability amplitudes are consistent with refractive interstellar scintillation (RISS) predicted for this line of sight, though three sources with modulation indices exceeding 30% likely require an intrinsic contribution. One source, subsequently confirmed as a compact symmetric object through VLBA follow-up observations, demonstrates the potential of VLITE for identifying populations of young radio AGN through commensal low-frequency variability searches.

title: A Cepheid-based Distance to the Type 1 Seyfert NGC 3783
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动，Type 1 Seyfert 是其中一类可通过宽发射线观测到吸积盘附近高速度气体的活动星系。对 AGN 宿主星系而言，精确距离是把角尺度、光度、时间延迟等观测量转换为物理尺度和黑洞质量的关键前提。造父变星是经典的标准烛光：其光变周期与平均光度之间存在周光关系（$P$–$L$ 关系），经大麦哲伦云（LMC）等近邻星系定标后，可用于测量星系距离。实际工作中需用哈勃空间望远镜（HST）多波段、多历元成像，拟合光变曲线模板，识别候选造父变星，并处理金属丰度、消光、混入天体和采样不足等系统效应。距离模数 $\mu$ 与光度距离 $D$ 通过 $\mu = 5\log_{10}D - 5$ 相联系，因而高精度造父变星距离也是检验宇宙距离阶梯的重要环节。该论文把这一距离测量方法用于较远的 Seyfert 星系 NGC 3783，兼具 AGN 宿主星系研究与距离阶梯方法学意义。
contribution: 论文利用哈勃空间望远镜（HST）对 Type 1 Seyfert NGC 3783 进行 15 次非冗余时间采样成像，其中 10 次使用 F350LP 滤光片，F555W 和 F814W 滤光片各 8 次。作者在全部观测中识别出 1541 个唯一点源，并用造父变星光变模板拟合其光变曲线，得到 7 个造父变星候选体；其中 4 个最可信，构成本文的“强”样本。基于 Riess et al. (2019) 的 LMC 定标，作者分别对全样本和强样本拟合周光关系，并采用 Pietrzynski et al. (2019) 给出的独立 LMC 距离、校正金属丰度的潜在影响后，由强样本得到 **距离模数 $\mu = 33.118 \pm 0.154$ mag，对应距离 $D = 42.03 \pm 2.98$ Mpc**。该结果与全样本给出的值在形式上一致，**使 NGC 3783 成为目前具有造父变星距离测量的最远星系之一**。
summary: We present a Cepheid-based distance to the Type 1 Seyfert NGC 3783 using the Hubble Space Telescope. Images were obtained over 15 visits using nonredundant time spacing, with ten observations in the F350LP filter and eight observations each in the F555W and F814W filters. We found 1541 unique point sources across all observations, and we fit Cepheid templates to analyze these light curves. From these data, we determined a full sample of seven Cepheid candidates. Of these seven candidates, four are the most convincing and comprise our "strong" sample of Cepheid candidates. We fit the period$-$luminosity relationship to the total sample and to our "strong" sample using the LMC calibration by Riess et al. (2019). Adopting an independent distance constraint to the LMC given by Pietrzynski et al. (2019), and correcting for the potential effects of metallicity, we determine a distance modulus of $μ= 33.118 \pm 0.154$ mag using our strong sample. This value is formally consistent with the value derived using our full sample and corresponds to a distance of $D = 42.03 \pm 2.98$ Mpc. NGC 3783 is therefore among the farthest galaxies with a Cepheid-based distance measurement.

title: The MAGPI Survey: the evolution of galaxy spin-filament alignments since z~0.3
background_knowledge: 宇宙网由节点、纤维、墙和空洞组成。星系形成于暗物质晕中，其角动量主要通过早期宇宙的潮汐力矩获得，并在后续并合、气体吸积和 secular 演化中改变。星系自旋轴相对宿主大尺度结构（尤其宇宙纤维）的统计取向，记录了角动量来源与环境各向异性的耦合，是连接星系形成与宇宙网的重要观测量。观测上通常用 IFU 积分视场光谱获得恒星与电离气体的二维运动学，去除投影和倾角影响后重建三维自旋轴，再与由星系巡天构建的纤维方向比较。低红移研究表明取向信号随恒星质量翻转：低质量星系倾向于自旋平行于纤维，高质量星系更倾向于垂直；这可能与暗物质晕的潮汐扭矩、纤维内相干气体吸积、并合历史及质量依赖的角动量重定向有关。气体与恒星运动学的差异还可检验近期气体吸积是否比恒星更紧密地保留纤维方向记忆。红移演化则可约束宇宙网各向异性、吸积模式和并合效应对星系角动量的影响。
contribution: 该工作利用 MAGPI 巡天的积分视场恒星与电离气体运动学，在 $0.20<z<0.42$ 重建星系三维自旋轴，并用 GAMA、MAGPI Redshift Survey 与 DESI 中按恒星质量匹配的等数密度星系样本识别宇宙纤维。**在 $z\sim0.3$ 探测到自旋—纤维统计取向信号随恒星质量发生翻转：低质量星系自旋倾向于平行于宿主纤维，高质量星系倾向于垂直。**测得转变质量约为 $\log(M_{*,t}/M_{\odot})\sim10.8$，比 $z\sim0.05$ 的 SAMI Galaxy Survey 结果高约 0.6 dex；bootstrap 分析给出 **99.5% 置信度认为 MAGPI 的转变质量高于 SAMI**。在固定恒星质量下，MAGPI 星系表现出比 SAMI 对应样本更强的平行取向，**暗示过去约 3 Gyr 内自旋—纤维取向关系发生演化**。MAGPI 星系的电离气体成分相对恒星成分更贴近纤维方向，且相对于 $M_*$ 匹配的 SAMI 样本更明显，**表明 $z\sim0.3$ 时电离气体与大尺度结构耦合更强，与沿纤维的相干气体吸积在较高质量仍有效相符**。在 $z\sim0$ 的低红移端则探测到低质量端向垂直取向转变，且气体与恒星成分相对纤维的取向相近，可能反映并合与长期演化累积效应。
summary: We present measurements of galaxy spin-filament alignments at 0.20<z<0.42 using the MAGPI Survey, exploiting resolved stellar and ionised gas kinematics to reconstruct 3D spin axes. Cosmic filaments are identified using a stellar mass-matched constant-number-density population from the GAMA, MAGPI Redshift Survey and DESI datasets. We detect a flipping of the statistical alignment signal at z~0.3 as a function of M*: low-mass galaxies preferentially exhibit spins parallel to the direction of their host filaments, while high-mass galaxies tend towards perpendicular orientations. The transition mass is measured to be log(M{*,t}/Msun)~10.8, approximately 0.6 dex higher than the value for the SAMI Galaxy Survey at z~0.05. Bootstrap analysis gives 99.5% confidence that the transition mass is higher for MAGPI than SAMI. At fixed stellar mass MAGPI galaxies exhibit stronger parallel alignments than their SAMI counterparts, suggesting evolution of spin-filament alignments over the past ~3 Gyr. The gaseous component in MAGPI galaxies is more closely aligned with filaments than the stellar component, relative to a M*-matched SAMI sample. This indicates a stronger coupling between ionised gas and the large-scale structure at z~0.3, consistent with coherent gas accretion onto filaments remaining efficient at higher M*. At z~0 we detect a transition toward perpendicular alignments at lower M*, while the gas and stellar components exhibit similar alignments relative to filaments, likely due to the cumulative effects of mergers and secular evolution.

title: Dust-induced reversal of the optical wavelength dependence of spiral-arm pitch angles
background_knowledge: 盘状星系的旋臂通常用密度波理论描述：旋臂并非固定不变的物质臂，而是气体和恒星在引力扰动下形成的波状结构。气体经过旋臂时受到激波压缩，触发恒星形成，因此旋臂附近常出现年轻、偏蓝的大质量恒星，而较老的偏红恒星则分布得更宽。经典图像预期，从旋臂上游到下游会出现由蓝到红的年龄—颜色梯度。观测上常用不同光学波段测量旋臂的螺距角，螺距角描述旋臂缠绕的松紧程度；不同波段主要追踪不同年龄的恒星群体及尘埃消光效应，因此其测得的旋臂位置和螺距角可能随波长变化。尘埃会优先吸收和散射较短波长的光，辐射转移以及气体和恒星的流线运动也会改变各波段光度峰值的空间位置，从而使表观颜色序列和螺距角关系偏离简单预期。
contribution: 本文研究尘埃消光对激波后恒星辐射的影响，并结合气体与恒星流线运动，解释旋臂螺距角随光学波长出现的表观反转。作者发现，在光学深度较高区域（ $\hat{\tau}_{V} \gtrsim 0.2$ ），尘埃消光能够改变不同波段恒星辐射通量极大值相对于激波位置的次序，从而产生表观的红到蓝空间序列；同时，流线运动使激波后恒星群体在旋臂附近停留的时间比圆轨道模型更长，进一步改变发射光的空间分布。由此，**观测到的红到蓝“颜色跳跃”并不必然与经典密度波图像矛盾**；它可由同一批激波后恒星群体产生：这些恒星内禀的年龄—颜色梯度为蓝到红，但经尘埃消光改造后可表现为红到蓝。
summary: The classical density-wave scenario predicts a blue-to-red age--colour gradient across the spiral arms of disc galaxies as a consequence of shock-induced star formation. However, observations of spiral-arm pitch angles at different wavelengths sometimes suggest the opposite trend, namely a red-to-blue ``colour jump''. The origin of this apparent contradiction remains unclear. In this work, we investigate the effects of dust attenuation on post-shock stellar emission, together with the streamline motions of gas and stellar populations. We find that dust attenuation in regions with relatively high optical depths, $\hatτ_{V} \gtrsim 0.2$, can produce an apparent red-to-blue spatial sequence, with respect to the shock location, by reversing the relative positions of the flux maxima of stellar populations observed in different bands. Moreover, streamline motions confine post-shock stellar populations near the spiral arms for longer than in a circular-orbit model, thereby modifying the spatial distribution of the emitted light. We conclude that the apparent red-to-blue colour jump does not necessarily contradict the classical density-wave scenario. Instead, it can arise from the same post-shock stellar populations that intrinsically produce a blue-to-red age--colour gradient if their emission is modified by dust attenuation.

title: Developing Environments: Formation and Quenching at Cosmic Noon Traced by the Large-scale Distribution of Gas and Galaxies
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学图像（$\Lambda$CDM）中，星系的形成与演化并非仅由自身暗物质晕质量决定，还强烈受到所处大尺度环境的影响。本地宇宙观测确立了清晰的「环境—星系性质」关联：大质量、早型、被动演化（淬灭）的星系高度聚集于星系团等高密度区域，而旋涡星系、活跃恒星形成星系更多存在于低密度场中（即形态—密度关系）。主流解释包括：大质量暗物质晕中高温 virial 气体的「引力加热」与冷却时间过长、星系并合与冲压剥离（ram-pressure stripping）移除冷气体、以及 AGN 与超新星反馈加热或驱散气体，使冷气体吸积（cold accretion）中断，恒星形成随之熄灭。然而这些环境趋势「何时」以及「如何」出现仍不清楚。宇宙正午（cosmic noon，$z\sim 1.5$–$3.5$）是宇宙恒星形成率密度与黑洞吸积活动的峰值时期，也是大尺度结构（protocluster，原星系团）正在装配的阶段，星系可在短时间内快速淬灭，其驱动机制存在争议。传统研究几乎只用星系数密度（galaxy number density）作为环境的代理，但星系数密度是「结果」而非「原因」，无法直接反映气体供应这一淬灭的关键物理量。新兴手段是利用背景光源（类星体或星系）光谱上的 Ly$\alpha$ 吸收，即 Ly$\alpha$ tomography（层析），来映射星系际介质中的中性氢（冷气体）分布，从而得到与星系示踪独立的「气体环境」。另一方面，JWST/NIRSpec 与 NIRCam 的深场光谱与测光使高红移星系的高质量多波段观测成为可能，通过全光谱—测光联合拟合（如 \texttt{Prospector}）可非参数化地重建恒星形成历史（SFH）、恒星质量、尘埃衰减，并利用静止光学 Na\,I\,D 吸收线测量气体外流速度与质量加载率，从而把「形成时间」「淬灭时间」「反馈强度」与「环境密度」直接对照。
contribution: 本文在 COSMOS 场中，对 $1.7<z<3.5$ 的大质量星系同时使用两种相互独立的环境示踪量：来自 COSMOS-Web 的星系数密度 $\delta_{\#}$，以及来自 LATIS Ly$\alpha$ 层析的星系际中性氢（冷气体）密度 $\delta_{\rm HI}$；样本由 139 个 Blue Jay JWST/NIRSpec 星系与 57 个 DAWN JWST Archive 棱栅（prism）光谱组成，通过光谱—测光联合的 \texttt{Prospector} 拟合得到恒星质量、恒星形成历史、尘埃衰减与 Na\,I\,D 外流率。核心结果包括：（1）在**大质量淬灭星系中，从形成到淬灭的时间间隔随环境密度增大而变长**；（2）**AGN 活动与 Na\,I\,D 外流仅出现在 $\delta_{\#}<0.5$ 且 Ly$\alpha$ 吸收增强（$\delta_{\rm HI}>1$）的区域**，且多集中于同时具备两者的极**大质量淬灭星系**；（3）约 65\% 的样本遵循两种示踪量之间的正相关，但存在两个显著偏离的区域：一个**星系富集而气体贫乏**的区域（$\delta_{\#}>2$，$\delta_{\rm HI}<1$）与质量最大的 Hyperion 原星系团核心之一重合，该处气体很可能已被完全电离，其中的淬灭星系**形成更早，且缺乏显著 AGN 活动与外流**；另一个**星系贫乏而气体富集**的区域（$\delta_{\#}<1$，$\delta_{\rm HI}>1$）位于最致密 Hyperion 核心 60 cMpc 范围内，其中星系**快速淬灭，且 AGN 与外流发生率很高**，这种「发展中的环境」（developing environment）既不同于成熟的原星系团，也不同于场星系环境，很可能对应仍在装配中的大质量暗物质晕。作者由此强调：**仅靠星系计数不足以刻画宇宙正午的环境**；只有同时测绘星系与冷气体，才能理解环境如何调控气体吸积、恒星形成与淬灭。
summary: Environmental density correlates with galaxy properties in the local Universe, but how and when these trends emerge is unclear: at cosmic noon, large-scale structures are still assembling and galaxies quench rapidly for debated reasons. We study how the formation and quenching histories of massive galaxies at $1.7<z<3.5$ depend on environment, using two independent tracers: galaxy number density ($δ_\#$) from COSMOS-Web and intergalactic neutral hydrogen ($δ_{HI}$, cool gas) from LATIS Ly$α$ tomography. We combine 139 Blue Jay JWST/NIRSpec galaxies with 57 DAWN JWST Archive prism spectra in COSMOS, deriving stellar masses, star formation histories, dust attenuation, and Na\,{\sc d} outflow rates from joint spectro-photometric \texttt{Prospector} fits. In massive quiescent galaxies, the formation-to-quenching interval increases with density. AGN and Na\,{\sc d} outflows are confined to $δ_\#<0.5$ and elevated Ly$α$ absorption ($δ_{HI}>1$), mostly in massive quiescent galaxies showing both. About 65\% of the sample follows a correlation between the tracers; two outlier regions stand out. A galaxy-rich, gas-poor region ($δ_\#>2$, $δ_{HI}<1$) coincides with one of the most massive Hyperion protocluster cores, where the gas is plausibly fully ionized; its quiescent galaxies formed earlier and lack significant AGN activity and outflows. A galaxy-poor, gas-rich region ($δ_\#<1$, $δ_{HI}>1$), within 60 cMpc of the densest Hyperion cores, hosts rapidly quenched galaxies with a high incidence of AGN and outflows. This \emph{developing environment}, distinct from both mature protoclusters and the field, likely traces massive halos still assembling. Galaxy counts alone cannot capture the environment at cosmic noon: jointly mapping galaxies and cool gas is crucial to understand how environment regulates gas accretion, star formation, and quenching.

title: Wide-field search for submicrosecond optical and gamma transients as manifestation of primordial black holes evaporation with the TAIGA-HiSCORE Cherenkov array
background_knowledge: 原初黑洞（primordial black hole, PBH）是早期宇宙中密度扰动坍缩形成的假想黑洞，质量可远小于恒星黑洞，因而可能同时关联早期宇宙物理、暗物质候选和超出标准模型的新物理。按霍金辐射，黑洞具有温度 $T_{\mathrm{H}} \propto 1/M$、寿命 $\tau \propto M^3$；质量越小，蒸发越剧烈，生命末段可产生极短时标的光学与超高能伽马射线爆发。地面切伦科夫阵列通过探测宇宙线或伽马射线引发的大气簇射切伦科夫光工作，TAIGA-HiSCORE 具有宽视场、高占空比和快速时间响应，原本用于宇宙线与超高能伽马天文学，也可用于搜索极稀有、亚微秒级的瞬变。多信使搜索则强调在同一仪器或观测网络中寻找光学与伽马等不同通道在时间上吻合的信号；由于预期事件率极低，实验通常以未探测到信号来给出通量或事件率上限。
contribution: 论文基于 TAIGA-HiSCORE 切伦科夫阵列，处理两个新观测季（2022—2024 年）的数据，延续此前 2018—2022 年的前四季亚微秒光学瞬变搜索，并进一步发展了针对超高能伽马射线（$>100\,\mathrm{TeV}$）窄时空群的搜索方法。作者在 $1000\,\mu\mathrm{s}$、$100\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ 和 $6\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ 时间窗内寻找窄时空伽马群，未发现显著信号，给出其事件率上限 **$10^{-3}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\,\mathrm{h}^{-1}$**。由于遗迹黑洞蒸发可同时伴随短光学脉冲和超高能伽马闪，该工作在单一装置内实现了光学与伽马两个通道的搜索，实际上构建了针对黑洞蒸发的多信使搜索。论文还更新了亚微秒光学瞬变的上限：能流上限约 **$10^{-4}\ \mathrm{erg}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$**，对应事件率上限约 **$5\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\,\mathrm{h}^{-1}$**。这些结果对原初黑洞蒸发候选给出了观测限制。
summary: We demonstrated in our papers [Panov, 2021; Panov,2025), that the TAIGA-HiSCORE Cherenkov array physics, originally designed for research in cosmic rays and ultra-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy, can also be used for wide-field searches for very rare submicrosecond optical transients of astrophysical origin. The papers \cite{PANOV-2021,PANOV-2025} presented the results of the first four seasons of optical transient searches (2018--2022) and the resulting upper limits on the flux of corresponding events. The present paper presents data processing from two new seasons of optical transient searches (2022--2024). This paper further develops a method for searching for narrow spatiotemporal groups of ultra-high-energy gamma-rays (above 100\,TeV). Since the evaporation of relic black holes can be accompanied by both by the emission of a short light pulse and by a flash of ultra-high-energy gamma-rays, a multimessenger technique for searching for black hole evaporation was in fact implemented in this work, where two different methods are implemented within a single instrument. The search for narrow spatiotemporal groups of gamma-rays was carried out in time windows of 1000\,$μ$s, 100\,$μ$s, and 6\,$μ$s. Since narrow groups of gamma were not detected, the upper limit on their frequency were obtained as $10^{-3}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$. The upper limit on the number of submicrosecond optical transients have also been updated: $10^{-4}\mathrm{erg/s/cm}^2$ as $5\cdot10^{-4}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$.

title: How tightly can PBH abundance information constrain scalar-induced gravitational waves?
background_knowledge:
在暴胀宇宙学中，小尺度标量曲率扰动会被放大；当这些扰动模式重新进入视界时，若局部密度反差超过形成阈值，就可能坍缩为原初黑洞（PBH）。PBH 质量由形成时的视界质量决定，丰度则强烈依赖扰动功率谱尾部、形成阈值以及宇宙学与 QCD 状态方程。因此，恒星质量区间的 PBH 丰度是探测小尺度原初功率谱的重要窗口。与此同时，同一批增强的标量扰动在二阶微扰层面会源出标量诱导引力波（SIGW），形成随机引力波背景；其谱形由标量功率谱的卷积与模式耦合决定，并非总能通过整体振幅重标度与 PBH 丰度一一对应。PBH 丰度与 SIGW 因而从不同物理权重探测同一原初涨落，联合推断需要建立从原初谱形到两类观测量的一致映射。
\n常用做法是用对数正态谱等参数化描述小尺度功率谱峰，并计算它对 PBH 质量函数 $f_{\mathrm{PBH}}(M)$ 和 SIGW 谱 $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ 的响应。这里存在峰位、峰宽与振幅之间的退化：不同谱形可在给定质量区间给出相近 PBH 丰度，却产生不同频率依赖的 SIGW。纳赫兹频段的脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）以及恒星质量 PBH 的种群限制，使这种退化成为可检验问题；QCD 相变会改变 PBH 形成阈值与质量—尺度关系，峰值曲率等形成方案也会改变映射。
contribution:
本文利用有限恒星质量区间内精确的合成绝对 PBH 丰度信息，并结合精确总丰度与外部种群限制，检验这些信息对 SIGW 的预测能力。在固定 QCD 形成方案、Gaussian 扰动下，两个光滑、对称的对数正态标量谱可以满足相同的 PBH 丰度条件，却产生彼此不成比例的领头阶 SIGW 谱：在两个相邻纳赫兹频窗中较低频窗内平均相差约 20%，而在较高频窗内相差近 60 倍，因此不能用引力波背景的单一重标度来描述。峰位与峰宽在丰度计算中会与振幅补偿，而较高频窗的几乎全部能量来自两个波数都高于原初谱峰的标量模式对。
\n在主要丰度基准下，局部有限宽度成分通过不同的模式耦合，在固定纳赫兹频率处产生更大的对比度；这一结论在 QCD 与随机峰值曲率形成方案下均成立。对于另行生成的种群，若把质量信息覆盖到其大部分丰度范围，会限制对数正态谱的峰位—峰宽补偿并降低较高频窗的对比度，但两个频窗响应不等的特征仍然保留。这些结果说明，**PBH 与 SIGW 的联合推断必须传播与 PBH 丰度信息相容的原初谱形状，而不能把单一引力波张量模板直接对应于某一次 PBH 丰度拟合。**
summary: Primordial black hole (PBH) abundances and scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) probe the same primordial fluctuations through different physical weights. We examine the predictive power of precise synthetic information on absolute PBH abundances over a finite stellar-mass interval, together with an exact total abundance and external population bounds. For Gaussian perturbations under a fixed quantum chromodynamics (QCD) formation prescription, two smooth, symmetric lognormal spectra satisfy the same abundance conditions while producing nonproportional leading-order SIGW spectra. The two spectra differ by about 20% when averaged over the lower of two adjacent nanohertz windows but by nearly a factor of 60 in the higher-frequency window, so the difference cannot be represented by a single rescaling of the gravitational-wave background. Peak position and width compensate with amplitude in the abundance calculation, while the higher-frequency window draws almost all its energy from scalar-mode pairs with both wavenumbers above the primordial peak. Under the principal abundance benchmark, local finite-width components yield larger contrasts at a fixed nanohertz frequency through distinct mode couplings under both the QCD and stochastic peak-curvature formation prescriptions. For a separately generated population, extending mass information over most of its abundance restricts the lognormal peak-position and width compensation and reduces the higher-window contrast, while the unequal window responses persist. These results show why joint PBH-SIGW inference must propagate primordial shapes compatible with the PBH abundance information rather than assign one tensor template to a single abundance fit.

title: Exothermic Higgs portal: from LUX-ZEPLIN recoil to Gamma Rays
background_knowledge: 暗物质与暗能量是现代宇宙学标准模型 $\Lambda$CDM 的两大组成，其中暗物质约占宇宙能量密度的四分之一，主要通过星系旋转曲线、星系团质量、宇宙微波背景（CMB）与大规模结构等间接推断。其研究范式包括确定暗物质粒子的质量与相互作用、理解其在早期宇宙中的产生机制（如热遗迹冻结、非热产生），并利用直接探测、间接探测和对撞机搜寻加以检验。热遗迹弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）是最具代表性的方案：暗物质在早期宇宙中通过湮灭冻结，遗迹丰度由湮灭截面决定，质量通常在 GeV 至 TeV 量级。直接探测寻找 WIMP 与靶核弹性或非弹性散射产生的核反冲信号，代表实验包括 LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）、XENONnT 与 PandaX 等；信号率对暗物质速度分布、质量劈裂和相互作用结构敏感。希格斯门户模型让暗物质通过希格斯玻色子与标准模型耦合，是最小且可检验的暗区模型之一。非弹性暗物质包含两个近简并态，可通过放热下散射或吸热上散射产生核反冲：放热过程能把微小质量劈裂释放的能量转化为更大的反冲能量，从而缓解运动学压低，并可不依赖速度分布的高速度尾部。间接探测则寻找暗物质湮灭或衰变产生的伽马射线、宇宙线、射电与微波信号，包括矮星系伽马射线观测、MeV 伽马背景、CMB 能量注入以及太阳捕获暗物质的湮灭。
contribution: 论文提出，用单个复标量场 $\phi$ 对标准模型（SM）作最小扩展，即可为 LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）最近报告的核反冲候选事件提供可行的**非弹性放热热遗迹解释**。质量项与希格斯门户相互作用把 $\phi$ 分裂为两个近简并的实标量 $\phi_1$ 与 $\phi_2$；当质量劈裂为几百 $\mathrm{keV}$ 时，$\phi_2$ 具有足够长的宇宙学寿命，且两态遗迹丰度相当。取 $\phi_{1,2}$ 质量约为 $100\ \mathrm{GeV}$、非对角希格斯耦合由遗迹丰度确定，则放热下散射对 LZ 曝光给出**量级为一的事件预期**，并且**无需依赖吸热情形所要求的速度分布高速度尾部**。该情景可用不同核靶和间接暗物质搜寻检验：$\phi_2\to\phi_1\gamma\gamma$ 衰变产生宽广的亚 $\mathrm{MeV}$ 光子连续谱，可由 INTEGRAL/SPI 与 COSI 探测；$\phi_1\phi_2$ 湮灭产生从 $\mathrm{GeV}$ 能段一直延伸到约 $100\ \mathrm{GeV}$ 的连续谱，可由 Fermi-LAT 对矮星系的观测检验；当前 CMB 限制得到满足，且太阳中捕获的暗物质粒子之间的湮灭被强烈压低。下一代实验有望探测该热遗迹希格斯门户情景中相互关联的散射、衰变与湮灭信号。
summary: We show that a minimal extension of the Standard Model (SM) by a single complex scalar $φ$ provides a viable inelastic exothermic, thermal relic, interpretation of the recently reported nuclear-recoil candidate from LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ). The mass terms and Higgs-portal interactions split $φ$ into two nearly degenerate real scalars, $φ_{1,2}$. For mass-splitting of a few hundred keV, $φ_2$ is cosmologically long-lived and the two states have comparable relic abundances. Taking $φ_{1,2}$ masses to be $\sim100\,$GeV, with off-diagonal Higgs coupling fixed by relic abundance, the exothermic down-scattering yields an order-one event expectation for the LZ exposure, without relying on the high-velocity tail of the dark matter velocity distribution required in endothermic scenarios. This scenario can be tested using different nuclear targets and with indirect dark matter searches: $φ_2\toφ_1γγ$ decays give a broad sub-MeV photon continuum that can be probed by INTEGRAL/SPI and COSI; $φ_1φ_2$ annihilation produces a GeV-scale continuum, extending up to $\sim$100 GeV, that is probed by Fermi-LAT observations of dwarf galaxies; current CMB constraints are satisfied and annihilation among dark matter particles captured in the Sun is strongly suppressed. Next-generation experiments could probe correlated scattering, decay, and annihilation signatures of this thermal Higgs-portal scenario.

title: A Century-Long Archival Search and Analysis of the Rubin Observatory-Discovered Dwarf Planet Candidate 2026 ED$_{138}$
background_knowledge: 海外天体（trans-Neptunian object，TNO）是绕太阳运行、轨道半长轴通常大于海王星的天体，主要分布于柯伊伯带及更外侧。它们保存了太阳系早期吸积与动力演化的化石信息；其中尺度较大者可能达到矮行星级别，其大小需结合绝对星等 $H_V$ 与几何反照率推算。该领域研究常把现代巡天发现与历史底片、红外与光学测光、恒星掩星和长期轨道积分结合：档案天体测量可改进历表并预测掩星；相位曲线与光变曲线可约束表面散射性质和三维形状；近红外颜色与吸收带可进行分类并追溯碰撞族；数值积分则用于判断与海王星的平运动共振及长期稳定性和捕获历史。
contribution: 论文对 Rubin Observatory 早期数据发现、并在 DECam 2016 年图像中回收到的小行星候选体 2026 ED$_{138}$ 开展长期档案搜寻与分析。该天体 $H_V = 3.11 \pm 0.05$ mag，直径约 635–1590 km（对应几何反照率 0.25–0.04），是已知最大的 TNO 之一。作者汇总了跨越 89 年的档案观测：1954–2000 年的 12 张照相底片、1937 年哈佛底片上的边缘探测、2010–2017 年 VISTA 近红外图像、2016–2020 年 SkyMapper 图像以及 10 年 ATLAS 测光。**这些档案位置将长期历表改进约五倍**，并预测 2027–2030 年将发生 15 次 $G \leq 16.5$ mag 恒星的掩星，其中 6 次位于有人居住的陆地上空。自 1954 年以来地球视线方向已转过 $\sim 87^\circ$，但底片星等仍与现今相位曲线一致。逐底片拟合**排除了至少一半自转轴方向下 $c/a \leq 0.6$ 的扁球形状**，并在现今光变振幅低于 $\sim 0.11$–$0.15$ mag 时，对约 90% 的自转轴方向**排除了 Haumea 式 Jacobi 椭球**。作者找到暂定的 10.4 h 光变周期（若为双峰则约 20.7 h）。近红外颜色将其归入 BR（中等偏红）分类， $J-H = 0.60\pm0.15$，比 Haumea 更红，且没有类似的 $1.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 水冰吸收证据，**支持其并非 Haumea 族成员**。$z$ 波段测光还将类 Eris 甲烷限制在表面 $\lesssim 25\%$。$\pm 1$ Gyr 的轨道积分显示它可连续数十 Myr 停留在与海王星的 12:7 共振中，但**很少能永久保持捕获**。
summary: The trans-Neptunian object (TNO) 2026 ED$_{138}$ was discovered in early data from the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory, and recovered in Dark Energy Camera images back to 2016. With an absolute magnitude of $H_V = 3.11 \pm 0.05$ mag, it is one of the largest known TNOs, with a diameter of 635-1590 km for geometric albedos between 0.25 and 0.04. Its position far to the south and close to the galactic plane kept it hidden in images that recorded it for decades. Here, we present archival observations of 2026 ED$_{138}$ spanning 89 years: twelve photographic plates taken between 1954 and 2000, a marginal detection on a 1937 Harvard plate, 2010-2017 VISTA near-infrared images, 2016-2020 SkyMapper images, and ten years of ATLAS photometry. The archival positions improve the long-term ephemeris fivefold, and we predict 15 occultations of $G \leq 16.5$ mag stars in 2027-2030, six of which will occur over populated land. The line of sight from Earth has turned by $\sim87^\circ$ since 1954, yet the plate magnitudes remain consistent with the present-day phase curve. Fitted plate by plate, they exclude oblate shapes with $c/a \leq 0.6$ for at least half of all spin-axis orientations and, with a present-day light curve amplitude below $\sim0.11-0.15$ mag, a Haumea-like Jacobi ellipsoid for $\sim90\%$ of them. We find a tentative 10.4 h light curve period ($\sim20.7$ h if double-peaked). Near-infrared colors place 2026 ED$_{138}$ in the BR (intermediate red) taxonomic class, with $J-H = 0.60\pm0.15$, redder than Haumea and without evidence of similar 1.5 $μ$m water-ice absorption, supporting the conclusion that it is not a Haumea-family member. $z$-band photometry also limits Eris-like methane to $\lesssim25\%$ of the surface. Integrations over $\pm1$ Gyr show it sticks to the 12:7 resonance with Neptune for tens of megayears at a time, but it rarely remains permanently captured.

title: Bayesian and frequentist constraints on dark energy parameterizations using non-CMB data
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学把宇宙晚期的加速膨胀归因于暗能量，其核心观测量是状态方程参数 $w=p/\rho$，即压强与能量密度之比。标准宇宙学模型 ΛCDM 取宇宙学常数为暗能量，$w=-1$；若暗能量随时间演化，则 $w=w(z)$，并可能在演化中穿越 phantom divide $w=-1$。为限制 $w(z)$，观测上常用 Ia 型超新星（SNe）、重子声学振荡（BAO）、宇宙微波背景（CMB）、伽马射线暴（GRB）和红移空间畸变（RSD）等多探针联合分析：SNe 提供相对距离—红移关系，BAO 提供标准尺，CMB 提供早期宇宙与几何锚点，RSD 通过星系成团性限制结构增长，GRB 则有望把距离测量延伸到高红移。理论侧常把 $w(z)$ 写成少数参数的参数化形式，例如 CPL 的 $w(a)=w_0+w_a(1-a)$、thawing quintessence 类参数化 TQD 与 AT，以及广义涌现暗能量 GEDE。模型比较通常使用贝叶斯因子（Bayes factor）以及信息论指标 AIC、DIC：贝叶斯因子比较模型证据，并天然包含对先验体积的奥卡姆惩罚；AIC 与 DIC 以拟合优度和有效参数数惩罚复杂度，但构造与解释不同。因此，同一数据下不同统计指标可能给出不同偏好。
contribution: 论文仅使用非 CMB 数据，联合 DES-Dovekie 超新星（SNe）、DESI BAO DR2、伽马射线暴（GRB）与 RSD，构建 GRB+BAO、BAO+SNe、GRB+BAO+SNe 三组样本（每组均含 RSD），对 TQD、AT、CPL 与 GEDE 四种暗能量参数化同时进行贝叶斯与频率学派分析。结果显示：**GRB 对限制仅有边际贡献，SNe 则显著收紧限制**；**CPL 的状态方程在 $z\sim 0.5$ 出现 phantom crossing**，而 **TQD 与 AT 相对 ΛCDM 改善最佳拟合的 $\chi^2$，但不出现 phantom crossing**。引入 SNe 后，**TQD 受到 Bayes factor 的中等偏好，并受到 AIC 与 DIC 的正向偏好**；对 CPL 与 AT，**AIC 与 DIC 正向偏好扩展模型**，但 **Bayes factor 对 CPL 弱偏好 ΛCDM，对 AT 则不确定**，这一差异与 Bayes factor 中先验体积导致的奥卡姆惩罚一致。**GEDE 因把高红移暗能量密度压低，被三种指标一致排斥**。因此，**对动力学暗能量的偏好取决于参数化、数据集与比较指标**。
summary: Data from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) BAO combined with the cosmic microwave background (CMB) have provided evidence for dynamical dark energy (DDE) with a phantom crossing ($w(z) < -1$) when constraining $w_0-w_a$ parameterizations. Given the tension between BAO and CMB data within $Λ$CDM, we use only non-CMB data: Type Ia Supernovae (SNe) from the DES-Dovekie compilation, DESI BAO DR2, Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRBs) and Redshift-Space-Distortion (RSD) measurements. We use the dataset combinations GRB$+$BAO, BAO$+$SNe and GRB$+$BAO$+$SNe, each with RSD. We perform both Bayesian and frequentist analyses of two quintessence-inspired thawing dark energy parameterizations: the thawing quintessence parameterization (TQD) and the Algebraic Thawing parameterization (AT), together with the Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) and the Generalized Emergent Dark Energy parameterizations (GEDE). The GRB sample, used in this work, contributes only marginally to the constraints, while SNe tighten them considerably. The CPL equation of state shows a phantom crossing at $z\sim 0.5$, while TQD and AT improve the best-fit $χ^2$ over $Λ$CDM, without showing phantom crossing. When SNe are included, TQD is preferred by the Bayes factor (moderately), AIC and DIC (positively). For CPL and AT, AIC and DIC prefer the extended model positively, while the Bayes factor weakly prefers $Λ$CDM over CPL and is inconclusive for AT. This difference is consistent with the Occam penalty from the prior volume in the Bayes factor. GEDE, with the DE density restricted to be suppressed at high redshifts is disfavored by all three metrics. Hence, the preference for DDE depends on the parameterization, the dataset and the comparison metric used.

title: Detection and excision of radio-frequency interference in radio arrays
background_knowledge: 射电干涉测量利用多台天线同步接收同一天体信号，并通过基线之间的相位差合成等效大口径，最终得到可见度（visibility）并成像。射电频率干扰（radio-frequency interference，RFI）来自人造发射机、飞机、卫星等，常比遥远天体信号强得多；若不在相关或成像前识别并切除，就会污染连续谱、谱线、暂现源搜索和宇宙 dawn 等弱信号实验。传统 RFI 处理多把问题表述为“在某个给定数据产品中如何最好地识别 RFI”，常用阈值 flagging、互相关统计、自相关统计或 tied-array beam 监测。理解该问题的物理基础包括：天线主波束对入射波的衰减、近场波前曲率造成的基线间相位不一致、带宽消抹与条纹跟踪造成的相干损失，以及运动源导致的快速条纹旋转。互相关探测依赖不同天线接收到信号的相干性；自相关只使用单台天线自身功率，因而对跨天线相位失相干不敏感。阵列构型（紧凑填充或扩展稀疏）、源距离与运动速度会共同决定哪种数据产品对 RFI 最敏感。
contribution: 论文把“如何在给定数据产品中识别 RFI”推进为“给定 RFI 发射源在哪种数据产品中最容易被探测”，并建立统一模型，量化天线主波束、近场波前曲率、带宽消抹与条纹跟踪对可见度和 tied-array beam 中 RFI 的抑制。核心比较可归结为单个量：每基线 RFI 平均相干度。**只有在相干度高于 $(N-1)^{-1/2}$ 时，互相关探测才优于天线自相关；其中 $N$ 为天线数。** 对 VLA A/D、MeerKAT 与 DSA 四类阵列和五类距离 5 km 至中地球轨道的 RFI 源评估表明：**紧凑填充阵列对静止地面源更利于互相关探测，而扩展稀疏阵列则不然；对飞机及低、中轨道卫星等有明显相对运动的源，因快速条纹旋转破坏相干性，天线自相关之和在几乎所有情形下都优于互相关，优势可达 1 至 7 个数量级。** 对低于单天线噪声的 RFI，任何相位未知的互相关统计量都不比自相关求和更灵敏。**Tied-array beam 是最不灵敏的数据产品：阵列因子不能抑制地面 RFI，其探测能力等同于单天线。** 论文还给出面向 110 天线 DSA 的 GPU 实时自相关切除实现，并讨论对未来阵列设计的启示。
summary: The detection and excision of radio-frequency interference (RFI) is usually approached by asking how best to identify RFI within a given data product. I address a prior question: which data product is a given RFI emitter is most detectable in? I develop a model for the suppression of RFI in visibilities and tied-array beams by the antenna primary beam, near-field wavefront curvature, bandwidth smearing, and fringe tracking. The comparison between antenna-based and array-based detection reduces to a single quantity related to the mean per-baseline RFI coherence. Cross-correlation detection is preferred only above a coherence threshold of $(N-1)^{-1/2}$, where $N$ is the number of antennas. I evaluate this model for four array configurations (the Very Large Array A and D configurations, and the fixed MeerKAT and Deep Synoptic Array / DSA configurations) and five representative RFI emitters spanning distances of 5\,km to medium-Earth orbit. Compact, filled, arrays favor the cross-correlations for stationary terrestrial emitters, whereas extended sparse arrays do not. RFI emitters with significant motion relative to radio arrays, in particular aircraft and low- and medium-Earth-orbit satellites, favor the sum of antenna autocorrelations everywhere by one to seven orders of magnitude, because their coherence is destroyed by rapid fringe rotation. For RFI below the single-antenna noise, no phase-unknown cross-correlation statistic is more sensitive than the autocorrelation sum. Tied-array beams are the least sensitive data product of all: the array factor supplies no suppression of terrestrial RFI, so a beam sees an emitter as a single antenna does. I describe a real-time, GPU-based implementation of autocorrelation-based excision for the 110-antenna Deep Synoptic Array, and outline the design implications for upcoming arrays.

title: foraois: Fast, Flexible Extended Press-Schechter Merger Trees with a General First-Crossing Solver
background_knowledge: 现代结构形成理论以 ΛCDM 模型为基准：暗物质通过引力不稳定性从早期宇宙的近高斯密度涨落中分级成团，形成暗物质晕，并在其中心形成星系。线性密度场通常用功率谱 $P(k)$ 描述；对密度场在质量尺度 $M$ 上做滤波后，其涨落方差 $S(M)=\sigma^2(M)$ 随 $M$ 减小而增大。excursion-set（漂移集）理论把晕的形成视为随机游走在 $S$ 空间中首次越过坍缩阈值（barrier） $\delta_c$ 的事件；首次越过分布给出晕质量函数，而给定最终晕质量后的条件首次越过分布给出 progenitor 质量分布，进而构造合并树。合并树记录晕在宇宙时间中的并合与吸积历史，是连接暗物质结构形成与星系形成、半解析模型及数值模拟的重要工具。实际构建 Monte Carlo 合并树时，需要指定线性功率谱、滤波窗函数、坍缩阈值以及 progenitor 采样算法；不同暗物质模型会改变小尺度功率谱，而滤波与阈值的选择会影响首次越过问题的数学性质。
contribution: 论文发布并介绍了 foraois（Gaelic 意为 Forest，发音 FAW-reesh）：一个用于生成 Monte Carlo 暗物质晕合并树历史的开源 Python 框架。其核心设计是**将线性密度场描述、晕坍缩物理与合并树算法解耦**，使不同宇宙学模型、坍缩处方和建树方法可在统一框架中组合。foraois 针对同一个 excursion-set progenitor 采样问题实现两条路径：一是 Parkinson、Cole 与 Helly（2008）的半经验算法，对 EPS progenitor 分布施加拟合修正；二是 Zhang 与 Hui（2006）发展的 Markovian first-crossing 方程数值解，在默认实空间 top-hat 窗函数下对应相关随机游走问题的近似。框架可输入冷、温与模糊暗物质（CDM、WDM、FDM）的线性物质功率谱，模块化坍缩处理为替代 barrier 模型提供扩展点，并支持基于 Nadler 等（2023）Brownian-bridge 构造的约束合并历史。作者进行了广泛的验证与扩展性测试，并给出将 foraois 与轻量级半解析星系形成模型耦合的示例，**表明该框架可作为可复现、可扩展的暗物质晕组装与星系形成建模工具**。
summary: We present foraois (Gaelic for Forest; FAW-reesh), an open-source Python framework for generating Monte Carlo dark matter halo merger tree histories. foraois separates the description of the linear density field, the physics of halo collapse, and the algorithmic construction of halo merger histories, allowing different cosmologies, collapse prescriptions, and tree building approaches to be combined within a common framework. The package implements two approaches to the same merger-tree problem of sampling progenitor masses in the excursion-set picture: the semi-empirical algorithm of Parkinson, Cole, & Helly (2008), which applies a fitted correction to the EPS progenitor distribution, and the numerical solution of the Markovian first-crossing equation developed by Zhang & Hui (2006), which for the default real-space top-hat window is an approximation to the correlated-walk problem. Linear matter power spectra for Cold, Warm, and Fuzzy Dark Matter (CDM, WDM, and FDM) can be supplied, while the modular collapse treatment provides an extension point for alternative barrier models. The framework also supports constrained merger histories based on the Brownian-bridge construction of Nadler et al. (2023). We run extensive validation and scaling tests, and also show an illustrative example of coupling foraois to a light-weight semi-analytical model of galaxy formation.

title: The Agentic Observer Hackathon: Autonomous Decision-making in Simulated Astronomical Surveys
background_knowledge: 天文巡天的观测运行本质上是一个受多约束支配的序贯决策问题：在有限的望远镜时间、可见性窗口、天气条件、仪器状态与科学优先级下，需要决定指向、曝光配置和目标分配，并在出现观测请求、仪器故障或数据丢失时动态调整。传统上，这类问题依赖队列调度、启发式规则与数值优化；近年来，借助机器学习与语言模型进行自主决策成为新的探索方向。由于真实巡天难以重复比较不同策略，构建可复现的合成巡天模拟器、设定统一的曝光响应与分配约束，并组织社区基准测试，成为研究自主观测系统的重要范式。该方向连接观测天文学、运筹优化与人工智能，核心挑战包括长期规划、故障恢复、科学优先级变化下的策略稳健性以及可解释性。
contribution: 论文提出 Agentic Observer Hackathon（AOH），一个用于研究自主巡天运行的社区挑战。参与系统在具有预设曝光响应和分配约束的合成多目标巡天中，选择指向、分配目标并选择曝光配置，同时应对观测请求、仪器故障和数据丢失。作者在保留的评估 campaign 上评测了 102 支团队提交的系统，并在一个参考 campaign 中分析目标完成情况。**领先系统将数值曝光规划与语言模型结合，用语言模型解释运行信息并支持较长周期的决策**。探索性测试显示，在若干系统中接入模型后故障报告有所改善；而**修改科学优先级会显著改变系统排名**。参考 campaign 追踪了目标完成过程，并诊断出基线方法在推断预设质量波段时存在错误。论文发布的模拟器与参考策略为比较曝光分配、目标选择以及中断恢复能力提供了共同的巡天条件。
summary: Astronomical surveys must allocate observing time while responding to changing conditions and competing scientific priorities. We present the Agentic Observer Hackathon (AOH), a community challenge for studying autonomous survey operations. Within a synthetic multi-object survey with prescribed exposure responses and assignment constraints, decision systems select pointings, assign targets and choose exposure configurations while responding to observing requests, instrumental faults and data loss. We evaluate systems submitted by 102 teams on campaigns reserved for evaluation and analyse target completion in a reference campaign. The leading systems combine numerical exposure planning with language models for interpreting operational information and supporting longer-term decisions. Exploratory tests show improved fault reporting with model access in several systems, while revised scientific priorities produce substantial changes in ranking. The reference campaign traces target completion and diagnoses errors in the baseline's inference of prescribed quality bands. The released simulator and reference strategies provide common survey conditions for comparing exposure allocation, target selection and recovery from interruptions.

title: Cuscuton Fifth Force: Implications of Non-Dynamical Scalars for Structure Growth
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学把宇宙加速膨胀归因于暗能量，或把晚期加速视为修改引力的信号。标量场是描述暗能量和修改引力最常用的语言之一：它既可有动力学演化，也可通过共形耦合或 disformal 耦合改变物质粒子的质量与引力作用。若标量场能传播，通常会在亚毫米到太阳系尺度上产生第五力，因此实际模型必须依靠屏蔽机制或极小的耦合来满足实验约束。结构形成是检验这类模型的敏感探针：背景膨胀历史决定距离与时间，线性密度扰动的增长则直接受有效引力耦合、物质质量演化和摩擦项影响；这些效应会印在宇宙微波背景温度与极化各向异性、物质功率谱以及重子声学振荡的声学尺度上。Cuscuton 是一类特殊标量场，其方程是约束方程而非演化方程，因而不引入传播的标量自由度；但它仍可通过代数关系修改引力，是研究“无传播自由度却产生第五力”这一范式的代表性理论。理解其宇宙学效应，需要自洽求解背景演化、线性扰动、复合历史以及 $\Lambda$CDM 之外的观测预言。
contribution: 论文在物质于 Jordan 框架最小耦合、从而在 Einstein 框架与 cuscuton 共形耦合的设定下，研究有效 cuscuton 理论的宇宙学。作者推导背景与线性扰动方程，并发现 **即使 cuscuton 本身不传播，其代数响应仍可媒介第五力**。同一共形因子还改变 Einstein 框架中的粒子质量和物质扰动摩擦，使第五力的强度与符号由背景演化决定，而非来自一个独立的耦合常数。作者研究一类幂律模型，其中同时包含追踪解与符号切换解；在后一类解中，**有效 cuscuton 密度在物质主导时期为负，到今天变为正的、类宇宙学常数的值**。利用修改版 CLASS，并计入粒子质量变化对复合过程的影响，作者对基准模型展示了 CMB 温度谱与线性物质功率谱的相应改变，而未拟合观测数据。**在最强基准模型中，第五力使亚视界尺度的有效引力耦合 $G_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 改变约 $1\%$，但这一改变小于同时出现的物质功率谱和声学尺度变化；对符号切换解，该改变在大部分宇宙历史中为负，表明非传播标量场可以削弱而非增强引力吸引。**
summary: The cuscuton is a scalar field that obeys a constraint rather than an evolution equation, so it modifies gravity without adding a propagating scalar degree of freedom. We study the cosmology of effective cuscuton theory when matter is minimally coupled in the Jordan frame, and therefore conformally coupled to the cuscuton in the Einstein-frame. We derive the background and linear perturbation equations and show that the algebraic cuscuton response mediates a fifth force even though the scalar itself does not propagate. The same conformal factor also changes Einstein-frame particle masses and the friction of matter perturbations, tying the strength and sign of the force to the background evolution rather than to an independent coupling. We study a power-law family of models which contain both tracking solutions and sign-switching solutions; in the latter the effective cuscuton density runs from negative during matter domination to a positive, cosmological-constant-like value today. Using a modified version of CLASS, including the induced particle-mass dependence of recombination, we illustrate the corresponding changes to CMB temperature and linear matter power spectra for benchmark models, without fitting to data. In the strongest benchmarks the fifth force changes the effective gravitational coupling on sub-horizon scales by about one percent, smaller than the accompanying changes to the matter power spectrum and the acoustic scale. For the sign-switching solutions this change is negative over most of cosmic history, so a non-propagating field can weaken rather than strengthen gravitational attraction.

title: MARTA: A "little" black hole hidden in a clumpy, metal-poor galaxy at z~3.8
background_knowledge: 在 $z\gtrsim 3$ 的高红移宇宙中，寻找低质量、正在吸积的黑洞是理解黑洞种子、早期增长以及黑洞—星系共同演化的关键。活动星系核（AGN）的宽发射线来自高速绕转的宽线区气体，在允许维里估计时可用于测量黑洞质量；结合连续谱或发射线光度可估计爱丁顿比 $\lambda_{\rm Edd}$。本地星系中黑洞质量与核球质量或恒星质量存在紧密标度关系，但其高红移、低质量端的外推与演化仍不确定。JWST 的近红外光谱和成像使 $z\sim 4$–$8$、恒星质量 $\sim10^8\,M_\odot$ 的星系及其微弱 AGN 信号变得可测；这类星系常呈团块状、金属贫乏，且可能具有显著 Ly$\alpha$ 逃逸，因而可把黑洞增长、恒星组装和电离光子逃逸放在同一对象中研究。
contribution: 论文报告在 $z=3.7694$ 的团块状、金属贫乏星系 MARTA 3887 中发现一个低质量黑洞候选体，结合深场 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱、HST 与 JWST 成像以及归档 VLT/MUSE 数据。作者探测到宽 H$\alpha$ 成分，其 $L_{\rm H\alpha,b}=2.35\times10^{41}\,{\rm erg\,s^{-1}}$、FWHM $=1270^{+260}_{-250}\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$，且没有同等宽度的 [O III] 对应体。在宽线区解释下，维里定标给出 $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot)=6.52^{+0.18}_{-0.23}$ 与 $\lambda_{\rm Edd}=0.07$（替代定标下可至 0.38）。宿主至少由三个致密团块组成，$\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=8.16^{+0.09}_{-0.10}$。若窄线主要由恒星光电离主导，则气体高度电离且金属贫乏，$12+\log({\rm O/H})=7.68\pm0.04$（约 $0.10\,Z_\odot$）。推断的 $M_{\rm BH}/M_\star=2.3\%$ 比外推的本地关系高约 2 dex，**表明黑洞增长已超过所观测宿主的恒星组装**。若增长仅始于观测恒星质量的前 10% 形成时（$t_{10}=92$ Myr 前），$10^2\,M_\odot$ 的种子将要求生命周期平均爱丁顿比约 5.7；更早开始增长或采用更重的种子（如直接坍缩黑洞）则允许亚爱丁顿平均吸积。MUSE 显示延展 Ly$\alpha$ 发射（约 6.5–6.9 proper kpc），相对系统速度偏移 $+64^{+10}_{-8}\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$，暂定逃逸分数约 0.44。结合接近光学薄极限的 Mg II 双线比和高 [O III]/[O II] 比，**MARTA 3887 成为联合研究黑洞增长、恒星组装与电离光子逃逸的实验室**。
summary: JWST has extended the search for accreting black holes into the high-redshift, low-mass regime. We report a low-mass black hole candidate in MARTA 3887, a clumpy, metal-poor galaxy at $z=3.7694$, combining deep JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy, HST and JWST imaging, and archival VLT/MUSE data. We detect a broad H$α$ component with $L_{\rm Hα,b}=2.35\times10^{41}$ erg s$^{-1}$ and FWHM $=1270^{+260}_{-250}$ km s$^{-1}$, with no [O III] counterpart of comparable width. Under a broad-line-region interpretation, virial calibrations give $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot)=6.52^{+0.18}_{-0.23}$ and $λ_{\rm Edd}=0.07$, or up to 0.38 for alternative calibrations. The host comprises at least three compact clumps, with $\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=8.16^{+0.09}_{-0.10}$. If stellar photoionization dominates the narrow lines, the gas is highly ionized and metal poor, with $12+\log({\rm O/H})=7.68\pm0.04$ ($\simeq0.10\,Z_\odot$). The inferred $M_{\rm BH}/M_\star=2.3\%$ lies about 2 dex above the extrapolated local relation, suggesting that black-hole growth has outpaced the assembly of the observed host. If growth began only when the first 10% of the observed stellar mass had formed ($t_{10}=92$ Myr ago), a $10^2\,M_\odot$ seed would require a lifetime-mean Eddington ratio $\simeq5.7$; earlier growth or a more massive, e.g. direct-collapse, seed would allow sub-Eddington mean accretion. MUSE reveals extended Ly$α$ emission ($\simeq6.5$-6.9 proper kpc), offset by $+64^{+10}_{-8}$ km s$^{-1}$ from systemic, with a provisional escape fraction of $\simeq0.44$. Together with a Mg II doublet ratio close to the optically thin limit and a high [O III]/[O II] ratio, this makes MARTA 3887 a laboratory to study black-hole growth, stellar assembly, and ionizing-photon escape jointly.

title: EMBER: A Little Red Dot Candidate at $z_{\rm spec}=10.36$ in the Seed Black Hole Era
background_knowledge: 高红移黑洞与活动星系核（AGN）研究关注宇宙早期种子黑洞如何形成并快速增长。理论上前者可能来自第一代大质量恒星的遗迹（轻种子，约百倍太阳质量），也可能来自早期星系气体直接坍缩形成的重种子（约万至十万倍太阳质量）；后者需要在宇宙年龄很小时增长到超大质量黑洞，因而对吸积效率和周围气体环境提出严峻限制。JWST 发现的小红点（Little Red Dots，LRDs）是一类紧凑、在静止光学波段偏红、在紫外偏蓝并呈 V 型连续谱的天体，可能对应被致密气体包围、正在快速吸积的黑洞，从而连接种子黑洞与明亮 AGN。该领域的研究范式通常包括：利用多波段成像筛选候选体，借助 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱测量红移与谱线，使用宽线、禁线诊断和连续谱斜率判断 AGN 性质，并通过中红外颜色与光谱探测尘埃辐射。红移 $z>10$ 时，宇宙处于种子黑洞形成与早期增长的 key 时代，Ly$\alpha$ 断崖和星际介质吸收使光谱证认尤为关键。
contribution: 利用 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱，作者测得目标天体的光谱红移为 $z_{\rm spec}=10.361^{+0.003}_{-0.002}$，**这是迄今红移最高的 LRD 候选体，首次把此类天体的光谱红移测量推进到 $z>10$**。该红移由显著的 Ly$\alpha$ 断崖以及多个暂定发射线限制，包括信噪比分别为 $3.9$ 和 $3.6$ 的 C IV $\lambda\lambda1549,1551$ 与 [O III] $\lambda4363$。其极端的 NIRCam-MIRI 颜色 $m_{\rm F444W}-m_{\rm F770W}=1.82\pm0.1$、在 Balmer 限附近转折的 V 型连续谱，以及连续谱斜率 $\beta_{\rm UV}=-2.26^{+0.11}_{-0.11}$ 和 $\beta_{\rm opt}=1.17^{+0.74}_{-0.70}$，均支持其 LRD 性质。可能的铁复合体（静止波长约 $0.24$--$0.25\,{\rm \mu m}$）和可能偏高的 $\log\left([{\rm O\,III}]\,\lambda4363/{\rm H}\gamma\right)=0.17^{+0.24}_{-0.22}$ 进一步支持 AGN 样解释，这与已知 LRD 的行为一致。暂定探测到的 Ly$\alpha$ 发射可能暗示 $z\sim10$ 处 Ly$\alpha$ 透射增强。**该工作把黑洞增长的观测前沿延伸到种子黑洞形成时代**，未来 MIRI 光谱将有助于最终确定该天体的物理本质。
summary: Little red dots (LRDs) are a newly discovered population that may trace rapidly growing black holes (BHs) and provide a link between seed BHs and luminous active galactic nuclei (AGNs). However, no LRD had previously been spectroscopically confirmed at $z>10$, leaving this earliest phase observationally unexplored. Using JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy from the EMBER program, we measure a spectroscopic redshift of $z_{\rm spec}=10.361^{+0.003}_{-0.002}$ for \target, the highest-redshift LRD candidate known to date. The redshift is constrained by a prominent Ly$α$ break and multiple tentative emission lines, including C\,{\sc iv}\,$λ\lambda1549,1551$ and [O\,{\sc iii}]\,$\lambda4363$ detected at $S/N=3.9$ and $3.6$, respectively. Its extreme NIRCam-MIRI color of $m_{\rm F444W}-m_{\rm F770W}=1.82\pm0.1$, characteristic V-shaped continuum with a turnover near the Balmer limit, and continuum slopes of $β_{\rm UV}=-2.26^{+0.11}_{-0.11}$ and $β_{\rm opt}=1.17^{+0.74}_{-0.70}$ all support its LRD nature. A possible iron complex at $λ_{\rm rest}\sim0.24$--$0.25\,{\rm μm}$ and a possibly high $\log\left([{\rm O\,III]\,\lambda4363/\rm Hγ}\right)=0.17^{+0.24}_{-0.22}$ further support an AGN-like interpretation, as seen in previously known LRDs. Tentative detection of Ly$α$ emission may indicate enhanced Ly$α$ transmission at $z\sim10$. Our findings extend the observational frontier of BH growth into the seed-BH formation era, and upcoming MIRI spectroscopy will further establish the physical nature of the source.

title: First-principles calculations of far-wing absorption in He-broadened CO2 infrared spectra
background_knowledge: 系外行星大气表征依赖于对透射光谱、发射光谱及反射光谱的辐射转移 modeling（建模），其中分子不透明度是连接观测光谱与大气温度、压强、化学成分和气候状态的关键物理量。对于以 H/He 为主的大气，压力展宽决定吸收线轮廓；线核心附近常可用 Lorentz 轮廓近似，但远翼可能显著偏离 Lorentz 行为，出现 sub-Lorentzian 或 super-Lorentzian 修正。若忽略远翼吸收，就会影响连续谱、窗口区及强带的等效宽度，进而偏差大气反演结果。${\rm CO}_2$ 的 $4.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 强红外带是 JWST 观测系外行星大气的重要诊断特征之一，而 He 碰撞展宽在富 He 或 H/He 大气中不可忽略。传统实验数据在宽温度范围和远翼区域有限，因此需要基于分子动力学与半经典线型理论的 first-principles（第一性原理）或理论辅助建模，并发展随温度变化的不透明度修正因子，用于 line-by-line 或相关 k-distribution 计算。
contribution: 作者针对 He 展宽 ${\rm CO}_2$ 的远翼吸收，开展了覆盖 $200$–$1000\ \mathrm{K}$ 的理论预测与建模，并面向系外行星大气不透明度计算。首先，采用 requantized classical molecular dynamics simulations（重量子化经典分子动力学模拟）预测 ${\rm CO}_2$ 的 $4.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 带远翼吸收，**所得结果与现有室温实验数据高度一致**。随后，将理论预测与测量数据结合，参数化 impact energy-corrected sudden 模型，**该模型能够在 $200$–$1000\ \mathrm{K}$ 范围内准确重现 He 展宽 ${\rm CO}_2$ 在多个红外光谱区的远翼吸收**。最后，为应用于系外行星大气不透明度计算，作者导出了随温度变化的 $\chi$-factor 修正，**用于刻画 ${\rm CO}_2$ 主要红外带远翼的 sub-Lorentzian 行为**。
summary: We report theoretical predictions and modeling of the far-wing absorption of CO2 broadened by He over a wide temperature range (200-1000 K), which are relevant for exoplanet atmosphere studies. Accurate modeling of He-broadened CO2 absorption is essential for opacity calculations used to characterize the composition, structure, and climate of exoplanet atmospheres. In particular, the strong CO2 band at 4.3 mum has been clearly identified in the spectra of several exoplanets observed with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). Requantized classical molecular dynamics simulations were first performed to predict absorption in the far wings of the 4.3 mum band of CO2. The resulting predictions show excellent agreement with available experimental data at room temperature. The theoretical predictions and measured data were then used to parameterize an impact energy-corrected sudden model, which allowed us to accurately reproduce the far-wing absorption of He-broadened CO2 in several infrared spectral regions over the (200-1000) K temperature range. Finally, for applications to exoplanet atmosphere opacity calculations, we derived temperature-dependent chi-factor corrections that account for the sub-Lorentzian behavior of the far wing of the major infrared bands of CO2.

title: Boosted Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Lane-Emden Type Equations
background_knowledge: 该工作属于科学机器学习与非线性微分方程数值求解的交叉方向，并以天体物理中的 Lane-Emden 方程为典型应用背景。Lane-Emden 方程常写为 $ \frac{1}{\xi^2}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}\xi}\left(\xi^2\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}\xi}\right)+\theta^n=0 $，用于描述多方气体球、恒星结构以及热行为等物理情形。该方程是非线性常微分方程，且在原点处具有坐标奇异性，通常需满足中心边界条件 $ \theta(0)=1 $ 与 $ \theta'(0)=0 $；除少数幂次 $ n $ 外，一般缺乏解析解，因此长期依赖数值积分或近似方法。近年来，Physics-Informed Neural Networks（PINNs）通过将微分方程残差、初边值条件编码进损失函数，可在无需传统网格剖分的框架下求解正问题与反问题；但其精度与稳健性会受到优化困难、损失函数多目标权衡以及神经网络近似误差的限制。提升 PINNs 对强非线性、奇异或非齐次微分方程的求解精度，是该方向的重要研究目标。
contribution: 论文提出一种将 Physics-Informed Neural Networks（PINNs）与 boosting 方法结合的新型混合框架，用于求解齐次与非齐次的 Lane-Emden 型方程。其核心是在标准 PINN 预测之后增加一个后处理 boosting 阶段：利用 LightGBM、Random Forest、XGBoost 与 Support Vector Regression（SVR）等回归算法对 PINN 预测的残差进行建模，再将这些 boosted 模型的输出进行聚合，从而得到经过修正的高保真预测。作者通过定量指标与相对标准 PINN 基线的对比分析系统验证了该方法，结果表明 **boosted PINN 框架能够显著降低预测误差并提升泛化能力**，为求解由微分方程支配的科学与工程问题提供了一种强大而灵活的思路。
summary: The Lane-Emden Equation is a class of nonlinear differential equations commonly used to model phenomena in astrophysics and mathematical physics, such as stellar structure and thermal behavior in polytropic gas spheres. This study presents a novel hybrid framework that integrates Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with boosting methods to enhance the accuracy and robustness of solutions for Lane-Emden type differential equations. Standard PINNs leverage physical laws encoded within the loss function, but their predictive performance can be constrained by optimization challenges and approximation errors. To address this, we introduce a post-processing boosting stage where the residual errors from the PINN prediction are modeled using some regression algorithms - including LightGBM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The outputs from these boosted models are aggregated to generate a corrected, high-fidelity prediction. The proposed methodology is systematically validated through quantitative metrics and comparative analysis against the standard PINN baseline. The results demonstrate that the boosted PINN framework significantly reduces prediction error, and improves generalization, offering a powerful and flexible approach for solving scientific and engineering problems governed by differential equations.

title: From Rock Tumbling to Telescope Mirror Grinding: How Optical Perfection Emerges from Random Motion
background_knowledge: 该主题属于天文光学制造与统计物理的交叉，而非某一传统天体物理分支。望远镜主镜的成像质量取决于反射面面形；传统手工研磨把两块玻璃盘之间夹磨料相对摩擦，表面会在随机行程中逐渐趋于相互吻合的球面，面形误差可达几十纳米。核心物理图像是：磨料在压力下造成微量材料去除，局部去除率由 Preston 定律给出，即单位时间去除量正比于接触压强与相对滑动速度，可写为 $\dot z \propto p v$。单次行程看似随机且局部，但大量行程的平均效果由几何对称性与边界条件决定，可把表面演化视为一种扩散或弛豫过程。研究范式是先用对称性找出平衡面形，再分析其对小尺度粗糙度与大尺度面形偏差的稳定性，并比较不同物理过程的特征时间尺度。该框架也适用于滚石打磨、砂纸磨平等日常现象，并可作为课堂案例说明稳定与不稳定平衡、指数弛豫、扩散、时间尺度分离，以及局部平均如何产生 Laplacian 算符。
contribution: 作者从 Preston 材料去除定律出发，建立了手工研磨玻璃盘面形演化的第一性原理模型。由于研磨行程的对称性，**平面与球面是这一过程的普适平衡态**。其稳定性由一组时间尺度层级控制：小尺度不规则性以研磨时间尺度 $T_\text{grind}$ 指数衰减；偏离球面的大尺度分量则以更长的球化时间尺度 $T_\text{sphere} \propto (R_\text{mirror}/R_\text{stroke})^2\, T_\text{grind}$ 扩散消失。重力和有限圆盘尺寸会破坏平面平衡，但在行程足够短时球面保持稳定，即 $T_\text{deform} \gg T_\text{sphere}$，仅曲率半径发生绝热变化。该框架统一解释了望远镜镜面研磨、滚石打磨与砂纸磨削：旋转滚筒比振动滚筒更易磨圆边缘，而二者都不会产生球面；小面积平面在砂磨中不可避免地变圆。该工作还提供了一个可用于课堂的案例，展示稳定与不稳定平衡、指数弛豫、扩散、多时间尺度分析，以及 Laplacian 算符如何从局部区域平均中涌现。
summary: When two glass disks are rubbed together by hand with an abrasive between them, their surfaces spontaneously converge to perfectly matching spherical curves, accurate to tens of nanometers. How does such optical precision emerge from an essentially random manual process? Starting from Preston's law of material removal, we derive a first-principles explanation. Symmetries of the grinding stroke imply that planes and spheres are the generic equilibria of the process. Their stability is governed by a hierarchy of timescales: small-scale irregularities decay exponentially on the grinding timescale $T_\text{grind}$, while large-scale deviations from a sphere diffuse away on the longer spherizing timescale $T_\text{sphere} \propto (R_\text{mirror}/R_\text{stroke})^2\, T_\text{grind}$. Gravity and finite disk size destabilize planar surfaces, but for sufficiently short strokes spheres remain stable ($T_\text{deform} \gg T_\text{sphere}$), with only their radius of curvature varying adiabatically. The same framework unifies telescope mirror grinding with everyday phenomena: rock tumbling (explaining why rotary tumbling rounds edges more than vibratory, and why neither produce spheres) and sanding (explaining why small flat surfaces inevitably round). These examples offer an accessible classroom context for stable and unstable equilibria, exponential relaxation, diffusion, multi-timescale analysis, and the emergence of the Laplacian operator from averaging over a local area.

title: Aperture Photometric Accuracy of Point-spread-function-deconvolved Astronomical Images
background_knowledge: 在天文观测中，望远镜与探测器会把点源成像为具有有限宽度的点扩散函数（PSF），延展天体的观测图像则是其真实亮度分布与 PSF 的卷积。进行孔径测光时，通常要在扣除背景后对目标区域求和；若 PSF 较宽、目标彼此混合或视场拥挤，邻近源混入、源重叠以及复杂仪器 PSF 的翼部都会引入系统偏差。反卷积旨在从观测图像中恢复更高分辨率的天体亮度分布，Richardson--Lucy（RL）迭代是常用方法，但它会放大噪声并产生振铃、负值或伪结构，尤其在高动态范围和复杂 PSF 条件下更为显著。低通预滤波可以压制噪声，却可能损失流量；负值回填、噪声回填以及将滤波时滤除的噪声重新注入等策略，试图在抑制伪影的同时保持总流量守恒。该方向属于天文图像处理与测光方法学，服务于空间与地面巡天数据的精确测光、源证认及后续科学分析。
contribution: 本文提出改进的 Richardson--Lucy（RL）反卷积框架，结合负值回填（negative backfilling, NB）与新算法 FiDNoBa（filtered image deconvolution and noise backfilling）。该方法在 RL 迭代前引入低通预滤波（采用 Kalman 滤波），并在迭代后将滤除的噪声成分重新注入，从而在抑制噪声伪影的同时保持严格的流量完整性。作者通过数值模拟与真实观测系统评估 Kalman + RL + NB 方法：**在孤立源情形将相对平均偏差（RMD）降至 1% 以下；对混合 Sérsic 星系保持高保真度（RMD 约 0.37%）；在拥挤恒星场达到约 5% 的 RMD，并显著提高源恢复率**，优于传统 PSF 测光。研究还在 JWST/NIRCam 空间图像与 VST OmegaCAM 地面图像上验证 FiDNoBa 的实用性，表明其能可靠处理复杂仪器特征（如 STPSF 的延展翼部），**有效减轻传统 RL 反卷积典型的严重振铃伪影，并在实际巡天处理中获得高度稳定的孔径测光**。
summary: This paper introduces an improved Richardson--Lucy (RL) framework utilizing negative backfilling (NB) and the novel filtered image deconvolution and noise backfilling (FiDNoBa) algorithm. By integrating a low-pass prefiltering stage---specifically employing a Kalman filter---with the reintegration of filtered-out noise components after RL iterations, we effectively suppress noise artifacts while maintaining rigorous flux integrity. We extensively evaluate our Kalman + RL + NB approach using both numerical simulations and real observational data. Simulations across three regimes demonstrate superior photometric accuracy, reducing the relative mean deviation (RMD) to below 1\% for isolated sources, maintaining high fidelity (RMD $\sim$0.37\%) for blended Sérsic galaxies, and achieving $\sim$5\% RMD in crowded stellar fields while significantly increasing source recovery rates compared to traditional point-spread function photometry. Crucially, we validate the practical efficacy of FiDNoBa on real space-based (JWST/NIRCam) and ground-based (Very Large Telescope Survey Telescope OmegaCAM) images. The results confirm that our method reliably handles complex instrumental signatures, such as the extended wings of the STPSF, mitigating the severe ringing artifacts typical of traditional RL deconvolution while ensuring highly stable aperture photometry in practical survey processing.

title: An Unusually Clumpy Ultra-Diffuse Galaxy in the Coma Cluster: A Missing Link for Globular Cluster Formation?
background_knowledge: 超弥散星系（ultra-diffuse galaxy，UDG）是一类有效半径可达数 kpc、中心表面亮度极低、恒星质量与尺寸关系明显偏离普通矮星系的星系，常出现在星系团及近邻宇宙中。其形成机制仍是星系演化研究的重要问题，可能涉及早期恒星形成熄灭、星系团环境作用、并合与反馈等过程。UDG 的球状星团（globular cluster，GC）系统数量跨度很大，被视为约束其形成历史和暗物质性质的重要探针。星系团内介质（intracluster medium，ICM）与星系高速相对运动可产生冲压剥离（ram-pressure stripping，RPS），移除冷气体、改变恒星形成并留下不对称的形态与运动学特征。恒星形成团块是致密星团形成的潜在场所，可能演化为球状星团或星团复合体。积分场光谱（integral-field spectroscopy，IFS）与深成像能够空间分辨地测量恒星形成历史、气体运动学和金属丰度；相空间（phase-space）位置则可用于判断星系在星系团中的落入阶段。
contribution: 作者利用 Keck Cosmic Web Imager 积分场光谱和 Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam 深成像，研究了 Coma 星系团外围的 Coma-B122——一个异常多团块的恒星形成超弥散星系。研究发现，B122 拥有约 10 个明亮恒星形成团块，这些团块贡献约 25% 的光度和约 7% 的恒星质量，典型团块质量约为 $10^6\ M_\odot$，与近邻星暴矮星系中最 massive 的超星团相当，并呈独特的环状分布，半径约 $2\ \mathrm{kpc}$。全光谱拟合表明，弥漫星系主体约 12.5% 的恒星质量形成于过去约 $300\ \mathrm{Myr}$ 的延长增强恒星形成事件，且所有团块均在该时段内形成。B122 显示出弱冲压剥离的证据：面向 Coma 中心一侧的弥散光分布被截断，而另一侧延伸，同时 H I 速度剖面不对称。其有序的恒星与电离气体旋转、冷气体比例以及相空间位置均与早期落入阶段一致。团块恒星形成历史和气相丰度的空间变化进一步表明，RPS 驱动的贫金属气体流入可能触发并维持了近期恒星形成。**B122 可能提供了 UDG 在星系团落入过程中组装球状星团系统的罕见现世样本**，但团块能否最终存活为 GC 仍不确定。未来更高空间分辨率的观测及更多类似天体的研究，将有助于完整理解多团块低表面亮度矮星系的形成与演化。
summary: We present a study of Coma-B122, an unusually clumpy star-forming ultra-diffuse galaxy (UDG) in the Coma cluster outskirts, using deep Keck Cosmic Web Imager integral-field spectroscopy and Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam imaging. B122 hosts $\sim10$ luminous star-forming clumps contributing $\sim25$% of its luminosity and $\sim7$% of its stellar mass, with typical clump masses of $\sim10^6\ M_\odot$ comparable to the most massive super star clusters known in nearby starbursting dwarfs. The clumps form a distinctive ring configuration $\sim2$ kpc from the center. Full-spectrum fitting shows that $\sim12.5$% of the diffuse body's stellar mass formed during an extended episode of enhanced star formation over the past $\sim300$ Myr, within which all the clumps assembled. B122 shows evidence of weak ram-pressure stripping (RPS), including a diffuse light distribution truncated on the side facing the Coma center and extended to the opposite side, along with an asymmetric H I velocity profile. Its ordered stellar and ionized-gas rotation, cold gas fraction, and phase-space position are consistent with an early stage of infall. Spatial variations in clump star formation histories and gas-phase abundances further indicate that RPS-driven metal-poor gas inflow may have triggered and sustained the recent star formation. B122 may offer a rare present-day view of how UDGs assemble their globular cluster (GC) systems during cluster infall, although it remains uncertain if the clumps could survive as GCs. Future observations with higher spatial resolution and of more analogs are important to provide a complete picture of the formation and evolution of clumpy low-surface-brightness dwarf galaxies.

title: Choosing a generator for streaming Gaussian noise in gravitational-wave mock data: accuracy, cost and reproducibility
background_knowledge:
引力波探测器（如 Advanced LIGO、Virgo、KAGRA）测量的是时空应变 $h(t)$ 的极微小变化，实际数据由探测器噪声主导。对多数搜索与参数估计任务，噪声可近似为在分析频带内平稳的彩色高斯噪声，其统计性质由单边功率谱密度 $S_n(f)$ 描述；探测器设计曲线中的窄谱线（如电源线、悬摆线）使谱形复杂。Mock data challenge 需要生成长时间、与给定 $S_n(f)$ 一致且可重复的噪声流，以验证探测流程，因此生成器不仅要统计正确，还要兼顾吞吐、内存状态和按位精确重生成。
\n常见生成范式包括：将白噪声通过频域整形或时域滤波器变成目标谱；直接频域整形会遇到数据段边界和环绕效应，标准引力波库常采用独立窗口加权拼接（crossfade）；也可用 overlap-save 有限冲激响应（FIR）滤波、AR/ARMA 递归模型，或 PyCBC 的可复现滤波。评价生成器的一个严格指标是分析频带内生成噪声协方差与目标协方差的误差；该误差可由生成器代数直接计算，生成样本只用于核验实现。另一个关键问题是目标谱在分析频带外如何延拓：若在带边直接截断，滤波器设计或窗口拼接可能在带内引入显著偏差。Crossfade 还会带来周期性非平稳性（cyclostationarity），需区分其循环分量与平稳分量对误差的贡献。
contribution:
论文系统比较了面向引力波 mock data 的长时间彩色高斯噪声生成器：标准引力波库中的独立窗口 crossfade、overlap-save FIR 滤波、AR 与 ARMA 模型，以及 PyCBC 的可复现滤波器。作者以分析频带内协方差相对目标的误差作为统一判据，该误差由各生成器的代数结构计算，生成噪声仅用于检查实现；同时测量吞吐、保留状态大小和按位精确重生成的代价。
\n主要结论是：当目标谱在分析频带以下平滑延拓时，**窗口不短于 $256$ s 的 crossfade 在列出的全部十一条探测器曲线上误差低于 $10^{-3}$**，吞吐约 **470 万样本每秒**，仅需数百字节状态。Overlap-save 滤波更快，但达到百分之几误差需要数万个抽头；所有测试的 AR/ARMA 配置都不在精度—吞吐前沿上。若要求误差为 $10^{-3}$，所需窗口为 **$8$ 到 $235$ s**，在含窄谱线的设计曲线上最长，且依赖谱的制表方式。若像当前生成器默认那样在分析带边直接截断目标谱，**所有方法在 projected Advanced LIGO（aLIGO）O4 曲线上的误差都高于 $1/2$**，crossfade 在另外五条曲线上也如此。Crossfade 是循环平稳的；在目标谱延拓情形下，其循环部分只有在 $8$ s 窗口、aLIGO O4 以及 Virgo 和 KAGRA 设计曲线上才成为误差的主要部分，而在 aLIGO O3 以及 Virgo 和 KAGRA 设计曲线上与平稳部分相差不超过因子 $2$。作者推荐使用 crossfade，窗口按探测器曲线表选取，并对分析频带以下的目标谱作平滑延拓。
summary: Mock data challenges need long stretches of colored Gaussian noise with a prescribed spectrum. The candidates are the crossfade of independently drawn windows that the standard gravitational-wave libraries implement, overlap-save finite-impulse-response filtering, autoregressive and autoregressive moving-average (ARMA) models, and the reproducible filter of PyCBC. One measure ranks them all: the covariance error against the target over the analysis band, evaluated from each generator's algebra; generated noise only checks the implementations. We also measure throughput, retained state and the cost of bit-exact regeneration. With the target continued smoothly below the band, the crossfade with windows of 256 s or more reaches an error below $10^{-3}$ on all eleven detector curves as tabulated, at about 4.7 million samples per second from a state of a few hundred bytes. An overlap-save filter is faster but needs tens of thousands of taps for an error of a few percent, and no tested autoregressive or ARMA configuration lies on the accuracy--throughput fronts. An error of $10^{-3}$ needs a window of 8 to 235 s, longest on the design curves with narrow lines, where it also depends on the tabulation. With the target cut at the band edge, as current generators do by default, every method has an error above one half on the projected Advanced LIGO (aLIGO) O4 curve, and the crossfade on five other curves. The crossfade is cyclostationary. With the continued target, its cyclic part is the larger part of the error only at 8 s, on the aLIGO O4 and the Virgo and KAGRA design curves, and stays within a factor of two of the stationary part on the aLIGO O3 and the Virgo and KAGRA design curves. We recommend the crossfade with a window from the table of detector curves, and a smooth continuation of the target below the band.

title: Physically Motivated Stellar Populations for Galaxies at Cosmic Dawn with a Temperature-Dependent IMF
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究常通过多波段测光或光谱的能量分布拟合，将观测到的星系光度反演为恒星质量、年龄、金属丰度和恒星形成历史。其核心是恒星族合成：给定初始质量函数（IMF）、恒星演化轨迹与光谱库，计算不同年龄和金属丰度的简单恒星族（SSP）模板，再与星系演化模型组合。IMF 决定光度-质量比，是质量估计系统误差的重要来源之一；本地宇宙校准的 IMF 与恒星族模型能否直接用于宇宙黎明（$z > 8$ 至 $12$）的高红移星系，是当前 JWST 时代的重要问题。若高红移星系被赋予过老或过重的星族，可能人为提高恒星质量，并引发与 $\Lambda$CDM 结构形成框架的紧张。因此，发展物理动机更强、适用于年轻且可能具有温度依赖 IMF 的高红移星族模型，并用统一拟合流程检验系统偏差，是该方向的关键研究范式。
contribution: 针对 JWST 在 $z > 12$ 发现此前未探测到的星系以及 $z > 8$ 星系质量估计中出现的与 $\Lambda$CDM 的潜在紧张，论文构建了简单恒星族库 SSPT，采用温度依赖的 IMF 计算，并在公开代码 CIGALE 中实现。针对高红移星系、要求年轻星族年龄的配置，该模型给出的恒星质量比采用本地宇宙校准模型的同类 CIGALE 分析低约 0.3–0.5 dex，比使用其他代码且对恒星年龄约束更宽松的分析低近 2 dex。**这些物理动机更强的星族模型表明，早期恒星形成星系的恒星质量并不与 $\Lambda$CDM 冲突，且在最高红移处由维里化暗物质晕形成星系的假说仍然合理。** SSPT 星族库及其 CIGALE 实现已公开发布。
summary: The first few years of James Webb Space Telescope observations have identified previously undetected galaxies at $z>12$ and provided new constraints on galaxies at $z>8$. Many of these objects have stellar masses that are difficult to reconcile with $Λ$CDM, inferred from models not calibrated for the high-redshift Universe. This necessitates new, more astrophysically plausible stellar population models for estimating stellar masses of galaxies at cosmic dawn. We introduce a simple stellar population (SSP) library, Simple Stellar Populations with Temperature (SSPT), computed using a temperature-dependent stellar initial mass function and its implementation in the public code CIGALE. When used in a configuration designed for high-redshift galaxies that requires young stellar population ages, the new models predict stellar masses that are ~0.3-0.5 dex lower than estimates from similar CIGALE analyses using models calibrated to the local Universe, and nearly 2 dex lower than estimates from analyses using other codes and softer constraints on stellar ages. Application of these physically motivated stellar populations suggests that stellar masses of early star-forming galaxies are not in tension with $Λ$CDM, and that galaxy formation from virialized halos remains a reasonable hypothesis at the highest redshifts. The SSPT SSPs and their CIGALE implementation are released publicly.

title: Deconvolved IXPE Polarization Maps of the Crab Nebula in a Maximum-a-Posteriori Framework
background_knowledge: X 射线偏振观测是高能天体物理中相对新兴的观测窗口，可在传统能谱与成像之外直接约束辐射机制和磁场几何。IXPE 利用气体像素探测器在软 X 射线波段同时记录光子的能量、入射位置和偏振信息。蟹状星云是脉冲星风云的典型代表，其 X 射线辐射主要来自相对论性电子在磁场中的同步辐射；偏振度和偏振角携带磁场位形、湍动程度以及粒子输运的信息。然而，望远镜点扩散函数、探测器响应以及响应随入射方向和偏振角的依赖会使图像和偏振结构发生模糊与混合，直接进行像素级分析可能受到仪器效应限制。偏振分辨反卷积本质上是一个逆问题：从计数数据恢复天区位置与偏振角空间中的分布，并借助正则化或最大后验（MAP）先验抑制噪声、提升重建稳定性。
contribution: 本文分析蟹状星云首个 IXPE 观测，采用基于最大后验（MAP）估计的偏振分辨反卷积方法。该方法将偏振分辨强度图重建为天区位置与偏振角空间中的三维分布，并使用依赖于 X 射线光子入射方向和偏振角的仪器响应。作者将该方法应用于 2–8 keV 能段的 IXPE 数据，并与基础分析结果比较。重建结果显示出更锐利的空间结构，**喷流形态比基础分析更清晰可辨**；重建图像还表明，在喷流区域**磁场方向倾向于与强度梯度方向垂直，且该趋势具有统计显著性**。尽管这些结果基于简化响应、仍存在系统不确定性，但工作表明 **基于 MAP 的反卷积能够提升 IXPE 偏振图对星云类源的可解释性**。
summary: We analyze the first IXPE observation of the Crab Nebula using a polarization-resolved deconvolution method based on maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation. The method reconstructs the polarization-resolved intensity map as a three-dimensional distribution in sky-position and polarization-angle spaces, using an instrumental response that depends on the incident direction and polarization angle of X-ray photons. We apply the method to the IXPE data in the 2-8~keV band and compare the result with that obtained using the basic analysis. Our result shows sharper spatial structure, making the jet shape more clearly identifiable than that in the basic analysis. The reconstructed image shows a statistically significant tendency for the magnetic-field orientation to be perpendicular to the intensity-gradient orientation in the jet region. Although these results are obtained by using a simplified response where systematic uncertainty remains, they demonstrate that our MAP-based deconvolution can improve the interpretability of IXPE polarization maps for nebular sources.

title: J-PAS: Exploring the connection between local environment and the triggering of bursty star formation in Extreme Emission Line Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究的重要问题之一，是恒星形成如何受到星系内部过程与外部环境的共同调控。低质量星系中常出现爆发式、间歇式的恒星形成；极端发射线星系（Extreme Emission Line Galaxies，EELGs）就是本地宇宙中一类紧凑、低质量且正在经历强烈星暴的系统，其强发射线和特殊物理条件使其成为研究早期宇宙星系的本地类比对象。星系—星系相互作用和并合可通过引力扰动、气体流入与激波压缩等机制触发或增强恒星形成，因此观测上常通过寻找近距离伴星系、测量配对比例来检验相互作用是否为主要触发机制。J-PAS 的多窄带测光能力有助于获得较精确的测光红移和发射线信息；结合测光红移概率分布、SED 拟合以及投影与完备性校正，可以在统计上研究 EELGs 的局域环境和伴星系性质。
contribution: 论文利用 J-PAS 内部数据释放中 $0.03 \lesssim z \lesssim 0.9$、覆盖约 30 deg$^2$ 天区的 917 个 EELGs，系统表征其局域环境，以检验其极端性质是否与近邻伴星系有关。作者采用基于完整测光红移概率分布的配对概率函数（Pair Probability Function），在投影距离至 200 kpc、速度差至 $500\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ 的范围内寻找伴星系，并用 CIGALE 对 EELGs 及其伴星系进行 SED 拟合，得到恒星质量、恒星形成率、尘埃消光和金属丰度估计；同时用 Monte Carlo 模拟校正投影效应和完备性。结果显示平均配对比例为 $f_\mathrm{pair} = 0.162^{+0.048}_{-0.033}$，即 **仅约 16% 的 EELGs 有可探测伴星系，且该配对比例低于相同判据下其他恒星形成星系的平均观测值**。在 J-PAS 灵敏度和恒星质量完备性范围内探测到的伴星系往往质量更高、基于 SED 的金属丰度估计也更高，表明 **EELGs 通常是非对称配对系统中的低质量成员**；但低于这些探测极限的低质量伴星系可能仍未被探测到。论文还发现，[O III] $\lambda$5007、H$\beta$ 和 H$\alpha$ 发射线的等值宽与到已探测伴星系的投影距离之间 **没有统计显著的相关性**。
summary: [Abridged]Extreme Emission Line Galaxies (EELGs) are compact, low-mass systems undergoing intense bursts of star formation, whose physical conditions resemble those of galaxies in the early Universe. We characterise the local environment of EELGs identified in the J-PAS survey to determine whether their extreme properties are associated with the presence of nearby companions, as expected if galaxy-galaxy interactions were the main trigger of the burst. We analyse 917 EELGs from the J-PAS internal data release at $0.03 \lesssim z \lesssim 0.9$ over $\sim$30 deg$^2$. We use the Pair Probability Function formalism, based on the full photometric redshift probability distributions, to identify companions within projected separations up to 200 kpc and velocity differences up to 500 km s$^{-1}$. Stellar masses, star formation rates, dust attenuation, and metallicity estimates were derived for the EELGs and their companions through SED fitting with CIGALE, and Monte Carlo simulations were used to correct for projection and completeness effects. The average pair fraction of the EELGs is $f_\mathrm{pair} = 0.162^{+0.048}_{-0.033}$, indicating that only $\sim$16% of the sample has detectable companions, a value lower than the observed average for other star-forming galaxies within the adopted limits. When detected within the sensitivity and stellar-mass completeness limits of J-PAS, companions tend to be more massive and to show higher SED-based metallicity estimates than the EELGs, suggesting that the latter are typically the low-mass components of asymmetric pairs. However, lower-mass companions below these limits may remain undetected. No statistically significant correlation is found between the equivalent widths of the [OIII]$λ$5007, H$β$, and H$α$ emission lines and the projected separation to the detected companions within the J-PAS limits.

title: An Empirical Temperature Relation for Chemical Abundances in AGN
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积释放的辐射供能，其强辐射场会电离周围气体并产生宽线区与窄线区（NLR）。NLR 云密度较低、禁线辐射显著，是研究 AGN 周围星际介质和化学丰度的重要探针。丰度测量通常依赖碰撞激发谱线：用同一离子的 auroral 线与强线的通量比可得到电子温度 $T_e$，再结合线强比推导氧等元素丰度，即 direct（$T_e$）方法。低电离区与高电离区温度不同（分别常记为 $t_2$ 与 $t_3$），完整 direct 方法需要两者；当只有 [O III] 4363 等单一 auroral 线时，必须借助 $t_2$–$t_3$ 关系从高电离区温度估计低电离区温度。H II 区已有此类校准，但 AGN 的辐射场更硬，且密度/压强结构和激波可能不同，因此需要专门的经验关系。
contribution: 论文首次基于 [N II] 与 [O III] auroral 线测量样本，给出 AGN 窄线区云的经验温度结构，并建立首个稳健的 AGN $t_2$–$t_3$ 经验关系：$t_2 = 1.285 t_3 + 0.799$（温度以 $10^4$ K 为单位）。作者发现，与其它 $t_2$–$t_3$ 校准相比，当 direct 方法仅使用 [O III] 4363 时，$12+\log(\mathrm{O/H})$ 会出现显著差异；**采用本文关系能最准确地还原完整 direct 方法得到的 $12+\log(\mathrm{O/H})$**。为解释该关系的物理机制，作者将观测到的 [N II] 6584/5755 与 [O III] 5007/4363 通量比分布与多种电离模型预测进行比较，发现**幂律密度梯度、压强分层以及（有时显著的）天体物理激波贡献驱动了这些通量比的大部分弥散，而金属冷却主导分布的主要形状**。更准确的 $t_2$–$t_3$ 与 $12+\log(\mathrm{O/H})$ 有助于刻画 AGN 光电离星际介质在广阔宇宙时间范围内的性质，并为 JWST 在 $z>6$ 的新观测以及理解最早星系演化阶段的化学增丰提供更好的背景。
summary: We present for the very first time the empirical temperature structure of the narrow line region (NLR) clouds of active galactic nuclei (AGNs) based on a sample of [N II] and [O III] auroral line measurements. The scaling of Te([N II]) with Te([O III]), expressed as the t2-t3 relation, is key to deriving accurate chemical abundances, in AGNs and other line-emitting nebulae, particularly when only one auroral line is observed. Here, we provide the first robust empirical description of t2-t3 for AGNs: t2(10^4 K)=1.285*t3(10^4 K)+0.799. We find substantial changes in 12+log(O/H) when compared to other t2-t3 calibrations when using the direct, or Te, method with only the [O III] 4363 auroral line. We find that adopting our t2-t3 most accurately recovers the fully direct method 12+log(O/H). To interpret the physical mechanisms behind the AGN t2-t3, we compare the observed distribution of [N II] 6584/5755 and [O III] 5007/4363 flux ratios to a variety of ionization model predictions. We find evidence for power law density gradients, pressure stratification, and (sometimes significant) contributions from astrophysical shocks driving much of the dispersion on these flux ratios while metal cooling dominates the primary shape of the distribution.
